https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: POSCO Group’s 1% Foundation is expanding its community programs, supporting veterans with disabilities, providing hands-on science education for teenagers and funding employee-led projects to address local needs. As of last year, 38,017 POSCO Group employees participated in the foundation’s donation program. The foundation recruits local university students and people with career breaks as instructors, helping create jobs.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: POSCO Group的1%基金会正在扩大社区项目，为残疾退伍军人提供支持，为青少年提供实践科学教育，并为员工主导、回应当地需求的项目提供资金。截至去年，已有38,017名POSCO Group员工参加了该基金会的捐赠项目。该基金会招募当地大学生和职业经历中断的人士担任讲师，帮助创造就业机会。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: POSCO Group’s 1% Foundation is expanding its community programs, supporting veterans with disabilities, providing hands-on science education for teenagers and funding employee-led projects to address local needs. The nonprofit foundation, established in 2013, is funded by employee donations of 1 percent of monthly salaries and matching contributions from their companies. As of last year, 38,017 POSCO Group employees participated in the foundation’s donation program. Since 2020, the foundation has provided advanced assistive devices to veterans, service members and firefighters injured in service, in cooperation with the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, which helps identify recipients and assess their needs. Devices provided so far include a robotic walking aid for a veteran who suffered paralysis of the lower body after a fall during military service and a prosthetic arm for another veteran who lost his right arm in an accident during a coastal surveillance operation. The government provides support depending on the severity of service-related injuries, but expensive advanced assistive devices, such as robotic prosthetic legs, are not covered by government assistance programs, making private-sector support essential. Over six years, the program has supported 219 people with a total investment of 6 billion won ($4.52 million). In 2019, the foundation also launched an education program to introduce middle school students to science through experiments and project-based learning. The four-day program, open to all first-year middle schoolers in Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province, and Gwangyang, South Jeolla Province, brings students to explore technologies related to POSCO’s businesses. Since its launch, the program has reached over 26,300 students at 201 schools, adding schools in Incheon's Songdo this year. The foundation recruits local university students and people with career breaks as instructors, helping create jobs. Meanwhile, the foundation has been operating an employee-led initiative, Change My Town, since 2019. POSCO Group employees propose and carry out projects addressing problems in communities near the company’s business sites. The foundation selects projects based on their public benefit, urgency and expected local impact, then provides funding. Projects have included repairing electrical equipment at disability service centers, building custom furniture for people with limited mobility, renovating playgrounds and installing fire safety equipment in older residents’ homes. The initiative has supported a total of 666 projects since its launch, with an annual budget of 500 million won. “The initiative provides employees with a platform to take the lead as change-makers in their communities,” a group official said. “We will continue to fully support employees’ ideas and enthusiasm to bring positive change to local communities.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: POSCO 1%基金会支持退役军人、学生和当地社区
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: POSCO集团的1%基金正在扩大社区项目，为残障退伍军人提供支持，为青少年提供动手科学教育，并为员工主导、旨在解决本地需求的项目提供资金。这家非营利基金会成立于2013年，资金来自员工每月工资1%的捐款以及各公司的配套出资。截至去年，共有38,017名POSCO集团员工参加了该基金会的捐款计划。自2020年以来，该基金会与退伍军人及军人家属事务部合作，为因公负伤的退伍军人、军人和消防员提供先进辅助设备；该部协助确定受助者并评估其需求。迄今提供的设备包括一款机器人步行辅助器，供一名退伍军人在服役期间跌倒后导致下半身瘫痪后使用；还包括一只假肢手臂，供另一名退伍军人在海岸监视行动期间遭遇事故失去右臂后使用。政府会根据与服役相关伤害的严重程度提供援助，但机器人假肢腿等昂贵的先进辅助设备不在政府援助计划覆盖范围内，因此私营部门的支持至关重要。六年来，该计划共为219人提供支持，总投资达60亿韩元（452万美元）。2019年，基金会还启动了一项教育计划，通过实验和项目式学习向初中学生介绍科学知识。这项为期四天的计划面向庆尚北道浦项和全罗南道光阳的所有初一学生，带领学生探索与POSCO业务相关的技术。计划启动以来，已惠及201所学校的26,300多名学生，并于今年将仁川新岛纳入其中。基金会招募当地大学生和处于职业间歇期的人士担任讲师，帮助创造就业机会。与此同时，自2019年起，基金会一直在运营一项由员工主导的计划——“改变我的城镇”。POSCO集团员工提出并执行项目，解决公司业务所在地附近社区面临的问题。基金会根据项目的公共效益、紧迫性和预期地方影响进行筛选，随后提供资金支持。已开展的项目包括维修残疾服务中心 electrical equipment、为行动不便人士定制家具、翻新操场，以及在老年居民家中安装消防安全设备。该计划启动以来共支持了666个项目，年度预算为5亿韩元。集团一名官员表示：“该计划为员工提供了平台，让他们能够主动成为社区变革的推动者。”“我们将继续全力支持员工的创意和热情，为当地社区带来积极改变。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Police step up crackdown on fake uniforms ahead of Halloween
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Police will launch a nationwide crackdown on imitation uniforms and equipment ahead of Halloween amid concerns that such items could be used to impersonate officers or disrupt police operations. The crackdown follows concerns raised after the deadly 2022 Itaewon crowd crush, when people costumed in police uniforms were reportedly mistaken for actual officers, causing confusion and hindering rescue operations.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 警方将在万圣节前发起全国范围的打击仿制制服和装备行动，因为担心这些物品可能被用于冒充警察或干扰警方行动。此次打击行动是在2022年梨泰院致命人群挤压事件引发担忧后进行的，据报道，当时身着警察制服的人被误认为是真正的警察，导致混乱并阻碍了救援行动。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Police will launch a nationwide crackdown on imitation uniforms and equipment ahead of Halloween amid concerns that such items could be used to impersonate officers or disrupt police operations. According to the National Police Agency (NPA) Sunday, the weeklong operation will run from Monday through Nov. 1, targeting the production, sale and distribution of imitation police gear in cooperation with provincial and metropolitan police agencies. Under the current law, civilians who wear or possess official or imitation police uniforms or equipment face up to six months in prison or fines of up to 3 million won ($2,260). The crackdown follows concerns raised after the deadly 2022 Itaewon crowd crush, when people costumed in police uniforms were reportedly mistaken for actual officers, causing confusion and hindering rescue operations. Similarly, Korea also restricts the unauthorized wearing of military uniforms under a separate law, which prohibits civilians from wearing official military attire or uniforms that could make them difficult to distinguish from actual service members. During the Halloween period, police will work with the Korea Online Shopping Association to step up monitoring of major online shopping platforms and secondhand marketplaces. They also plan to block searches for keywords such as “police uniform” and other related terms to curb the sale of imitation police gear. Authorities will intensify inspections of 54 major online retailers while conducting on-site patrols and enforcement in popular Halloween gathering spots, including Itaewon and Hongdae in Seoul. Those found violating the regulations could face criminal investigations. Police also urged the public to avoid selling or wearing police-themed costumes and accessories, even if they do not legally qualify as imitation uniforms, warning that they could be mistaken for actual police attire, particularly at night or in crowded areas. The NPA said it would continue efforts to raise public awareness of the regulations and encourage compliance to prevent confusion and misuse of police uniforms and equipment
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 万圣节前，警方加强打击假冒制服行为
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 万圣节前夕，警方将在全国范围内开展打击仿制警服及警用装备的专项行动，因为外界担忧此类物品可能被用于冒充警察或干扰警务行动。据韩国国家警察厅（NPA）周日表示，为期一周的行动将从周一开始持续至11月1日，警方将与各道及大都市警察机构合作，打击仿制警用装备的生产、销售和流通。根据现行法律，佩戴或持有制式或仿制警服及警用装备的平民，最高可被判处6个月监禁或处以最高300万韩元（$2,260）的罚款。此次专项行动紧随外界对2022年梨泰院踩踏惨案的担忧展开；据报道，当时有人身穿警察服装的戏装，被误认为真正的警察，造成混乱并妨碍救援工作。韩国还依据另一部法律限制未经授权穿着军服，禁止平民穿着制式军装或可能让人难以与现役军人区分的制服。万圣节期间，警方将与韩国网上购物协会合作加强对大型在线购物平台和二手交易市场的监管。警方还计划屏蔽“警察制服”等关键词及其他相关词条，以遏制仿制警用装备的销售。当局将加强对54家大型网络零售商的检查，同时在首尔梨泰院和弘大等万圣节热门聚集地开展现场巡逻和执法。违反相关规定者可能面临刑事调查。警方还敦促公众不要销售或穿着以警察为主题的服装及配饰，即使这些物品依法不构成仿制警服也应如此，因为它们可能被误认为真正的警服，尤其是在夜间或拥挤场所。韩国国家警察厅表示，将继续加强相关法规的宣传并鼓励公众遵守规定，以防止警服及警用装备引发混淆和滥用。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: North Korea's evolving threat goes beyond missiles as Russia ties deepen
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Experts warn Russian jammers, Ukraine combat experience could reshape Pyongyang's tactics North Korea’s military cooperation with Russia is giving Pyongyang more than new weapons. Gen. Xavier Brunson, commander of U.S. Forces Korea, recently warned that North Korea had received Russian-made jamming equipment and had gained experience in moving troops and supplies over long distances through its involvement in Russia’s war against Ukraine.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 专家警告称，俄罗斯干扰设备以及乌克兰作战经验可能重塑平壤的战术。北朝鲜与俄罗斯的军事合作给平壤带来的不只是新武器。驻韩美军司令Xavier Brunson将军最近警告称，北朝鲜已获得俄罗斯制造的干扰设备，并通过参与俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争，积累了长距离调动兵员和物资的经验。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Experts warn Russian jammers, Ukraine combat experience could reshape Pyongyang's tactics North Korea’s military cooperation with Russia is giving Pyongyang more than new weapons. From electronic warfare equipment to battlefield lessons learned in Ukraine, the partnership could change how North Korean forces fight, military experts say, although the extent of those gains remains difficult to verify. Gen. Xavier Brunson, commander of U.S. Forces Korea, recently warned that North Korea had received Russian-made jamming equipment and had gained experience in moving troops and supplies over long distances through its involvement in Russia’s war against Ukraine. Speaking at a Center for Strategic and International Studies' event on Oct. 13, Brunson said the equipment marked a change in North Korea’s electronic warfare capabilities. “They didn’t have those jammers before. Those jammers were given to them by the Russians,” he said. Brunson also pointed to interference affecting movement in Korean territorial waters, saying the jamming activity had not reached its full potential. His remarks raised questions about how far Russian assistance has strengthened North Korea’s ability to disrupt communications and navigation. Beyond the equipment, Brunson said North Korean troops had gained experience deploying personnel and military equipment over long distances, organizing supply lines and sustaining operations abroad. Such skills are difficult to acquire through military exercises alone. Shin Jong-woo, secretary-general of the Korea Defense and Security Forum, said the lessons could become a threat if North Korea puts them into practice. “No matter how realistically you train, you can’t reproduce the conditions of an actual war exactly,” Shin said. He noted that North Korean troops had faced drone attacks in Ukraine and had opportunities to adapt their tactics. “If they develop their doctrine from that experience, it becomes a security threat to us.” Shin said Russia was capable of supplying more advanced electronic warfare equipment than North Korea had previously acquired from abroad. Such systems could interfere with military communications and GPS-guided weapons, potentially disrupting battlefield coordination during a conflict, Shin said. He considered Russian assistance plausible but did not independently confirm any specific equipment transfer. “Electronic warfare is fundamental to modern warfare,” he said. Retired Lt. Gen. Chun In-bum, a former commander of the Army’s Special Warfare Command, said the greater threat lies not in individual weapons but in how new technology and battlefield experience could work together to strengthen North Korea’s military capabilities. “It’s not just missiles, electronic warfare or drones. It’s all of them coming together,” Chun said. “One plus one plus one doesn’t add up to three. It becomes five or 10.” Chun was particularly concerned that North Korean troops had grown more confident through their battlefield experience and might be more willing to take risks along the border. However, Chun cautioned against assuming that combat experience alone had turned North Korea into a modern fighting force. “Battlefield experience does not automatically produce a modern, competent military. But neither should we dismiss them,” he said, emphasizing that North Korea was learning and receiving outside assistance. Shin was less convinced that growing confidence would translate into bolder provocations. North Korea, he said, also knows that South Korean forces possess accurate and powerful weapons, a factor its commanders cannot ignore. A military official, meanwhile, said the practical effects of North Korea’s experience in Ukraine remain unclear. It is difficult to establish how returning troops have changed their training or small-unit tactics without observing those changes over time, the official said. “To assess the actual threat, you need to see what they do,” the official said, adding that evidence must accumulate before analysts can distinguish new capabilities from potential ones. The official did not confirm whether the military had independently verified the arrival or deployment of the Russian jammers Brunson described
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 随着与俄罗斯关系加深，朝鲜不断演变的威胁已不止于导弹
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 专家警告称，俄罗斯的电子干扰设备以及乌克兰战场经验可能重塑平壤的战术。军事专家表示，朝鲜与俄罗斯的军事合作给平壤带来的不只是新武器。从电子战设备到在乌克兰学到的战场经验，这种伙伴关系可能改变朝鲜军队的作战方式，尽管这些收益的具体程度仍难以核实。美军朝鲜地区司令部司令泽维尔·布伦森将军近日警告称，朝鲜已经获得俄罗斯制造的干扰设备，并因参与俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争而积累了远距离调动兵员和物资的经验。布伦森于10月13日在战略与国际研究中心举办的一场活动上表示，这些设备标志着朝鲜电子战能力发生了变化。他说：“他们以前没有这些干扰设备。这些干扰设备是俄罗斯人给他们的。”布伦森还指出，朝鲜半岛水域内的航行受到了干扰，并称这种干扰活动的全部潜力尚未得到发挥。他的言论引发了人们对俄罗斯援助在多大程度上增强了朝鲜扰乱通信与导航能力的疑问。布伦森说，除了设备之外，朝鲜部队还积累了远距离部署人员与军事装备、组织补给线以及维持境外行动的经验。此类技能很难仅靠军事演习获得。韩国国防安全论坛秘书长申钟佑表示，如果朝鲜将这些经验付诸实践，其经验可能构成威胁。申说：“无论训练得多么逼真，都无法完全重现真正战争的环境。”他指出，朝鲜部队在乌克兰遭遇过无人机袭击，并有机会调整战术。申说：“如果他们以此经验发展自己的作战理论，就会成为我们的安全威胁。”申表示，俄罗斯有能力向朝鲜提供比其此前从海外获得的技术更先进的电子战设备。申说，此类系统能够干扰军事通信和全球定位系统制导武器，在冲突期间可能扰乱战场协同。他认为俄罗斯提供援助是可信的，但没有独立确认任何具体的设备转让。他说：“电子战是现代战争的基础。”已退役的陆军中将全仁范曾任韩国陆军特种作战司令部司令。他表示，更大的威胁不在于某一种武器，而在于新技术与战场经验如何相互结合，从而增强朝鲜的军事能力。全说：“不只是导弹、电子战或无人机，而是所有这些力量汇聚在一起。一加一加一并不等于三，而会变成五或10。”全尤其担心，朝鲜部队通过战场经验变得更加自信，因而更可能在边境沿线冒险。不过，全警告说，不能仅凭作战经验就认定朝鲜已经变成一支现代化作战力量。他说：“战场经验不会自动造就一支现代且称职的军队。但我们也不应低估他们。”他强调，朝鲜正在学习并获得外部援助。申则不太相信日益增强的自信会转化为更大胆的挑衅。他说，朝鲜也知道韩国军队拥有精确而强大的武器，这是其指挥官无法忽视的因素。与此同时，一名军方官员表示，朝鲜在乌克兰积累经验的实际效果仍不清楚。这名官员说，如果不长期观察相关变化，就很难确定归国部队如何改变了训练方式或小分队战术。这名官员说：“要评估实际威胁，你必须观察他们采取什么行动。”他补充说，证据必须不断积累，分析人员才能区分朝鲜已经具备的新能力与潜在能力。这名官员没有确认军方是否独立核实了布伦森所称的俄罗斯干扰设备已经抵达并投入使用

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Korean Air breach exposes blind spot in airline cybersecurity
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Airlines face persistent risks from third-party IT partners A recent data breach involving Korean Air and Asiana Airlines demonstrates the aviation industry’s structural vulnerability to cyberattacks targeting third-party IT providers. Last week, Korean Air and Asiana said customer reservation information had been leaked through Amadeus IT Group, a global aviation technology provider that operates reservation and ticketing systems for airlines worldwide.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 航空公司持续面临来自第三方IT合作伙伴的风险。大韩航空和韩亚航空近期发生的数据泄露事件表明，航空业在结构上容易受到针对第三方IT供应商的网络攻击。上周，大韩航空和韩亚航空表示，客户预订信息已通过Amadeus IT Group泄露。该公司是全球航空技术提供商，为世界各地的航空公司运营预订和票务系统。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Airlines face persistent risks from third-party IT partners A recent data breach involving Korean Air and Asiana Airlines demonstrates the aviation industry’s structural vulnerability to cyberattacks targeting third-party IT providers. Carriers depend on external IT system operators to manage critical operations, as they have to share passenger booking and ticketing data with external partners for real-time global operation. Last week, Korean Air and Asiana said customer reservation information had been leaked through Amadeus IT Group, a global aviation technology provider that operates reservation and ticketing systems for airlines worldwide. The two carriers said Amadeus had notified them of the incident on Tuesday. The breach is believed to have involved unauthorized access using login credentials assigned to an account in Amadeus' system. The estimated incident window spans August 2023 to last month, although investigators have yet to establish the exact timing. Korean Air confirmed that some customers' booking reference numbers were among the exposed information, while the full scope of the leak and the number of affected customers remained under investigation. Asiana also confirmed that reservation-related information had been compromised, but said payment data was not affected because it uses a separate system for transactions. Neither airline has found evidence of a direct breach of its own internal systems or databases, they said. They activated security measures after being notified and are working to prevent further damage. Amadeus is also blocking unauthorized access and monitoring the dark web, according to the airlines. Industry officials said the incident shows how difficult it is for airlines to eliminate cybersecurity risks stemming from third-party providers in an industry that relies heavily on information sharing. Airlines must exchange booking, ticketing and passenger information with travel agencies, partner carriers and other service providers to operate international routes and manage customer itineraries. Building and maintaining all the necessary systems and connections independently would require substantial investment and technical resources. Global providers such as Amadeus offer established platforms that connect airlines with the wider travel ecosystem. But when multiple carriers rely on the same provider, a security incident at that company can potentially affect customers across different airlines, creating a shared point of vulnerability. The incident also underscores the importance of airlines monitoring the security practices of their tech partners, rather than relying solely on their own cybersecurity measures. “Airlines face structural cybersecurity risks because they rely on external technology providers for stable operations,” an industry official said. Korean Air said it had requested stronger safeguards and measures to prevent further issues from Amadeus. In 2017, a technical network failure affecting Amadeus systems disrupted check-in services at airports worldwide, demonstrating how problems at a shared provider can affect multiple carriers
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 大韩航空遭入侵事件暴露航空公司网络安全盲区
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 航空公司面临来自第三方信息技术合作伙伴的持续风险。大韩航空和韩亚航空近期发生的数据泄露事件表明，航空业在抵御针对第三方信息技术供应商的网络攻击方面存在结构性脆弱性。航空公司依赖外部信息技术系统运营商管理关键运营环节，因为它们必须与外部合作伙伴共享旅客预订和机票数据，以实现全球实时运营。上周，大韩航空和韩亚航空表示，客户预订信息已通过Amadeus IT Group泄露。Amadeus IT Group是一家全球航空技术供应商，为世界各地的航空公司运营预订和机票系统。两家航空公司表示，Amadeus已于周二将此事通知它们。据信，此次泄露事件涉及利用分配给Amadeus系统内某个账户的登录凭据进行未经授权的访问。事件窗口估计从2023年8月持续至上个月，但调查人员尚未确定具体时间。大韩航空确认，部分客户的预订参考编号也存在于泄露信息中，而泄露的完整范围和受影响客户数量仍在调查中。韩亚航空也确认预订相关信息已经遭到泄露，但表示支付数据未受影响，因为其交易使用独立系统。两家航空公司表示，尚未发现其自身内部系统或数据库遭直接入侵的证据。它们在收到通知后启动了安全措施，并正致力于防止进一步损害。据航空公司介绍，Amadeus也正在阻止未经授权的访问，并监测暗网。行业人士表示，该事件表明，在一个高度依赖信息共享的行业中，航空公司很难彻底消除由第三方供应商引发的网络安全风险。航空公司必须与旅行社、合作伙伴航空公司及其他服务提供商交换预订、机票和旅客信息，才能运营国际航线并管理客户行程。独立建设和维护所有必要的系统及连接，需要大量投资和技术资源。Amadeus等全球供应商提供成熟的平台，将航空公司与更广泛的旅行生态系统连接起来。然而，当多家航空公司依赖同一家供应商时，该公司的安全事件可能影响不同航空公司的客户，从而形成共同 vulnerability。此次事件还凸显了航空公司监控其技术合作伙伴安全实践的重要性，而不能仅仅依赖自身网络安全措施。一位行业人士表示：“航空公司依赖外部技术提供商维持稳定运营，因此面临结构性网络安全风险。”大韩航空表示，它已要求Amadeus加强保障措施，防止问题再次发生。2017年，一次影响Amadeus系统的技术网络故障扰乱了全球各地机场的值机服务，说明共享供应商出现问题时可能影响多家航空公司……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: More Korean middle school students experience feelings of depression: data
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The proportion of Korean middle school students who experienced feelings of depression exceeded that of high school students for the third consecutive year in 2025, data showed Sunday. The share of middle school students who said they felt depressed accounted for 26.2 percent last year, compared with 25.1 percent for high school students, according to the data by the Korean Educational Development Institute.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国教育开发研究院的数据显示，2025年韩国初中学生经历抑郁情绪的比例连续第三年高于高中生。去年，表示感到抑郁的初中生占26.2%，高中生则为25.1%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The proportion of Korean middle school students who experienced feelings of depression exceeded that of high school students for the third consecutive year in 2025, data showed Sunday. The share of middle school students who said they felt depressed accounted for 26.2 percent last year, compared with 25.1 percent for high school students, according to the data by the Korean Educational Development Institute. In the study, "feelings of depression" were defined as experiencing sadness or despair severe enough to suspend daily routines for two consecutive weeks over the past year. In 2024, the proportion of such middle school students came to 27.9 percent, higher than 27.5 percent recorded for high school students. In 2023, middle school students experiencing feelings of depression accounted for 26.3 percent, compared with 25.6 percent for high school students. In the January-June period of this year, a total of 112 elementary, middle and high school students died by suicide. Of them, 43, or 38.4 percent, were middle school students, according to data by the education ministry. Last year, a total of 244 students took their own lives, and 92 of them were middle school students
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 数据显示，更多韩国初中学生出现抑郁情绪
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 数据显示，2025年韩国初中学生经历抑郁情绪的比例连续第三年超过高中生。根据韩国教育开发研究院的数据，去年表示感到抑郁的初中学生占26.2%，而高中生为25.1%。该研究将“抑郁情绪”定义为在过去一年中，悲伤或绝望的程度严重到连续两周无法维持日常生活。2024年，此类初中学生占27.9%，高于高中生的27.5%。2023年，经历抑郁情绪的初中学生占26.3%，高中生为25.6%。今年1月至6月，共有112名小学、初中和高中学生自杀身亡。据教育部数据，其中43人为初中学生，占38.4%。去年，共有244名学生结束了自己的生命，其中92人为初中学生

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Footage released of huge Korean national flag on Dokdo Island
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Promotional footage of a huge national flag of Korea on its easternmost island of Dokdo was unveiled Sunday to mark Dokdo Day, a social media post showed. A 30-by-20-meter Taegeukgi, unfurled by 70 Koreans at a pier on Dokdo Island, was captured in 60-second footage taken by drone, according to Seo Kyoung-duk, a professor at Sungshin Women's University in Seoul, on social media.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 社交媒体帖子显示，为纪念独岛日，韩国于其最东端的独岛公布了一面巨大国旗的宣传影像。据首尔诚信女子大学教授徐敬德在社交媒体上发布的消息，一幅30米乘20米的太极旗由70名韩国人在独岛码头展开，并由无人机拍摄成一段60秒的视频。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Promotional footage of a huge national flag of Korea on its easternmost island of Dokdo was unveiled Sunday to mark Dokdo Day, a social media post showed. A 30-by-20-meter Taegeukgi, unfurled by 70 Koreans at a pier on Dokdo Island, was captured in 60-second footage taken by drone, according to Seo Kyoung-duk, a professor at Sungshin Women's University in Seoul, on social media. The video also contained various images of Dokdo Island in the East Sea and a message recommending foreigners visit as part of a global promotional campaign for Dokdo. Korea has said Dokdo is historically, geographically and under international law its territory, categorically rejecting Japan's claim to the territory. Korea keeps a small police detachment on the islets, to showcase its effective control of Dokdo
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 发布巨型韩国国旗在独岛岛升起的画面
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 社交媒体上发布的一段视频显示，为纪念独岛日，韩国于周日在其最东端的独岛展示了巨幅韩国国旗宣传影像。首尔诚信女子大学 Seo Kyoung-duk 教授在社交媒体上称，一面长30米、宽20米的太极旗，由70名韩国人在独岛一座码头展开，拍摄这段60秒视频的素材由无人机拍摄。该视频还收录了独岛在东海 various 景象，并发布了一段信息，建议外国人将独岛游览纳入全球宣传活动的一部分。韩国表示，独岛在历史、地理以及国际法上均属于韩国领土，明确拒绝日本对该领土的主张。韩国在岛上驻有一支小型警察分队，以展示其对独岛的有效控制

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Foreign-language emergency calls more than double in Korea
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Tourism boom strains police interpretation services As a record number of international tourists visit Korea, police are facing a growing demand for interpretation services, both for foreign-language emergency calls and at crime scenes. According to data submitted by the National Police Agency to Rep. Park Ju-min of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea, police received 21,252 emergency calls in foreign languages last year, nearly double the 10,348 recorded in 2024.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 旅游业繁荣让警方口译服务承受压力 随着到访韩国的国际游客创下纪录，警方面临的口译服务需求不断增长，既包括外语紧急求助电话，也包括犯罪现场口译。据韩国执政党民主党的朴柱民议员收到的国家警察厅数据，警方去年接听的外语紧急电话达21,252起， nearly double the 10,348 recorded in 2024.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Tourism boom strains police interpretation services As a record number of international tourists visit Korea, police are facing a growing demand for interpretation services, both for foreign-language emergency calls and at crime scenes. However, budget constraints have hindered efforts to recruit additional professional interpreters for languages other than English and Chinese, leaving officers to struggle with language barriers, particularly at crime scenes where interpreters are often difficult to secure on short notice. Foreign arrivals to Korea rose 21.5 percent year-on-year to 17.11 million in the first nine months of this year, up from 14.08 million in 2025, further increasing demand for police interpretation services. According to data submitted by the National Police Agency to Rep. Park Ju-min of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea, police received 21,252 emergency calls in foreign languages last year, nearly double the 10,348 recorded in 2024. The surge has continued this year, with 21,012 foreign-language calls recorded through August, nearly equaling last year's annual total. Despite repeated requests for additional interpreters, recruitment has remained stalled due to a lack of funding. Beyond emergency calls, police also face challenges securing interpreters for in-person questioning of foreign nationals at police stations, where they rely on civilian interpreters rather than dedicated staff. Unlike 112 emergency call centers, which have interpreters on duty, police stations arrange interpretation services on a case-by-case basis, calling in civilian interpreters who typically hold other jobs. The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency had 629 registered civilian interpreters as of last month. Chinese interpreters accounted for the largest share at 198, followed by 97 for English, 64 for Vietnamese, 57 for Japanese, 39 for Russian, 33 for Mongolian and 18 for Thai. However, disparities in interpreter availability across languages and scheduling conflicts often make it difficult for police to secure interpreters when needed. The challenge is even greater at crime scenes, where bringing in an interpreter on short notice can be particularly difficult. Accurate communication is especially critical when arresting foreign nationals, as police are legally required to inform suspects of their rights, including the reason for their arrest and their right to legal counsel, under the Miranda warning. To address these challenges, police have begun using smartphone applications and translation devices, though such initiatives remain limited to individual police agencies and stations rather than being implemented nationwide. The Gyeonggi Nambu Provincial Police Agency has developed a smartphone application that allows officers to recite the Miranda warning to foreign suspects in their native languages. Officers can select a language, and the application provides the warning through both audio and text. Meanwhile, Seoul's Mapo Police Station has introduced a standalone translation device that converts officers' spoken words into a selected foreign language. The device can be used to deliver the Miranda warning and assist foreign nationals seeking police services. Police are also developing an artificial intelligence-powered interpretation system to ease the growing burden of handling foreign-language emergency calls. The system will automatically detect foreign languages and translate conversations between police officers and callers in real time. However, until the system is fully developed and deployed, police will have to continue relying on existing interpreters, leaving language barriers a persistent challenge in emergency response operations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国外语紧急呼叫数量增至两倍以上
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国旅游业蓬勃发展，警方口译服务不堪重负。随着赴韩国际游客数量创下纪录，警方面临越来越多的口译需求，包括外语紧急求助电话以及犯罪现场的口译服务。然而，预算限制阻碍了招聘更多精通英语和中文以外语言的专业口译员，导致警员难以克服语言障碍，尤其是在犯罪现场，因为临时寻找口译员往往十分困难。今年前9个月，外国入境韩国人数同比增长21.5%，达到1711万人次，高于2025年的1408万人，进一步增加了警方口译服务需求。据韩国国家警察厅向执政的韩国民主党议员朴珠敏提交的数据，去年警方接到21252通外语紧急求助电话，几乎是2024年记录的10348通的两倍。今年这一增幅仍在持续，截至8月已记录21012通外语电话，几乎追平去年全年总量。尽管警方多次要求增配口译员，但由于缺乏资金，招聘工作仍陷入停滞。除了紧急求助电话外，警方还难以安排口译员在警察局对外国籍人士进行当面问询，只能依靠兼职民间口译员，而非专职人员。与配备值班口译员的112紧急求助中心不同，警察局按个案安排口译服务，通常临时呼叫从事其他工作的民间口译员。截至上个月，首尔 Metropolitan Police Agency登记的民间口译员共有629名。其中中文口译员人数最多，为198名；英语97名、越南语64名、日语57名、俄语39名、蒙古语33名、泰语18名。然而，各语言口译员供给不均以及排班冲突，往往使警方难以在需要时找到口译员。犯罪现场面临的问题更加严峻，因为临时调用口译员尤其困难。逮捕外国籍人士时，准确沟通尤为重要，因为根据米兰达警告的法律要求，警方必须告知嫌疑人其权利，包括逮捕原因以及获得法律代理的权利。为应对这些挑战，警方已开始使用智能手机应用和翻译设备，但此类举措仍仅限于各警察机构和派出所，尚未在全国实施。京畿南道警察厅开发了一款智能手机应用，可让警员用外国嫌疑人的母语宣读米兰达警告。警员可以选择语言，应用会通过音频和文字提供警告内容。与此同时，首尔麻浦警察所引入了一款独立式翻译设备，可将警员的口头话语转换成所选外语。该设备可用于宣读米兰达警告，并协助外国籍人士寻求警方服务。警方还在开发一套人工智能口译系统，以减轻处理外语紧急求助电话日益增加的负担。该系统可自动识别外语，并实时翻译警员与报案人之间的对话。然而，在该系统得到全面开发并投入使用之前，警方仍不得不依赖现有口译员，语言障碍也将继续困扰紧急响应行动……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Incidents involving Koreans in 10 nations under travel advisory rise 50%: data
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The number of accidents and incidents involving Korean nationals in 10 major countries under Seoul's travel advisory rose nearly 50 percent in 2025 from the previous year, data showed Sunday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 数据显示，2025年，在首尔发布旅行警示的10个主要国家中，涉及韩国公民的事故和意外事件数量较上一年上升近50%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The number of accidents and incidents involving Korean nationals in 10 major countries under Seoul's travel advisory rose nearly 50 percent in 2025 from the previous year, data showed Sunday. In the 10 countries for which Seoul issued travel advisories the most over the past five years, the cases of accidents and incidents involving Korean nationals came to 4,016 in 2025, up 48.3 percent from 2024, according to the data from the foreign ministry and the National Police Agency to Rep. Kim Joon-hwan of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea. The countries are Russia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Cambodia, Thailand, China, El Salvador, Mexico, Lebanon, Iran and Laos. Cases of losing contact saw the sharpest rise, increasing to 617 in 2025 from the previous year's 248, the data showed. Kidnapping and confinement more than doubled to 553 last year from 246 in 2024. Cases of suspected missing jumped nearly five times to 188 in 2025. By country, accidents and incidents involving Koreans increased the most in China, with such cases rising to 1,580 from the previous year's 1,133. In Cambodia, such cases rose 569 to 917 last year, accounting for 43.5 percent of the total on-year increase among the 10 countries, the latest findings showed. A police unit in Cambodia exclusively dedicated to crimes involving Koreans, known as the Korea desk, was launched last November in a bid to cope with rising crimes targeting Koreans, such as online scams. Eight Koreans have since been rescued and 107 nabbed in a joint crackdown on scam crimes in Cambodia
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 数据显示，旅行建议涉及10国韩国人的相关事件上升50%
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国政府周日公布的数据显示，2025年，在首尔发布旅行警告的10个主要国家中，涉及韩国公民的事故和意外事件数量较上一年上升近50%。据外交部向执政的韩国民主党的金峻焕议员提供的数据，过去5年首尔最多发布旅行警告的10个国家中，涉及韩国公民的事故和意外事件在2025年达到4,016起，较2024年的2,707起上升48.3%。这10个国家分别是俄罗斯、刚果民主共和国、柬埔寨、泰国、中国、萨尔瓦多、墨西哥、黎巴嫩、伊朗和老挝。数据显示，失去联系事件的增幅最大，2025年达到617起，上一年为248起。绑架和拘禁事件从2024年的246起增至去年的553起，增幅超过一倍。疑似失踪事件在2025年增至188起，增幅接近5倍。按国家划分，涉及韩国人的事故和意外事件在中国增幅最大，由上年的1,133起升至1,580起。最新调查结果显示，柬埔寨此类事件由569起增至917起，占这10个国家同比新增总数的43.5%。柬埔寨警方去年11月成立了一个专门处理涉韩国人犯罪的警察单位，称为“韩国组”，以应对针对韩国人的犯罪上升，如网络诈骗。此后，两国联合打击柬埔寨诈骗犯罪行动中已救出8名韩国人，并逮捕107名嫌疑人。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title: Major banks plan bigger cybersecurity budgets for 2027
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary: Emergency checks launched, affected services suspended over PHP security flaw Major Korean banks are preparing to raise their information security spending next year following a wave of suspected artificial intelligence (AI) agent-driven cyberattacks and data breaches across the financial sector, industry officials said Sunday. Alongside those spending plans, banks are checking their exposure to the PHP vulnerability.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary_zh: 启动紧急检查，因PHP安全漏洞暂停受影响服务。行业官员周日表示，在金融行业遭遇一波疑似由人工智能（AI）代理驱动的网络攻击和数据泄露后，韩国主要银行正准备明年提高信息安全支出。除了这些支出计划，各银行还在检查自身受PHP漏洞影响的程度。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: Emergency checks launched, affected services suspended over PHP security flaw Major Korean banks are preparing to raise their information security spending next year following a wave of suspected artificial intelligence (AI) agent-driven cyberattacks and data breaches across the financial sector, industry officials said Sunday. Some intend to commit at least 100 billion won ($75 million) each to bolstering cyber defenses. The lenders have also launched urgent inspections and taken certain services offline to address a recently disclosed security flaw in PHP, a programming language used to build applications that process requests on web servers, including user logins and online posts. Hana Bank aims to earmark more than 100 billion won for information security next year, an increase of more than 50 percent from this year. Priorities include developing AI-powered defenses against cyberattacks and hiring security specialists. NH NongHyup Bank is weighing a budget increase of around 20 percent, which would bring its spending to approximately 100 billion won. KB Kookmin Bank has already announced plans to set aside more than 100 billion won for security next year. At Woori Bank, the department overseeing information security is considering spending about 20 percent more on related systems. Shinhan Bank will draw up its budget in line with its medium-term information security strategy and allocate additional funds as needed. Alongside those spending plans, banks are checking their exposure to the PHP vulnerability. Disclosed on Wednesday, the flaw could enable attackers to execute commands on a server without authentication. If exploited, it could expose customer data or allow attackers to take control of a server. The Financial Security Institute responded that day by urging banks to check whether they use affected versions, install patches and examine their systems for evidence of a breach. Banks running outdated versions that no longer receive security updates were advised to switch to supported releases. Kookmin has completed security measures for two of five relevant services and will suspend the remaining three while addressing their vulnerabilities. It has also raised its security monitoring threat level. Woori has finished securing two relevant services accessible from outside the bank. Shinhan said its bankwide review did not uncover the flaw. Hana and NongHyup likewise reported no confirmed exposure among their relevant customer-facing services. “Information security teams are under intense pressure as they respond to the PHP flaw while continuing to deal with the AI hacking incidents,” a commercial bank official said. “Banks are maintaining the highest level of security monitoring around the clock.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title_zh: 大型银行计划为2027年增加网络安全预算
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body_zh: PHP安全漏洞引发紧急检查，多项服务暂停。行业官员周日表示，在金融业掀起疑似由人工智能（AI）代理发动的网络攻击和数据泄露潮后，韩国大型银行正准备明年增加信息安全支出。部分银行计划各自投入至少1000亿韩元（7500万美元），以加强网络防御。银行还启动紧急检查，并暂停某些服务，以处理最近披露的PHP安全漏洞。PHP是一种用于构建网络服务器应用程序的编程语言，这些应用程序可处理用户登录和在线发帖等请求。Hana Bank计划明年为信息安全划拨超过1000亿韩元，较今年增加逾50%。重点工作包括开发人工智能驱动的网络攻击防御措施，以及聘请安全专家。NH NongHyup Bank正在考虑将预算提高约20%，届时其支出将增至约1000亿韩元。KB Kookmin Bank已宣布计划明年为安全防护预留超过1000亿韩元。Woori Bank负责信息安全的部门正考虑将相关系统支出提高约20%。Shinhan Bank将依据其中期信息安全战略制定预算，并视需要拨付额外资金。在推进这些支出计划的同时，各银行正检查自身受PHP漏洞影响的程度。该漏洞于周三披露，可能使攻击者无需身份验证便能在服务器上执行命令。若遭到利用，攻击者可能泄露客户数据或控制服务器。Financial Security Institute当天回应，敦促银行检查是否使用受影响的版本、安装补丁，并审查系统是否存在入侵痕迹。仍在运行过时版本、已不再获得安全更新的银行被建议改用仍受支持的版本。Kookmin已完成五项相关服务中两项的安全措施，并将暂停其余三项服务，以修复相关漏洞。该行还提高了安全监控威胁等级。Woori已完成对两项可从银行外部访问的相关服务的安全加固。Shinhan表示，其全行审查未发现该漏洞。Hana和NongHyup也报告称，其面向客户的相关服务均未确认受到该漏洞影响。一名商业银行官员说：“信息安全团队正承受巨大压力，他们既要应对PHP漏洞，又要继续处理人工智能黑客事件。银行正全天候维持最高等级的安全监控。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title: Corporate watchdog chief calls for tougher penalties for obstructing investigations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary: Korea's antitrust chief on Sunday called for tougher financial penalties against companies that refuse to cooperate with investigations, following a recent dispute involving e-commerce giant Coupang. Ju Biung-ghi, chair of the Fair Trade Commission (FTC), said imposing fines equivalent to 1 percent of a company's total revenue for obstructing investigations would strengthen the watchdog's enforcement powers.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary_zh: 韩国反垄断负责人周日呼吁，对拒绝配合调查的企业施加更严厉的经济处罚。此前，电子商务巨头 Coupang 卷入了一场争端。公平交易委员会（FTC）主席朱秉吉表示，对妨碍调查的企业处以相当于其总收入1%的罚款，将加强该监管机构的执法权力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body: Korea's antitrust chief on Sunday called for tougher financial penalties against companies that refuse to cooperate with investigations, following a recent dispute involving e-commerce giant Coupang. Ju Biung-ghi, chair of the Fair Trade Commission (FTC), said imposing fines equivalent to 1 percent of a company's total revenue for obstructing investigations would strengthen the watchdog's enforcement powers. "Imposing a fine equivalent to 1 percent of a company's total revenue for refusing to cooperate with an investigation, rather than a slap on the wrist, would strengthen investigative powers and make law enforcement more effective," Ju said in an interview with public broadcaster KBS. Ju said the FTC's existing investigative authority was largely sufficient, but stressed the need for tougher penalties against companies that refuse to cooperate. While some laws enforced by the FTC allow financial penalties and criminal sanctions for obstructing investigations, the Act on Fair Transactions in Large Retail Business provides only for administrative fines. The legal limitation came to light after the FTC's on-site investigation into Coupang was thwarted in August. A court rejected Coupang's request to suspend the probe last month, prompting the company to appeal. Ju called for legal revisions to allow heavier financial penalties and enforcement fines in such cases
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title_zh: 企业监管机构负责人呼吁对妨碍调查行为施加更严厉处罚
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body_zh: 韩国反垄断负责人周日在电子商务巨头Coupang近期卷入的争端后，呼吁对拒绝配合调查的企业处以更严厉的经济处罚。公平交易委员会（FTC）主席朱丙羲表示，对阻碍调查的企业处以相当于其总营收1%的罚款，将加强该监管机构的执法权限。朱在接受公共 broadcaster KBS采访时说：“对拒绝配合调查的企业处以相当于其总营收1%的罚款，而非仅仅象征性处罚，将增强调查权限，使执法更加有效。”朱表示，FTC现有的调查权限基本充足，但强调有必要对拒绝配合的企业施加更严厉的处罚。尽管FTC执行的部分法律允许对阻碍调查行为处以经济处罚和刑事制裁，但《大型零售业公平交易法》仅规定可处以行政罚款。FTC于8月对Coupang进行现场调查受阻后，这一法律限制才显露出来。上个月，法院驳回了Coupang中止调查的请求，促使该公司提出上诉。朱呼吁修订法律，以便在此类案件中施加更重的经济处罚和执法罚款……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国交通部周日表示，鉴于旅行需求强劲，将在冬季增加国际客运航班，通往日本和中国的航班服务也将增多。自10月起，冬季期间共有264条航线连接44个国家，计划每周执飞5,353班国际航班。每周航班总量较去年冬季的4,973班增加7.6%，超过疫情前水平，2019年冬季为每周4,980班。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea will increase international passenger flights for the winter season, with more services to Japan and China amid strong travel demand, the transport ministry said Sunday. A total of 5,353 weekly international flights are scheduled on 264 routes connecting 44 countries during the winter season from Oct. 25 to March 27 of 2027, according to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国将在冬季扩大国际航班数量
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国交通部周日表示，鉴于出行需求旺盛，韩国将在冬季增加国际客运航班，通往日本和中国的航班服务将增多。据国土交通部消息，在2026年10月25日至2027年3月27日的冬季航季期间，计划每周安排5,353班国际航班，连接44个国家的264条航线。这些航班将由84家航空公司运营，其中包括11家韩国航空公司和73家外国航空公司。冬季每周航班总量较去年冬季航季的4,973班增长7.6%，超过疫情前2019年冬季航季4,980班的水平。航班扩容主要由新增通往日本和中国的服务推动，每周分别增加314班和232班，以满足强劲的入境和出境旅行需求

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: See you later, alligator
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: When I was younger, kids and young people in the USA often said good-bye with the phrase, “See you later, alligator.” The other person would reply, “In a while (or after a while), crocodile.” There was no meaning implied using the terms for the oft scary reptiles of folktales (such as Peter Pan) and wild animal shows. Korea has nothing comparable to “see you later, alligator.” At least, not that I’ve been able to discover. “See you later, alligator; in a while, crocodile” emerged as American slang in the 1950s.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 我年轻时，美国的孩子和年轻人常用“See you later, alligator”这句短语道别。对方则会回应：“In a while（或 after a while）, crocodile。”这些说法使用民间故事（如《彼得·潘》）和野生动物表演中常令人害怕的爬行动物名称，但本身并无特别含义。韩国没有与“see you later, alligator”类似的说法，至少就我所能发现的而言没有。“See you later, alligator; in a while, crocodile”是在20世纪50年代成为美国俚语的。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: When I was younger, kids and young people in the USA often said good-bye with the phrase, “See you later, alligator.” The other person would reply, “In a while (or after a while), crocodile.” There was no meaning implied using the terms for the oft scary reptiles of folktales (such as Peter Pan) and wild animal shows. Cultural differences emerged just the other day after a church fellowship meal, when I used the greeting with a young multicultural, English-fluent child. One of the Korean parishioners standing nearby called me out on my use of the term. He was worried the child might be scared or the parents may be offended. We launched into learning curves on all sides of the cultures in the room. The phrase is simply rhyming slang. There is no connection to reptiles. Playful greetings, sayings and plays-on-words exist in many cultures and languages. However, finding matches or similarities is sometimes impossible. Korea has nothing comparable to “see you later, alligator.” At least, not that I’ve been able to discover. I’ve interviewed dozens of people, young and old. I’ve consulted colloquial wisdom or proverb encyclopedias. I’ve come up empty. Therefore, my friend was shocked by the comment I made to the small child. The encounter stirred my curiosity, so I went on a hunt to find the origins of a farewell greeting that was set in my psyche from childhood. Not only did I find early rock group recordings, but I also found modern cartoon-like video songs for children. “See you later, alligator; in a while, crocodile” emerged as American slang in the 1950s. It’s no surprise that teenagers are usually the creators of slang expressions. This is still true today with the various shorthand ways youngsters use in their text messages, as well as other expressions. I recall some phrases and words used during my high school years, that when used among youngsters today, quickly reveal how old I must be. Some of the earliest recorded sources for alligator and crocodile goodbye greetings come from various newspapers in the United States, beginning with a column in the Franklin (Louisiana) Banner-Tribune newspaper in December 1951. Other reports followed in newspapers across the country. The phrase crops up in Honolulu, Washington, D.C., Los Angeles, Seattle. Not only was the reporting widespread, but the use by youngsters also spread like wildfire. According to a Honolulu Star-Bulletin report on May 1, 1952, high schoolers in Hawaii were also using some other unique expressions. These included “toodle-oo tofu” and “so long, dai-kong,” reflecting the multicultural heritage of the island territory and the many immigrants who settled there mainly as farmers in the early 20th century. By the mid-1950s, and many times since, various musicians picked up the phrase in their songs. Bobby Charles (Robert Charles Guidry), a Louisiana musician, recorded his version of a song, “Later, Alligator” late in 1955. Guidry was a Cajun musician, and his music reflects a New Orleans blues-style. A few weeks later, Bill Haley & His Comets recorded their rock 'n' roll version, which reached No. 6 on the U.S. Billboard Charts early in 1956. Their recording popularized the expressions (alligator and crocodile) throughout much of the English-speaking world, and even in several European countries. Rock 'n' roll music was sweeping the globe, and teenage slang became almost universal. Since then, Haley’s version, has appeared in musicals, film, television and album collections recorded by dozens of artists, including Sha Na Na, Bob Dylan and Ringo Starr. Perhaps one of the most prolific and well-loved children’s books authors to make full use of rhyming was “Dr. Seuss.” Who can forget “The cat in the hat,” “Green eggs and ham” or “One fish, two fish, red fish, blue fish.” Some of his books were political satire, others were directed to a mature audience. My family had a large collection of his books that my siblings and I grew up on. We split up the collection when we each started having families of our own, and my books were passed on to my son and now my grandchildren. Playful rhyming expressions can be fun. I find with children that these kinds of rhymes can help develop their creative thinking. By encouraging them to think about other common words that might fit this simple poetic pattern, children can expand their vocabulary and conversational abilities. Cross-cultural and multilanguage opportunities can be sources of great conversational fun and a way to gain appreciation for one another. Rev. Steven L. Shields, FRAS (slshields@gmail.com) has lived in Korea for many years, beginning in the 1970s. A fellow of the Royal Asiatic Society of Great Britain and Ireland, he is also a life member of the Royal Asiatic Society of Korea, of which he was a director, vice president and president. He was a copy editor of The Korea Times in 1977. The views expressed in this column are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect The Korea Times’ editorial stance.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 我年轻时，美国的孩子和年轻人经常用“See you later, alligator”这句话道别。对方则会回应：“In a while (or after a while), crocodile.” 这里使用这些经常令人害怕的爬行动物名称，并不暗含任何含义；它们只出现在民间故事（如《彼得·潘》）和野生动物表演中。就在前几天，一次教会团契聚餐后，我用这句问候语向一个能说英语的多元文化背景孩子打招呼， cultural differences（文化差异）便显露出来。站在旁边的一位韩国教友指出我用了这个词，担心孩子可能会被吓到，或其父母可能会觉得受到冒犯。于是，我们开始从房间内各种文化背景出发，互相学习。这句话不过是一句押韵俚语，与爬行动物毫无关系。许多文化和语言中都有俏皮的问候语、俗语和双关表达。然而，有时要找到对应说法或相似之处并不容易。韩国没有与“see you later, alligator”类似的表达。至少，以我所能查到的资料来看并不存在。我采访过数十位年轻人和老年人，也查阅过口语智慧或谚语百科全书，却始终没有找到。因此，我的朋友听到我对那个小孩说的话时十分震惊。这次经历激起了我的好奇心，于是我开始探寻这句自童年起便铭刻于我心里的告别语的起源。我不仅找到了早期摇滚组合的录音，还找到了现代儿童动画风视频歌曲。“See you later, alligator; in a while, crocodile”在20世纪50年代成为美国俚语。青少年通常是俚语表达的开创者，这并不令人意外。如今，年轻人仍会在短信中使用各种简写方式及其他表达，青少年创造俚语的传统依然延续至今。我还记得高中时代用过的一些短语和词语，如今若在年轻人之间使用，会立刻暴露我有多老了。关于使用alligator和crocodile道别的最早有记录来源，可以追溯到美国各地的报纸，最早的一篇是1951年12月《Franklin (Louisiana) Banner-Tribune》的一篇专栏。随后，全国各地的报纸也纷纷报道。这句话在Honolulu、Washington, D.C.、Los Angeles和Seattle等地接连出现。相关报道不仅范围广泛，年轻人对它的使用也像野火般迅速蔓延。根据1952年5月1日《Honolulu Star-Bulletin》的一篇报道，夏威夷的高中生当时还在使用其他一些独特表达，包括“toodle-oo tofu”和“so long, dai-kong”，反映了该岛屿领地的多元文化传承，以及许多主要在20世纪初以农民身份定居于此的移民群体。到了20世纪50年代中期，此后也有许多次，多位音乐人将这句话写入自己的歌曲。路易斯安那州音乐人Bobby Charles（Robert Charles Guidry）于1955年末录制了自己演唱的歌曲《Later, Alligator》。Guidry是一名卡津音乐人，他的音乐带有New Orleans布鲁斯风格。几周后，Bill Haley & His Comets录制了他们的摇滚版本，该歌曲于1956年初登上美国Billboard排行榜第6位。他们的录音使alligator和crocodile这两个表达在整个英语世界乃至多个欧洲国家广为流传。摇滚乐风靡全球，青少年俚语也几乎成为全球通用语。从那以后，Haley的版本出现在音乐剧、电影、电视节目以及数十位艺人录制的专辑中，其中包括Sha Na Na、Bob Dylan和Ringo Starr。或许最常使用押韵手法且最受喜爱的儿童文学作家之一就是“Dr. Seuss”。谁能忘记《The cat in the hat》、《Green eggs and ham》或《One fish, two fish, red fish, blue fish》呢？他的一些书是政治讽刺作品，另一些则面向较为成熟的读者。我和兄弟姐妹小时候一起读过他的大量著作。我们各自成家后便把藏书分开，我的那些书后来传给了儿子，如今又传给了我的孙辈。俏皮的押韵表达可以很有趣。我发现，这类韵句能帮助孩子发展创造性思维。通过鼓励孩子思考其他可能契合这种简单诗歌节奏的常用词，孩子可以拓展词汇量和交谈能力。跨文化和多语言环境可以成为交流乐趣的重要来源，也有助于增进彼此的理解。Rev. Steven L. Shields，FRAS（slshields@gmail.com）在韩国生活多年，自20世纪70年代起便开始在那里生活。他是英国与爱尔兰皇家亚洲学会会员，也是韩国皇家亚洲学会终身会员，曾担任该学会的理事、副会长和会长。1977年，他曾任《The Korea Times》副编辑。本专栏表达的观点仅代表作者本人，不一定反映《The Korea Times》的编辑立场。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The fiscal balance of Korea's national health insurance for foreigners posted a surplus exceeding 1 trillion won ($753 million) for the first time last year, but the account for Chinese nationals swung to a deficit, data showed Sunday. Jeon Jin-sook of the ruling party.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 数据显示，韩国面向外国人的国民健康保险财政收支去年首次实现超过1万亿韩元（7.53亿美元）的盈余，但中国公民参保账户转为赤字。韩国国民健康保险公团（NHIS）向执政党议员全仁淑提交的数据显示，去年外国人的财政收支盈余达到1,012.8万亿韩元，高于上一年的943.9亿韩元。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The fiscal balance of Korea's national health insurance for foreigners posted a surplus exceeding 1 trillion won ($753 million) for the first time last year, but the account for Chinese nationals swung to a deficit, data showed Sunday. The fiscal balance for foreign nationals came to 1,012.8 trillion won in the black last year, up from 943.9 billion won the previous year, according to data submitted by the National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) to Rep. Jeon Jin-sook of the ruling party. Insurance premium paid by foreign nationals totaled 2.54 trillion won, while medical expenses covered by the NHIS stood at 1.52 trillion won. It marked the first time that the health insurance fiscal balance for foreigners posted a surplus topping 1 trillion won. It also represented the consecutive surplus streak since 2017. But the fiscal balance for Chinese nationals logged a deficit of 40.9 billion won last year, turning from a surplus of 5.5 billion won in the previous year. In 2025, insurance premiums collected from Chinese people totaled 956.4 billion won, while payouts shouldered by the NHIS for medical treatment reached 997.3 billion won, the data showed. The health insurance account for Chinese posted a deficit for the seventh straight year in 2017 before swinging to a surplus in 2024. By country, the fiscal balance for Vietnam logged the largest surplus of 160.1 billion won last year, followed by Nepal with 126.2 billion won and Indonesia with 91.8 billion won. The Korean government has been strengthening measures to plug financial leaks in the foreign health insurance system. Since April 2024, foreign nationals and overseas Koreans have been required to reside in Korea for at least six months if they were to be registered as dependents of employee-based policyholders. The deficit in the Chinese account could prompt opposition lawmakers to renew their call to introduce "reciprocity" in the foreign national health insurance. They argue Korea should restrict foreign nationals' insurance eligibility and coverage benefits commensurate with health insurance benefits provided to Korean nationals by their home countries
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 去年国家医疗保险对外国人的财政余额盈余超过7.53亿美元
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国国民健康保险外国人财政收支去年首次实现超过1万亿韩元（7.53亿美元）的盈余，但数据显示，中国籍参保人的账户转为赤字。据国民健康保险服务公团（NHIS）向执政党议员全진淑提交的数据，外国人财政收支去年实现1,012.8万亿韩元盈余，高于上年的943.9亿韩元。外国人缴纳的保险费总额为2.54万亿韩元，NHIS承担的医疗费用为1.52万亿韩元。这是外国人健康保险财政收支首次录得超过1万亿韩元的盈余，也延续了自2017年以来的连续盈余。但中国籍参保人的财政收支去年出现409亿韩元赤字，而上一年为55亿韩元盈余。数据显示，2025年向中国人征收的保险费总额为956.4亿韩元，NHIS承担的医疗费用达997.3亿韩元。中国参保账户在2017年连续第7年出现赤字，随后于2024年转为盈余。按国家划分，越南财政收支去年录得最大盈余，达1,601亿韩元，其次是尼泊尔的1,262亿韩元和印度尼西亚的918亿韩元。韩国政府一直在加强措施，堵住外国人健康保险体系的财务漏洞。自2024年4月起，外国人和旅外韩国人须在韩国居住至少6个月，方可登记为职工参保人的家属。中国账户的赤字可能促使反对党议员再次呼吁在外国人健康保险中实行“互惠”。他们主张，韩国应根据外国人在本国为韩国人提供的健康保险福利，对外国人的保险资格和保障范围作出相应限制

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Chungnam National University holds town hall on future development plans
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Chungnam National University held a town hall meeting on Friday to discuss its future development, including a proposed merger with another national university. The university said the meeting was organized to build consensus on major issues and future development plans, including a proposed merger with Kongju National University.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 忠南国立大学周五举行市民大会，讨论学校的未来发展，包括拟与另一所国立大学合并。该大学表示，此次会议旨在就重大问题和未来发展规划形成共识，其中包括拟与公州国立大学合并。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Chungnam National University held a town hall meeting on Friday to discuss its future development, including a proposed merger with another national university. About 250 people, including faculty members, staff, teaching assistants, students and alumni, attended the meeting at Baekma Hall of the university’s Jeongsimhwa International Cultural Center. The university said the meeting was organized to build consensus on major issues and future development plans, including a proposed merger with Kongju National University. Participants also discussed the Glocal University Project and a support package for flagship national universities, sharing their views on the university’s future. The two-hour meeting began with opening remarks by President Kim Jeong-kyoum, followed by a presentation on the university’s future direction by Kim Young-guk, vice president for external affairs. “The meeting provided a forum for university members to better understand the key issues facing Chungnam National University, discuss its future direction and share their views,” President Kim said. Representatives of various university groups and other attendees then shared their views in an open discussion. The university said the meeting was intended to foster mutual understanding among its members and lay the groundwork for its future growth
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 忠南大学举行市民大会，讨论未来发展规划
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 忠南大学周五举行市民集会，讨论学校未来发展，其中包括与另一所国立大学合并的提议。约250人参加了会议，其中包括教职员工、教学助理、学生和校友。会议在该校贞_simhwa国际文化中心的白马礼堂举行。忠南大学表示，此次会议旨在就重大议题和未来发展规划凝聚共识，其中包括与公州国立大学合并的提议。与会者还讨论了全球本地化大学项目以及支持国立重点大学的一揽子计划，并就学校的未来分享了各自看法。历时两小时的会议以校长金正utyouм开幕致辞开始，随后由负责外事事务的副校长金永国介绍了学校未来发展方向。金正utyouм校长说：“此次会议为大学成员提供了一个平台，使其能够更好地了解忠南大学面临的关键议题，讨论学校的未来方向，并分享各自看法。”随后，各个大学团体的代表及其他与会者在开放讨论中分享了意见。忠南大学表示，此次会议旨在促进成员之间的相互理解，并为学校未来发展奠定基础

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Why Nepal's glacial lakes demand Indian action
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: Nepal’s ambitious six-year plan to drain four high-altitude glacial lakes — Thulagi, Lower Barun, Lumding Tsho and Hongu-2 — is born of sheer urgency. The current project addresses only four of Nepal's 21 highly dangerous glacial lakes, leaving the exact valley that experienced flooding in August completely untouched. The 1954 Koshi Agreement remains a point of friction in Nepal, and any unilateral Indian offer to plant equipment in Nepali mountains will be viewed with skepticism.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 尼泊尔雄心勃勃的六年计划，旨在排干四座高海拔冰川湖——图拉吉湖、下巴伦湖、卢姆丁措湖和洪古-2湖——其出台完全出于紧迫形势。当前项目仅处理尼泊尔21座高度危险冰川湖中的4座，对今年8月发生洪灾的那条山谷完全不涉及。1954年《戈西协定》至今仍是尼泊尔的一处摩擦点，印度任何单方面提出在尼泊尔山地安装设备的提议，都会遭到怀疑。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: Nepal’s ambitious six-year plan to drain four high-altitude glacial lakes — Thulagi, Lower Barun, Lumding Tsho and Hongu-2 — is born of sheer urgency. Following a catastrophic flood along the China-Nepal border that left more than 1,450 dead and thousands missing, Kathmandu is scrambling to mitigate future disasters. New Delhi cannot afford to view this as a purely domestic Nepali affair. For India, providing immediate technical support, data sharing and early warning systems to Nepal is proactive flood defense for its own northern plains. The catastrophic August deluge surged from the Lhende Khola into the Bhote Koshi, then wound through the Trishuli and Narayani rivers before crossing into India as the Gandak river to join the Ganga. The primary threat is rarely a sudden wall of water but rather an acute, destabilizing volume surge delivered to rivers already swollen by monsoons and hemmed in by fragile embankments. The 2008 Koshi embankment breach at Kusaha permanently altered the river's course, displacing over 2.3 million people in northern Bihar. The current project addresses only four of Nepal's 21 highly dangerous glacial lakes, leaving the exact valley that experienced flooding in August completely untouched. Where engineering fails, technology must step in. When the August collapse occurred, seismic instruments registered the shockwave as a magnitude 5.2 event. Linked to automated alerts, such data can buy downstream communities precious minutes — provided the monitoring systems are properly maintained. However, technology requires infrastructure and upkeep. Automated monitoring stations, lake-level sensors and satellite feeds are remarkably inexpensive when measured against the catastrophic cost of a breached levee. Facing a $5 billion recovery bill, Nepal cannot secure its mountains alone, but India is noticeably absent from the project's current list of financial backers. This is a missed diplomatic and security opportunity. India already possesses world-class satellite arrays, meteorological assets and a Central Water Commission that tracks these very river systems. Sharing this existing data costs New Delhi virtually nothing. The 1954 Koshi Agreement remains a point of friction in Nepal, and any unilateral Indian offer to plant equipment in Nepali mountains will be viewed with skepticism. New Delhi should route its cooperation through multilateral bodies like the UN Development Programme and the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development, the Kathmandu-based mountain center where India holds a seat. By ensuring data flows symmetrically and leaving station ownership with Nepal, India can build trust. South Korea knows what an unwarned flood looks like. In 2009, North Korea released water from the Hwanggang Dam without notice, and six South Koreans were swept away in the resulting flooding on the Imjin River. Seoul has an interest here beyond sympathy. The Green Climate Fund is based in Incheon, the Korea International Cooperation Agency runs aid programs in Nepal and thousands of Nepali workers live in Korea. Sensors and gauges would be cheap, and Seoul's own experience with an upstream neighbor gives it standing to press for data sharing. Early warning cooperation is a rare geopolitical arena where one nation's gain does not equal another's loss. During the August disaster, the river gauge at Syabrubesi went offline within minutes of the glacial collapse. A sensor's sudden silence is a loud distress signal — but only if someone downstream is listening. India's major rivers begin in foreign peaks; its domestic security is hostage to what happens in those mountains and how fast that information reaches Delhi and Patna. The next deluge will not pause at the border. The only remaining question is whether India chooses to hear it coming. Brabim Karki is a businessman and writer based in Nepal. The views here are his own
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 尼泊尔的冰川湖泊为何要求印度采取行动
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 尼泊尔雄心勃勃的六年计划，旨在排干四座高海拔冰川湖——图拉吉、下巴伦、林丁措和洪古-2——其背后是极其紧迫的现实需求。中国与尼泊尔边境沿线发生灾难性洪灾，造成1,450多人死亡、数千人失踪后，加德满都正加紧采取措施，防止未来灾难重演。新德里不能把这看作纯粹属于尼泊尔的内政。对印度而言，立即向尼泊尔提供技术支援、共享数据并建立预警系统，是针对印度北部平原的主动防洪措施。8月发生的灾难性洪灾从伦德河汇入波忒科西河，随后流经特里舒利河和纳拉亚尼河，进入印度后改称甘达克河，最终汇入恒河。主要威胁很少是突然出现的水墙，而是大量水流在短时间内急剧涌入已经因季风而水位上涨、又受到脆弱堤岸约束的河流。2008年，Kusaha的科西河堤坝决口，永久改变了河道走向，导致印度比哈尔邦北部230多万人流离失所。当前项目只处理尼泊尔21座高度危险冰川湖中的4座，8月发生洪灾的山谷完全未被纳入其中。工程手段失效之处，必须由技术手段介入。8月山体崩塌时，地震仪器记录到冲击波，震级为5.2级。此类数据若与自动预警系统相连接，可以为下游社区争取宝贵的几分钟时间——前提是监测系统得到妥善维护。然而，技术需要基础设施和持续维护。与堤坝决口造成的灾难性代价相比，自动监测站、湖泊水位传感器和卫星数据源的成本低得惊人。面临50亿美元的灾后重建账单，尼泊尔无法独自守护其山区，但印度显然没有出现在该项目的现有出资方名单中。这是一个错失的外交与安全机会。印度已经拥有世界一流的卫星阵列、气象监测设备和中央水委员会，后者一直在追踪这些河流系统。共享这些现有数据，几乎不会给新德里增加任何成本。1954年《科西协定》至今仍是尼泊尔与印度之间的一处摩擦点，印度若单方面提出在尼泊尔山区安装设备，必会受到质疑。新德里应通过联合国开发计划署和国际山地综合开发中心等多边机构推进合作；该山地中心总部位于加德满都，印度在其中占有席位。只要确保数据双向流动，并将监测站所有权留给尼泊尔，印度就能建立信任。韩国深知在毫无预警的情况下发生洪水意味着什么。2009年，朝鲜未经通知便从华阳川水库放水，南韩6人在随后发生于임진河的洪水中被冲走。首尔对此并非仅仅出于同情。绿色气候基金总部设在仁川，韩国国际合作机构在尼泊尔实施援助项目，数千名尼泊尔劳工居住在韩国。传感器和测量设备的成本很低，而首尔自身与上游邻国交涉的经验，也使其有充分理由推动数据共享。预警合作是少有的地缘政治领域，在这里，一个国家的收益并不意味着另一个国家的损失。8月灾难发生期间，萨布鲁贝西河的水位计在冰川崩塌后数分钟内便停止传输数据。传感器突然陷入沉默，是响亮的求救信号——但前提是下游有人 listens。印度的主要河流发源于境外群山；其国内安全取决于那些山区发生什么，以及相关信息能以多快的速度传抵德里和巴特那。下一场洪灾不会在边境线前停下。唯一悬而未决的问题是，印度是否愿意听见它正在到来。布拉比姆·卡尔基是一名常驻尼泊尔的商人和作家。本文观点仅代表他本人。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Lotte Group stepped up efforts to recruit local talent in Vietnam with a three-day campus recruitment event in Hanoi that drew more than 3,000 job seekers, the retailer said Sunday. The group held its 2026 Lotte Global Campus Recruiting in Vietnam for three days starting Wednesday at five universities in the Vietnamese capital, including Vietnam National University and Hanoi University of Science and Technology. Six Lotte affiliates operating in Vietnam — Lotte Department Store, Lotte Hotel, Lotte World, Lotte Innovate, Lotte Property & Development and Daehong Communications — took part in the event, offering recruitment briefings, career consultations and one-on-one mock interviews. Recruiters and current employees introduced their companies and job openings. They also shared practical advice on the application process and their work experiences. The universities were selected based on each affiliate’s hiring needs and the academic disciplines offered by the institutions. Lotte currently employs more than 10,000 local workers in Vietnam and plans to hire around 500 additional employees this year, up 20 percent from 2025, according to the group. The recruitment drive is part of Lotte’s effort to strengthen its employer brand in overseas markets. Since last year, the group has organized diverse global job fairs and campus recruiting programs to connect with local candidates, as its international businesses grow. Lotte plans to hold a similar recruitment event in Indonesia, another key overseas market, following the Vietnam program. “Lotte is considered one of the Korean companies that Vietnamese job seekers want to work for,” said Nguyen Thi Linh, a student at Vietnam National University who attended the event for the second consecutive year. She said she had been interested in the group and wanted to learn more about its career opportunities. A Lotte official said attracting global workers requires communicating the group’s business strengths and career development opportunities to candidates overseas. “We will continue to expand our engagement with local talent and strengthen our recruitment brand to become an employer of choice for global candidates,” the official said

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 乐天集团周日表示，该集团加大在越南招募本地人才力度，于河内舉辦為期三天的校园招聘会，吸引超过3,000名求职者。集团自周三起在越南首都的5所大学舉辦2026乐天全球校园招募活动，包括越南国家大学和河内理工大学。活动共有6家在越南运营的乐天关联公司参与，分别为乐天百货、乐天酒店、乐天世界、乐天创新、乐天不动产与开发以及Daehong Communications。公司提供招聘说明、职业咨询和一对一模拟面试。招聘人员和现任员工介绍了各自公司和职位空缺，还分享了申请流程的实用建议及工作经验。各大学是根据每家关联公司的招聘需求以及院校开设的学科而选定。据该集团介绍，乐天目前在越南雇用了超过10,000名当地员工，并计划今年增聘约500人，比2025年增长20%。此次招聘是乐天加强其在海外市场雇主品牌建设的一部分。自去年以来，随着国际业务不断增长，该集团已举办多场全球招聘会和校园招募项目，与当地候选人建立联系。继越南项目之后，乐天计划在另一个重要海外市场印度尼西亚舉辦类似招聘活动。连续第二年参加活动的越南国家大学学生Nguyen Thi Linh表示：“乐天被视为越南求职者希望加入的韩国企业之一。”她说，自己一直对该集团感兴趣，希望进一步了解其职业发展机会。一名乐天官员表示，吸引全球人才需要向海外候选人宣传集团的业务优势及职业发展机会。该官员说：“我们将继续深化与本地人才的联系，加强招聘品牌建设，成为全球候选人的首选雇主。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung is mulling over selecting a justice minister nominee from between two prosecutor-turned-lawmakers after his previous pick for the post withdrew his candidacy last month over lobbying allegations, a source at the presidential office said Sunday. Rep. Park Kyoon-taek and Rep. Yang Bu-nam of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) are the candidates that Lee is reviewing for justice minister, a source at Cheong Wa Dae told Yonhap News Agency. "After a lengthy deliberation, Lee is reviewing the choice between Park and Yang. An official nomination is expected to be made soon," the source said. In a Cabinet reshuffle in late August, Lee nominated Rep. Kim Seung-won of the DPK to lead the justice ministry. A parliamentary confirmation hearing was held last month, but Kim withdrew his candidacy amid controversy over various allegations, including lobbying for a COVID-19 treatment drug. Amid a two-month vacancy in the justice minister post, Lee is believed to be carefully reviewing the nomination while considering public sentiment. Park and Yang, both first-term lawmakers in the DPK's stronghold in the southwestern Honam region, formerly served as prosecutors. Park is among a group of DPK lawmakers calling for dropping Lee's criminal indictments, claiming they were brought by politically motivated prosecutors. Yang was appointed a co-chief of the party's legal affairs committee in 2022, when Lee was the head of the DPK, to manage Lee's legal issues

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Montana's plan to curb election spending
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: This fall, Montana voters will have a chance to approve what’s known as the “Montana Plan,” a novel ballot initiative that would redefine corporate powers in our state. If the ballot measure passes, spending money in Montana elections will no longer be one of those granted powers. The Montana Plan ballot initiative would prohibit electoral spending by corporations across the board, from the state’s chamber of commerce and labor unions, to out-of-state and in-state companies, to all varieties of nonprofits.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 今年秋季，蒙大拿州选民将有机会表决批准一项被称为“蒙大拿计划”的新型公投提案，该提案将重新界定本州企业的权利。如果这项公投提案获得通过，在蒙大拿州选举中花费资金将不再是企业享有的权利之一。“蒙大拿计划”公投提案将全面禁止企业进行选举支出，包括州商会、工会、外州企业和本州企业，以及各种非营利组织。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: One of the greatest frustrations I had during my 18 years representing the great state of Montana in the U.S. Senate was watching, in real time, the ever-increasing flood of corporate money poison our political discourse. Washington couldn’t — or wouldn’t — fix the problem unleashed by the Supreme Court’s 2010 decision in Citizens United, which allowed unlimited independent spending on elections by corporations and unions on free speech grounds. But now there’s a quiet revolution happening in the states that could finally take corporate money out of politics. And I’m proud that my home state is helping lead the way. This fall, Montana voters will have a chance to approve what’s known as the “Montana Plan,” a novel ballot initiative that would redefine corporate powers in our state. It’s based on a simple premise: The state has always had the authority to dictate a corporation’s powers, and it has the authority to change them. If the ballot measure passes, spending money in Montana elections will no longer be one of those granted powers. The Montana Plan ballot initiative would prohibit electoral spending by corporations across the board, from the state’s chamber of commerce and labor unions, to out-of-state and in-state companies, to all varieties of nonprofits. No person will be forced to give up any of their First Amendment rights; every Montanan will be able to speak, publish, give, organize, and vote. All that will change is that corporations will get a little less powerful. Enactment of this measure is not precluded by Citizens United. That ruling considered what restrictions the government may place on corporations that already hold the power to spend in elections. But it never held that a state must grant corporations the power to spend in the first place. No court ever has. This plan, first envisioned by the think tank Center for American Progress, is such a good idea that it has since sprouted elsewhere while it takes root in Montana. Hawaii legislators were so inspired by what we were doing that they passed their own version into law in May, with bipartisan support. Nineteen other state legislatures took up versions of the bill this year. (The Hawaiian bill will not take effect until July 2027, while the Montana Plan, if passed, would be effective on Jan. 1.) Looking back, I spent much of my Senate career trying to stem the torrent of corporate money in politics. This included writing the Spotlight Act requiring exempt organizations like unions and some nonprofits to disclose all substantial contributors, backing the DISCLOSE Act to rein in campaign spending, and supporting a constitutional amendment to overturn Citizens United directly. But, in each case, the profusion of cash always won. It’s incredibly satisfying to see a real solution now arising in the states. Passing this ballot initiative on Nov. 3 would, in many ways, return to the ideals that Montana held for a century before the Citizens United ruling. In 1912, at a time when my grandparents were homesteading their Montana farm, the state passed the Corrupt Practices Act, which imposed limits on corporate money in politics, usurping the ability of the state’s powerful copper industry to buy off legislators, judges and newspapers. In short, Montana cleaned up its own politics without waiting for Washington, D.C., to act or a court to grant permission. The current Montana Plan is built of even sturdier stuff, using a tool only Montanans can wield: amending our state’s laws to give corporations the powers we decide they should have. If we decide to no longer grant corporations the power to overwhelm our politics, that’s our decision to make. Former Sen. Jon Tester represented Montana in the U.S. Senate from 2007 to 2025. This column was produced for Progressive Perspectives, a project of The Progressive magazine, and distributed by Tribune Content Agency
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 蒙大拿州遏制选举支出的计划
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 在我代表美国蒙大拿州参加联邦参议院议员的18年间，我最大的 frustration 之一，就是眼看着企业资金如洪水般不断涌入，污染我们的政治 discourse。华盛顿无力——或者不愿——解决最高法院2010年在“公民联合会”案（Citizens United）中引发的难题。该判决以言论自由为由，允许企业和工会为选举进行无限额的独立支出。但如今，各州正在发生一场安静的革命，可能终于能让企业资金退出政治。我很自豪，我的家乡州正在引领这一进程。今年秋季，蒙大拿州选民将有机会投票批准所谓的“蒙大拿计划”，这是一项新颖的 ballot initiative，将重新界定企业在我国的权力。它基于一个简单前提：州政府一直有权决定企业拥有哪些权力，也有权改变这些权力。如果这项投票提案获得通过，在蒙大拿州选举中花费资金将不再属于企业获得的权力。“蒙大拿计划”投票提案将全面禁止企业和工会在选举中的支出，包括州商会、工会、外州企业和本州企业，以及各种非营利组织。任何人的《第一修正案》权利都不会因此受到强迫；每一位蒙大拿州居民都可以发表言论、出版、捐款、组织和投票。唯一改变的是，企业的权力将会略微削弱。“公民联合会”案并未排除实施这项措施。该判决审视的是政府可以对已经拥有选举支出权的企业施加哪些限制，但它从未认定州政府必须首先赋予企业支出权。从未有任何法院这样认定。这项计划最初由智库美国进步中心提出，是一个如此出色的创意，以至于在蒙大拿州扎根的同时，如今也已延伸到其他地方。夏威夷州立法者深受我们所作举措鼓舞，于5月在两党支持下通过了自己版本的这项法律。今年另有19个州议会审议了该法案的各个版本。（夏威夷州法案要到2027年7月才会生效，而“蒙大拿计划”如获通过，将于1月1日生效。）回顾过去，我在参议院的大部分职业生涯都在努力遏制企业资金涌入政治的洪流。这包括起草《聚光灯法案》，要求工会等免税组织和某些非营利组织披露所有大额捐助者；支持《披露法案》，以约束竞选支出；以及支持通过宪法修正案，直接推翻“公民联合会”案。但每一次，铺天盖地的现金总是胜出。如今，看到各州真正出现解决方案，令人无比欣慰。在11月3日通过这项投票提案，将在许多方面让蒙大拿州回到“公民联合会”案判决之前一个世纪所秉持的理想。1912年，也就是我的祖父母在蒙大拿州拓荒经营农场的时候，该州通过了《廉政实践法》，对政治中的企业资金设置限制，遏制了当地实力雄厚的铜业行业通过收买立法者、法官和报纸来影响政治的能力。简言之，蒙大拿州不等候华盛顿特区采取行动，也不等法院给予许可，就自行整顿了本地政治。当前的“蒙大拿计划”以更加坚固的基础构建而成，采用一种只有蒙大拿州居民才能运用的工具：修改州法律，决定企业应当拥有哪些权力。如果我们决定不再赋予企业压倒我们政治的力量，这就是应由我们作出的决定。前参议员乔恩·特斯特于2007年至2025年代表蒙大拿州出任美国联邦参议员。本专栏为《Progressive》杂志旗下“进步视角”项目制作，并由Tribune Content Agency分发

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: Hetbahn向美国和欧洲出口，在先进Jincheon工厂生产。位于忠清北道JINCHEON的CJ CheilJedang于1996年以Hetbahn品牌推出韩国首个可用微波炉加热的蒸饭碗，此后一直主导市场。该公司正加快出口，以推动全球消费者采用更健康的饮食。作为全球扩张的一部分，CJ CheilJedang将米饭定位为比面包更好的碳水化合物。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Hetbahn for US, Europe on pipeline at advanced Jincheon plant JINCHEON, North Chungcheong Province — CJ CheilJedang, which introduced the country’s first microwavable steamed rice bowls under the Hetbahn brand in 1996 and has dominated the market since, is accelerating exports to promote healthier diets for global consumers. CJ CheilJedang is positioning rice as a “better carbohydrate” compared to bread as part of its global expansion. The company cited global market research agency Mintel, which said 34.6 percent of American consumers who purchase rice see it as a “healthier option” and use it not only for Asian cuisines like fried rice or sushi but also for Western dishes like chicken, steak, burritos or rice bowls. The share of people in the country who ate rice at least once a week rose to 45 per cent last year, up from 37 per cent in 2023. “Of course there are other rice exporters to the U.S. right now. But we possess better quality and convenience than them. Ours come in microwavable bowls and short grain. The variety is now expanding," Jin Kim, the company's global chief marketing officer, said Wednesday. "The others, on the other hand, come in a pouch and still need a pot to cook them. Our quality and technologies, they haven’t reached yet." She added, “But our period of exports to the U.S. hasn’t been long enough. While our market share there is now 11.9 percent, Ben’s Original takes up about 45 percent.” CheilJedang said it has targeted the U.S. as a primary global market for now because local consumers have become very familiar with rice and the country’s market for processed foods is second to none in the world. “American consumers, contrary to my initial thought, have developed a keen taste for rice. They know differences between different brands and know what good quality rice tastes like,” said Oh Ye-jin, food research and development master at the company. Kim added, “The U.S., unlike Asian countries where rice is a main ingredient on food tables, has a high acceptance for imported food ingredients. Their produced foods market has already entered a mature stage.” CheilJedang now owns 16 U.S. manufacturing plants of Schwan’s, an American food company it acquired in 2019. Kim said that if the needs in the U.S. rise to a level unsustainable by CheilJedang’s rice export base in Busan, it is possible some of the Schwan’s plants will be upgraded to locally produce Hetbahn. Hetbahn, produced at the company’s largest plant in Jincheon, North Chungcheong Province, last year posted sales of 1.18 trillion won ($892 million) overall, 15 percent of which were in overseas markets. The figure has risen every year since 2021, when sales reached 790 billion won, with exports accounting for 8 percent. Hetbahn’s rising popularity contributed to CheilJedang’s overall sales. Between 2001 and 2025, sales jumped 18 times, last year peaking at 5.2 trillion won. The Jincheon plant, known as CJ Blossom Campus, was completed in 2018 following a 1 trillion won investment. It features aseptic packaged rice manufacturing technology that the company says is as complex as semiconductor foundry technology. Automation facilitates the entire process from packaging to logistics, rice cooking and bowl making, enabling the plant to produce 280 million Hetbahn bowls per year. With another factory in Busan, the company’s production capacity is 700 million units annually. The company holds 267 patents for the production technologies behind Hetbahn. CheilJedang is pushing forward with Hetbahn despite falling rice consumption here, increasing supply contract volume with farmers. Last year, the company bought 65,000 tons of domestic rice, more than triple the amount from a decade ago. Over the past 30 years, Hetbahn used 43 million bags of supplied rice, equivalent to 860,000 trucks loading 1 ton
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: CJ CheilJedang蒸制糯米饭，推动全球扩张
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh:
美国和欧洲市场对Hetbahn需求上升，先进 Jincheon 工厂扩大管线产能
韩国忠清北道 Jincheon——CJ CheilJedang 于1996年推出全国首款以Hetbahn品牌销售的微波即食蒸米饭，此后一直主导市场。该公司正加快出口，以向全球消费者推广更健康的饮食。CJ CheilJedang 将米饭定位为相较面包的“更优质碳水化合物”，作为其全球扩张战略的一部分。公司援引全球市场研究机构 Mintel 的数据称，34.6%的美国大米消费者认为米饭是“更健康的选择”，他们不仅将米饭用于炒饭、寿司等亚洲菜式，也用于鸡肉、牛排、墨西哥卷饼或米饭碗等西式菜肴。去年，该国每周至少吃一次米饭的人口占比升至45%，高于2023年的37%。公司全球首席营销官 Jin Kim 周三表示：“当然，目前也有其他稻米出口商向美国销售。但我们的产品在质量和便利性方面优于它们。我们的产品采用微波碗包装，并使用短粒米，品种现在也在不断增加。相比之下，其他产品采用袋装包装，煮饭时仍然需要锅具。它们尚未达到我们的质量和技术水平。”她补充说：“但我们向美国出口的时间还不算长。尽管我们目前在美国的市场份额为11.9%，Ben’s Original 的占比约为45%。CheilJedang 表示，目前将美国作为主要全球市场，是因为当地消费者已经非常熟悉米饭，而且该国加工食品市场在全球名列前茅。公司食品研发负责人 Oh Ye-jin 表示：“与我最初的想法相反，美国消费者已经培养出对米饭的浓厚兴趣。他们了解不同品牌之间的差异，也知道优质大米是什么味道。”Kim 补充道：“美国不同于把米饭作为餐桌主食的亚洲国家，对进口食品原料的接受度很高。当地食品生产市场已经进入成熟阶段。”CheilJedang 目前拥有美国食品公司 Schwan’s 的16家美国制造工厂，该公司于2019年被其收购。Kim 表示，如果美国市场需求增长至超出 CheilJedang 依托釜山出口基地所能供应的水平，Schwan’s 的部分工厂可能会升级改造，在当地生产Hetbahn。
Hetbahn 由公司位于忠清北道 Jincheon 的最大工厂生产，去年总体销售额达到1.18万亿韩元（8.92亿美元），其中15%来自海外市场。自2021年以来，这一数字逐年增长；2021年销售额为7900亿韩元，出口占比为8%。Hetbahn 日益提升的知名度推动了 CheilJedang 的整体销售。2001年至2025年间，销售额增长18倍，去年达到5.2万亿韩元的峰值。
Jincheon 工厂又称 CJ Blossom Campus，在投资1万亿韩元后于2018年建成。工厂采用无菌包装米饭制造技术，公司称其复杂程度与半导体晶圆代工技术相当。自动化设备覆盖从包装、物流到蒸饭和制碗的整个流程，使工厂每年能够生产2.8亿碗Hetbahn。加上釜山的另一座工厂，公司年产能达到7亿份。公司持有Hetbahn 生产技术相关的267项专利。
尽管韩国大米消费量下降，CheilJedang 仍在推动Hetbahn业务，并增加与农户签订的供货合同量。去年，公司采购了6.5万吨国产大米，是十年前的3倍多。过去30年间，Hetbahn 共消耗了4300万袋供应大米，相当于86万辆装载1吨大米的卡车
