https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 共和党筹款优势很大程度上来自少数几位富有的印度裔美国捐助者，尤其是科技行业的捐助者。与此同时，民主党从印度裔美国人群体中吸引到的大额捐助者较少。资金差距还凸显出，尽管民主党仍得到较小额捐助者的支持，但富有的印度裔美国捐助者正日益倾向于支持共和党。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: A group of major Indian-American business leaders and entrepreneurs have donated over $15.8 million to Republican Party-linked political action committees and funds since 2025, giving Donald Trump’s party a roughly 4:1 fundraising advantage over Democrats among prominent donors ahead of the November 3 US midterm elections, an HT analysis of Federal Election Commission data shows. The Democratic party, which is fighting to take back control of the House of Representatives and the Senate from the Republicans, has raised roughly $3.7 million from key donors within the community. Much of the Republicans’ fundraising advantage comes from a handful of wealthy Indian-American donors, particularly those in the technology industry. Venture capitalist Asha Jadeja Motwani, who has donated an estimated $5.9 million to Trump-affiliated political action committee MAGA Inc and the Republican National Committee (RNC) since 2025, emerged as the party’s biggest Indian-American donor. Michelle D’Souza, an entrepreneur who grew up in Goa and heads IT firm Unified Business Technologies, contributed $4 million to MAGA Inc in October 2025, followed by more than $400,000 to the RNC in 2025 and 2026. Other major Republican donors include Palantir chief technology officer Shyam Sankar, who contributed about $1.9 million to Republican political action committees and groups in 2025 and 2026. Sankar, a newly minted billionaire, was reportedly considered by the Trump administration for a senior Pentagon role. Orthopaedic surgeon Anjani Sinha, who was nominated by Trump as US ambassador to Singapore in March 2025, donated $1 million to MAGA Inc the previous month. Retired medical professional Krishna Tripuraneni also contributed $1 million to the committee. Tripuraneni, who pleaded guilty to filing a false tax return, is seeking a presidential pardon, HT reported earlier this year. Florida businessman Ramalinga Mantena, who made headlines in India last year over his daughter’s lavish wedding in Udaipur, donated $886,000 to Republican causes, in addition to a substantial contribution to Trump’s inaugural ball. Donations from billionaire sports team owner Vivek Ranadive, technology entrepreneur Vipul Prakash and Nvidia vice-president Sundeep Singh Madra added a further $750,000 to the Republicans’ election war chest. The Democrats, meanwhile, have attracted fewer big-money donors from the Indian-American community. Venture capitalist Vinod Khosla contributed about $2.09 million to Democratic causes in 2025 and 2026, with much of the funding directed towards the Senate Majority PAC, which aims to help the party regain control of the upper chamber. Khosla’s daughter, writer and brand strategist Anu Khosla, donated more than $250,000 to Democratic and progressive groups during the same period, while veteran Democratic donor and investment adviser Shekar Narasimhan contributed about $309,400. The Democratic-aligned Impact Fund also raised more than $1 million from prominent Indian-American donors, including Silicon Valley-based investor Sumir Chadha. The fundraising gap reflects a sharp increase in contributions to Trump-aligned groups by some prominent Indian-American donors since 2025. Motwani, for instance, donated $300,000 to a joint fundraising committee supporting Trump’s 2024 presidential campaign and the RNC before increasing her contributions roughly 18-fold in 2025. Sankar, meanwhile, gave less than $100,000 to Republican causes during the 2023-24 election cycle before contributing about $1.9 million in 2025 and 2026. Motwani said her increased funding was driven by a desire to help Republicans retain control of both chambers of Congress in the November midterm elections. “I want the Republicans to maintain a major majority in the House and the Senate, so contributing to President Trump’s war chest is an important step towards funding the right candidates and their campaigns,” Motwani told HT. HT’s analysis also found that some prominent Indian-American donors backing Republicans were previously major supporters of the Democratic Party. Motwani, for instance, supported Barack Obama in 2012, Hillary Clinton in 2016 and Joe Biden in 2020 before becoming one of the community’s biggest donors to Trump. Ranadive, who contributed roughly $60,000 to the Democrats in the 2024 election cycle, donated $250,000 to Republican causes in 2025. Mantena, a major Trump supporter in 2020 and 2024, had also backed Obama in 2012. Motwani attributed her shift to a loss of faith in the Democratic Party, alleging that it had allowed undocumented migrants to enter the country and obtain documents that could be used to vote. “I lost trust in the Democratic Party after I discovered that they had opened the borders to import voters in swing states,” she told HT, making claims about election fraud. Motwani said she intended to continue backing Republican candidates in 2026 and 2028. The funding gap also highlights how wealthy Indian-American donors are increasingly favouring Republicans, even as Democrats retain support among smaller contributors. “Trump is soaking up the money among big Indian-American donors. The people giving less than $1,000 are Democrats now. The people giving more than half a million dollars are Republicans,” Narasimhan told HT. However, he said Democratic committees had seen a “big uptick” in small donors contributing $25 to $50 a month, describing it as evidence of a growing grassroots movement. The trend, he added, was difficult to capture fully through Federal Election Commission records, which do not always convey the scale of small-donor mobilisation. The Republicans’ fundraising advantage among wealthy Indian-Americans comes even as opinion within the community remains divided over Trump’s handling of relations with India. One Indian-American active in the Republican Party told HT, on condition of anonymity, that concerns over online attacks against Indians could erode support for Trump and his party. Democrats, meanwhile, believe tensions in US-India relations, visa difficulties and anti-immigration sentiment could win back voters who supported Trump in 2024. “Many of those who once supported Trump are now returning to the Democratic side,” Democratic fundraiser and organiser Ajay Bhutoria told HT, pointing to recent elections in New Jersey, Virginia and New York
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 美国中期选举前，印度裔美国捐赠者向共和党提供的资金是民主党的4倍
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 《Hindustan Times》对美国联邦选举委员会数据的分析显示，自2025年以来，一批印度裔美国商界领袖和企业家已向与共和党有关联的政治行动委员会和基金捐款逾1580万美元。在11月3日美国中期选举前夕，这些知名捐款人给唐纳德·特朗普所属政党带来的筹款优势约为民主党的4倍。民主党正努力从共和党手中夺回众议院和参议院的控制权，该党从社区内的关键捐款人处筹集了约370万美元。共和党的筹款优势主要来自少数几位富有的印度裔美国捐款人，尤其是科技业人士。风险投资家Asha Jadeja Motwani自2025年以来据估计已向特朗普阵营的政治行动委员会MAGA Inc和共和党全国委员会（RNC）捐款约590万美元，成为该党最大的印度裔美国捐款人。在果阿邦长大的企业家、信息技术公司Unified Business Technologies负责人Michelle D’Souza于2025年10月向MAGA Inc捐款400万美元，随后在2025年和2026年又向RNC捐款逾40万美元。共和党的其他主要捐款人包括Palantir首席技术官Shyam Sankar，他在2025年和2026年向共和党政治行动委员会和团体捐款约190万美元。据报道，这位新晋亿万富翁曾被特朗普政府考虑任命为五角大楼高级职位的人选。骨科外科医生Anjani Sinha于2025年3月获特朗普提名为美国驻新加坡大使，并在当月向MAGA Inc捐款100万美元。退休医疗专业人士Krishna Tripuraneni也向该委员会捐款100万美元。《Hindustan Times》今年早些时候报道称，Tripuraneni因提交虚假纳税申报书而认罪，目前正在寻求总统赦免。佛罗里达州商人Ramalinga Mantena去年因女儿在乌代布尔举办奢华婚礼而登上印度头条，除向特朗普就职舞会提供一笔可观捐款外，还向共和党事业捐款88.6万美元。亿万富翁、体育球队老板Vivek Ranadive、科技企业家Vipul Prakash和Nvidia副总裁Sundeep Singh Madra的捐款，又为共和党的选举资金库增加了75万美元。与此同时，民主党从印度裔美国社区吸引的大额捐款人较少。风险投资家Vinod Khosla在2025年和2026年向民主党事业捐款约209万美元，其中很大一部分流向参议院多数党PAC，旨在帮助该党重新掌控参议院。Khosla的女儿、作家兼品牌战略家Anu Khosla在同一时期向民主党和进步派团体捐款逾25万美元；资深民主党捐款人和投资顾问Shekar Narasimhan则捐款约30.94万美元。民主党阵营的Impact Fund也从包括总部位于硅谷的投资者Sumir Chadha在内的知名印度裔美国捐款人处筹集了逾100万美元。筹款差距反映出，自2025年以来，一些知名印度裔美国捐款人向特朗普阵营团体捐款的金额大幅增加。例如，Motwani曾向支持特朗普2024年总统竞选和RNC的联合筹款委员会捐款30万美元，随后在2025年将捐款额提高约18倍。与此同时，Sankar在2023至2024年选举周期内向共和党事业捐款不足10万美元，但2025年和2026年又捐款约190万美元。Motwani表示，她增加捐款是为了帮助共和党在11月中期选举中继续掌控国会两院。“我希望共和党在众议院和参议院保持明显多数，因此向特朗普总统竞选资金库捐款，是为合适的候选人和他们的竞选活动提供资金的重要一步。”Motwani告诉《Hindustan Times》。《Hindustan Times》的分析还发现，一些支持共和党的知名印度裔美国捐款人此前曾是民主党的主要支持者。例如，Motwani曾在2012年支持贝拉克·奥巴马，2016年支持希拉里·克林顿，2020年支持乔·拜登，后来成为特朗普在该社区内最大的捐款人之一。Ranadive在2024年选举周期内向民主党捐款约6万美元，却在2025年向共和党事业捐款25万美元。Mantena是特朗普在2020年和2024年竞选中的主要支持者，此前也曾在2012年支持奥巴马。Motwani将这一立场转变归因于对民主党失去信任，并声称民主党允许无证移民进入美国，获取可用于投票的证件。“当我发现民主党开放边境，把选民引入摇摆州后，我就失去了对民主党的信任。”她告诉《Hindustan Times》，并提出了有关选举舞弊的说法。Motwani表示，她打算在2026年和2028年继续支持共和党候选人。资金差距也凸显出，富裕的印度裔美国捐款人越来越倾向支持共和党，尽管民主党仍得到小额捐款人的支持。“特朗普正在吸走印度裔美国大额捐款人的钱。现在，捐款低于1000美元的人是民主党，捐款超过50万美元的人是共和党。”Narasimhan告诉《Hindustan Times》。不过，他表示，民主党委员会的小额捐款人捐款额每月在25至50美元之间，已经出现“大幅增长”，并将其视为草根运动不断发展的迹象。他补充说，这一趋势很难通过联邦选举委员会的记录得到完整反映，因为这些记录并不总能体现小额捐款人动员的规模。尽管共和党在富裕印度裔美国人群中拥有筹款优势，但该社区对特朗普处理印美关系的做法仍意见分歧。一名活跃于共和党的印度裔美国人士在匿名条件下告诉《Hindustan Times》，针对印度人的网络攻击所引发的担忧，可能削弱对特朗普及其政党的支持。与此同时，民主党认为，美印关系紧张、签证困难和反移民情绪，可能促使2024年支持特朗普的选民重新转向民主党。民主党筹款人兼组织者Ajay Bhutoria告诉《Hindustan Times》：“许多曾经支持特朗普的人如今正在回归民主党阵营。”他还提到新泽西州、弗吉尼亚州和纽约州近期的选举

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/24/e.summary_zh: 肯尼亚卫生部昨天宣布该国出现第二例埃博拉死亡病例，并表示，这名65岁女子在隔离期间出现症状，她是本月早些时候因埃博拉去世的一名肯尼亚男子的近亲。瑞士外交部证实，这名在尼日利亚检测呈埃博拉阳性的女子是一名瑞士外交官的妻子。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/24/e.body: WHO says source of infection remains unknown, calls for regional vigilance The directive by the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare followed concerns raised by the Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA) over reported breaches of government-approved Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) entry protocols at Nigeria’s designated points of entry. The ministry’s directive was contained in circular PS/FMOH/08/VIII/48, dated October 22, 2026, and signed by the Permanent Secretary, Daju Kachollum S., on behalf of the Coordinating Minister of Health and Social Welfare, Prof. Muhammad Ali Pate. This comes as Kenya’s Health Ministry yesterday announced a second Ebola death, adding that the 65-year-old woman had developed symptoms during quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died of Ebola earlier this month. Also yesterday, Edo State Governor, Senator Monday Okpebholo, established a committee to coordinate the state’s emergency preparedness and response. Switzerland’s Foreign Ministry confirmed that the woman who tested positive for Ebola in Nigeria was the wife of a Swiss diplomat. The 42-year-old Ugandan-born woman, who lives in Abuja, tested positive on October 20, becoming Nigeria’s first confirmed Ebola patient in more than a decade. The couple had travelled to Uganda earlier in October. Her husband is currently in isolation but has not developed symptoms, according to the Swiss Foreign Ministry. The ministry told the BBC that all 25 staff members at its embassy in Nigeria were in good health and did not need to isolate. The decision, taken in consultation with Nigeria’s Ministry of Health and the World Health Organisation (WHO), covered eight Swiss staff members and 17 local employees. The embassy remains open and operational, with health and safety measures in place. The woman had reportedly spent about a week at a private clinic in Abuja experiencing symptoms before her diagnosis. She returned to Nigeria on October 3 after spending about two and a half weeks in Uganda. She developed symptoms four days after arriving in Abuja and sought treatment at two private health facilities before testing positive on October 20. WHO said the woman was receiving treatment in isolation and showing signs of improvement. Although there were reports that she had travelled to eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) for business, the WHO, Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and Nigeria’s health ministry said they had not received verified information confirming that she visited the country. The Swiss government had also told Reuters that she did not travel to DR Congo, contradicting accounts from Uganda. Health officials are investigating whether she may have crossed paths with a Kenyan man who died of Ebola after travelling through Uganda’s main airport on the same day. The Africa CDC said investigators were examining whether the two could have been exposed through shared equipment or other contact. The agency’s Head of Emergency Preparedness and Response, Dr. Wessam Mankoula, described this as one of the possible scenarios but stressed that no link had been established. The Kenyan man had travelled from DR Congo through Uganda before arriving in Nairobi on October 3. He subsequently died, becoming Kenya’s first recorded Ebola fatality. Kenya has since confirmed nine cases and traced 135 contacts, all of whom were placed in quarantine. Ebola has infected nearly 10,000 people and killed more than 4,600 in Congo. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. Only people with symptoms can transmit the virus. The rare Ebola species behind the current outbreak has no approved treatment or vaccine. WHO said it was too early to determine where the woman in Nigeria contracted the virus. “The source of exposure is still not known. The travel history of the patient is still being pieced together,” said Dr Patrick Otim, a WHO emergency response official. He said investigators had struggled to obtain a complete account of her movements because opportunities to interview her were limited while she remained in hospital. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) is conducting genomic sequencing to help establish whether her infection is linked to other cases. However, the woman has been confirmed to have the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, the same species responsible for the outbreak in DR Congo. “The investigation is reconstructing the full travel and exposure history. Genomic sequencing is given a high priority,” said Dr Pavel Ursu, WHO’s representative in Nigeria. Meanwhile, Nigerian authorities are tracing additional people who may have been exposed to the woman beyond the 44 contacts initially identified. Kenya’s Director-General of Health, Dr Patrick Amoth, said all nine confirmed infections in his country were linked to the first patient, with no evidence of wider community transmission. He urged the public to remain vigilant without panicking, while warning that the country was not yet out of danger. He added that the eight surviving patients remained in isolation and were responding well to treatment. The developments have renewed concerns about the movement of infected people across international borders, particularly between DR Congo and neighbouring Uganda, where thousands of people cross daily for trade, work and family visits. WHO’s Regional Director for Africa, Dr Mohamed Janabi, called for regional vigilance and urged countries to strengthen surveillance, investigate infections and protect frontline health workers. Ebola is a serious viral disease transmitted through direct contact with the blood or other bodily fluids of an infected person, or contaminated objects. It does not spread through the air like influenza. Symptoms can include fever, severe weakness, vomiting and diarrhoea, and the disease can be fatal. People are not considered infectious before developing symptoms. Health authorities say rapid contact tracing, isolation of suspected cases and early treatment are crucial to preventing further transmission. In the circular, the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare directed relevant institutions to ensure strict adherence to approved EVD screening, health declaration, surveillance and other applicable entry requirements at all designated points of entry into Nigeria. According to a statement signed by the Assistant Director, Information and Public Relations, Ado Bako, the directive followed concerns communicated to the Coordinating Minister by ONSA over reported non-compliance with government-approved protocols. The ministry emphasised the need for consistent, effective and non-discriminatory enforcement of the measures to mitigate potential cross-border transmission and protect public health and national security. It also called for stronger coordination, communication and information-sharing among stakeholders to support effective surveillance, early detection and prompt responses to potential threats. “All concerned institutions have been urged to promptly document and report any actual or attempted breach of approved protocols through established channels, provide necessary support to officials responsible for enforcement, and establish effective monitoring and accountability mechanisms to sustain compliance,” the statement said. The ministry stressed that personnel responsible for enforcing the protocols should be allowed to perform their duties professionally and without undue interference. It also directed the immediate and widespread dissemination of public advisories to relevant departments, units, field offices and personnel to ensure that they understood their responsibilities. “All concerned MDAs are expected to accord the directive the highest priority, address identified lapses promptly and sustain compliance with approved EVD entry protocols in the collective interest of public health and national safety,” the statement added. The directive comes amid efforts to contain the confirmed Ebola case in the Federal Capital Territory, with the government intensifying surveillance at airports, seaports and land borders. Kenya has recorded a second Ebola death, the health ministry said yesterday, adding that the 65-year-old woman had developed symptoms during quarantine and was a close relative of a Kenyan man who died of Ebola earlier this month. The outbreak, which started in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has now been reported in four countries across eastern, central andwestern Africa, giving it the widest geographic spread of any Ebola outbreak on the continent to date. The Ebola victim who died yesterday, was a direct contact of the index patient, Reuters quoted the Kenyan ministry to have revealed. “This loss brings the number of deaths to two among the nine confirmed cases. The remaining seven patients continue to receive care in the two isolation facilities,” the ministry said, adding there was no evidence of community spread in the country. Late on Monday, the US State Department advised Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya and raised its travel advisory level for the countrybecause of health risks. Edo State Governor, Senator Monday Okpebholo, has established a committee on Ebola emergency preparedness and response. The committee is chaired by the Deputy Governor, Dennis Idahosa, according to a statement issued yesterday by the Chief Press Secretary to the Governor, Dr Patrick Ebojele. The committee is expected to coordinate the state’s preparedness and response to any Ebola threat. Other members include personnel from the Department of State Services, Nigeria Immigration Service, Nigeria Police Force and Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps. The committee also includes representatives of the University of Benin Teaching Hospital, Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital, Edo State University Teaching Hospital, Federal Neuropsychiatric Hospital in Uselu, Edo Specialist Hospital, Central Hospital in Benin City and Stella Obasanjo Hospital. Professional bodies represented include the Nigeria Medical Association, National Association of Nigeria Nurses and Midwives, and the Edo State chapter of the Association of Private Medical Practitioners of Nigeria. Other members include a traditional ruler, a leader of the Christian Association of Nigeria in Edo State, the state’s Chief Imam and a market women’s leader. Development partners and agencies represented on the committee include the WHO, UNICEF, Nigeria Red Cross Society, DataFi, National Primary Health Care Development Agency and Edo State Primary Health Care Development Agency. The committee will operate through the Public Health Emergency Operations Centre, which has designated areas of responsibility covering coordination, epidemiology, surveillance, infection prevention and control, risk communication, logistics, laboratory services, case management, and safe and dignified burial. A centre manager will oversee operations. The statement added that a stakeholders’ meeting would be scheduled for the committee. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/24/e.title_zh: 埃博拉：联邦政府加强监测和筛查，确认一名感染者是瑞士外交官的妻子
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/24/e.body_zh:
世卫组织称感染源头仍不明，呼吁加强地区警觉

联邦卫生与社会保障部发布指令，此前国家安全顾问办公室（ONSA）担忧，尼日利亚指定入境口岸据报违反了政府批准的埃博拉病毒病（EVD）入境规程。该部指令载于编号为PS/FMOH/08/VIII/48、日期为2026年10月22日的通函，由常任秘书Daju Kachollum S.代表卫生与社会保障部协调部长、Prof. Muhammad Ali Pate签署。

就在肯尼亚卫生部昨日宣布该国出现第二例埃博拉死亡病例之际，该指令发布。卫生部称，这名65岁女性在隔离期间出现症状，她是一名肯尼亚男子的近亲；该男子于本月早些时候死于埃博拉。

埃多州州长、参议员Monday Okpebholo昨日成立了一个委员会，协调该州疫情应急准备和响应工作。瑞士外交部证实，在尼日利亚检测呈埃博拉阳性的这名女子是一名瑞士外交官的妻子。这名42岁、出生于乌干达的女子居住在阿布贾，于10月20日检测呈阳性，成为尼日利亚十多年来首名确诊埃博拉患者。这对夫妇10月初曾前往乌干达。据瑞士外交部称，其丈夫目前正在隔离，但尚未出现症状。该部告知BBC，其驻尼日利亚使馆的25名工作人员均健康状况良好，无须隔离。这项决定是在与尼日利亚卫生部和世界卫生组织（WHO）磋商后作出的，涉及8名瑞士工作人员和17名当地雇员。使馆继续开放并正常运作，已采取卫生和安全措施。

据报道，这名女子确诊前曾在阿布贾一家私人诊所出现症状并就诊约一周。她在乌干达停留约两个半星期后，于10月3日返回尼日利亚。抵达阿布贾4天后，她开始出现症状，先后前往两家私人医疗机构就诊，并于10月20日检测呈阳性。世卫组织称，这名女子正在隔离接受治疗，并出现好转迹象。

尽管有报道称她曾因公前往刚果民主共和国（刚果（金）），但世卫组织、非洲疾病控制和预防中心（Africa CDC）及尼日利亚卫生部均表示，尚未收到经核实的信息，无法确认她到访过该国。瑞士政府也告诉路透社，她没有前往刚果（金），与乌干达方面提供的情况相互矛盾。

卫生官员正在调查，她是否可能与一名肯尼亚男子有过接触。那名男子途经乌干达主要机场的同一天，她也曾经过那里，随后他死于埃博拉。Africa CDC表示，调查人员正在研究两人是否可能因共用设备或其他接触而暴露于病毒。该机构应急准备与响应负责人Dr. Wessam Mankoula称，这是可能的情形之一，但强调尚未确定二者存在关联。

那名肯尼亚男子于10月3日抵达内罗毕，此前曾从刚果（金）经乌干达旅行。此后他去世，成为肯尼亚有记录以来首名埃博拉死亡患者。肯尼亚此后已确认9例病例并追踪135名接触者，所有人均已接受隔离。刚果（金）的埃博拉疫情已导致近10,000人感染、逾4,600人死亡。该病可引起发热、呕吐、腹泻，严重时还会造成内出血和外出血。只有出现症状的人才会传播病毒。引发当前疫情的罕见埃博拉病毒种类尚无获批治疗药物或疫苗。

世卫组织表示，现在判断尼日利亚这名女子在何处感染病毒仍为时过早。世卫组织应急响应官员Dr Patrick Otim说：“暴露源头仍不清楚。目前仍在梳理患者的旅行史。”他说，调查人员一直难以获得其完整行动记录，因为她在住院期间接受访谈的机会有限。尼日利亚疾病控制和预防中心（NCDC）正在进行基因组测序，以帮助确定她的感染是否与其他病例有关。不过，现已确认该女子感染的是埃博拉病毒的Bundibugyo种类，与刚果（金）疫情的病毒种类相同。

世卫组织驻尼日利亚代表Dr Pavel Ursu说：“调查正在重建完整的旅行和暴露史。基因组测序被列为高度优先事项。”与此同时，尼日利亚当局正在追踪最初确认的44名接触者之外，可能与该女子有过接触的其他人员。

肯尼亚卫生总监Dr Patrick Amoth说，该国9例确诊感染均与首名患者有关，没有证据显示病毒已扩大至社区传播。他敦促公众保持警惕但不要恐慌，同时警告该国尚未脱离危险。他补充说，其余8名存活患者仍在隔离中，治疗反应良好。

这些进展再次引发了对感染者跨境流动的担忧，尤其是刚果（金）与邻国乌干达之间；两国每天有数千人往来经商、工作和探亲。世卫组织非洲区域主任Dr Mohamed Janabi呼吁加强地区警觉，并敦促各国强化监测、调查感染病例并保护一线卫生工作者。

埃博拉是一种严重的病毒性疾病，可通过直接接触感染者的血液或其他体液，以及接触受污染物品传播。它不像流感那样通过空气传播。症状可能包括发热、严重虚弱、呕吐和腹泻，并可能致命。患者在出现症状前不会被视为具有传染性。卫生当局表示，迅速追踪接触者、隔离疑似病例和尽早治疗，是防止进一步传播的关键。

在通函中，联邦卫生与社会保障部指示相关机构确保在尼日利亚所有指定入境口岸严格遵守获批的EVD筛查、健康申报、监测及其他适用入境要求。根据由信息与公共关系助理主任Ado Bako签署的声明，该指令是在ONSA向协调部长通报有关未遵守政府批准规程的情况后发布的。该部强调，必须持续、有效且不带歧视地执行相关措施，以减轻潜在的跨境传播风险，并保护公共健康和国家安全。该部还呼吁利益相关方加强协调、沟通和信息共享，以支持有效监测、及早发现和迅速应对潜在威胁。

声明称：“所有相关机构均获敦促立即通过既定渠道记录并报告任何实际或企图违反获批规程的情况，为负责执法的官员提供必要支持，并建立有效的监督和问责机制，以维持合规。”该部强调，负责执行规程的人员应获准专业履职，不受不当干预。该部还指示立即向相关部门、单位、外勤办公室和人员广泛发布公众通告，确保其理解自身职责。声明补充说：“所有相关MDA均应把该指令置于最高优先级，迅速纠正已发现的疏漏，并出于公共健康和国家安全的共同利益，持续遵守获批的EVD入境规程。”

该指令发布之际，政府正在努力控制联邦首都区已确诊的埃博拉病例，并加强机场、海港和陆地边境的监测。

肯尼亚卫生部昨日表示，该国已录得第二例埃博拉死亡病例，并补充说，这名65岁女子在隔离期间出现症状，她是一名肯尼亚男子的近亲；该男子于本月早些时候死于埃博拉。这场始于刚果民主共和国的疫情如今已在东非、中非和西非的4个国家报告，是非洲迄今地理分布范围最广的埃博拉疫情。

肯尼亚卫生部向路透社透露，昨日去世的埃博拉患者是指示病例的直接接触者。该部说：“此次死亡使9例确诊病例中的死亡人数增至2人。其余7名患者继续在两处隔离设施接受治疗。”该部还表示，没有证据显示疫情已在国内社区传播。

周一晚些时候，美国国务院因健康风险建议美国人重新考虑前往肯尼亚旅行，并提高了对该国的旅行警示等级。

埃多州州长、参议员Monday Okpebholo已成立埃博拉疫情应急准备和响应委员会。据州长首席新闻秘书Dr Patrick Ebojele昨日发表的声明，该委员会由副州长Dennis Idahosa主持。委员会预计将协调该州针对任何埃博拉威胁的准备工作和响应工作。

其他成员包括国家安全局、尼日利亚移民局、尼日利亚警察部队和尼日利亚安全与民防部队人员。委员会还包括贝宁大学教学医院、Irrua专科教学医院、埃多州立大学教学医院、位于Uselu的联邦神经精神病医院、埃多专科医院、贝宁城中央医院和Stella Obasanjo医院代表。

委员会所代表的行业机构包括尼日利亚医学协会、尼日利亚护士与助产士全国协会，以及尼日利亚私人医疗从业者协会埃多州分会。其他成员还包括一名传统统治者、尼日利亚基督教协会埃多州分会负责人、该州首席伊玛目和一名市场妇女领袖。

委员会中有代表的发展伙伴和机构包括WHO、UNICEF、尼日利亚红十字会、DataFi、国家基层医疗保健发展署和埃多州基层医疗保健发展署。委员会将通过公共卫生应急行动中心运作，该中心划分的职责领域包括协调、流行病学、监测、感染预防与控制、风险沟通、物流、实验室服务、病例管理，以及安全且有尊严的安葬。中心经理将监督各项运作。声明补充说，将为委员会安排一次利益相关方会议。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The Presidential Working Group on the National Policing Bill says 24 State Houses of Assembly have approved the Constitution (Sixth Alteration) Bill, 2026, providing for a dual policing system. The approval meets the constitutional threshold of two-thirds of the 36 states required for the amendment to proceed. The working group commended the state Houses of Assembly for their action and acknowledged the National Assembly for passing the amendment in both chambers. This is contained in a statement issued by Femi Gbajabiamila, chief of staff to the President and chairman of the group, on Friday in Abuja. Mr Gbajabiamila said the approval provided constitutional backing for the policing framework outlined in the working group’s draft National Policing Bill, 2026. He added that the draft Bills were undergoing legislative drafting review and validation at the Federal Ministry of Justice. The Bills are expected to be returned on or before 30 October, after which the working group will give them final consideration before presenting them to President Bola Tinubu. The working group urged stakeholders to support a smooth transition to a dual policing system aimed at improving public safety

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/he.summary: The Coordinating Minister of Health and Social Welfare, Muhammad Pate, has confirmed that the Ebola virus detected in Nigeria is highly similar to the virus identified in Kenya’s first imported case. “Based on the genomic analysis, there is no evidence of travel of that index case in Kenya that links it to Nigeria, but the viruses are appearing to be related,” he said.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/he.summary_zh: 卫生与社会福利协调部长穆罕默德·帕特证实，在尼日利亚发现的埃博拉病毒与肯尼亚首例输入性病例所发现的病毒高度相似。他说：“根据基因组分析，没有证据表明该指示病例在肯尼亚旅行期间与尼日利亚存在联系，但两种病毒似乎存在关联。”
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/he.body: The Coordinating Minister of Health and Social Welfare, Muhammad Pate, has confirmed that the Ebola virus detected in Nigeria is highly similar to the virus identified in Kenya’s first imported case. Mr Pate disclosed this on Friday during a briefing at the Federal Ministry of Health in Abuja, saying genomic sequencing showed that the viruses differed by only one mutation. He said the analysis was conducted by sequencing teams at the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) and the Institute of Genomics and Global Health at Redeemer’s University, Ede, Osun State, with the team led by virologist Christian Happi. However, he cautioned that the finding does not establish how the Nigerian first case acquired the infection. “Based on the genomic analysis, there is no evidence of travel of that index case in Kenya that links it to Nigeria, but the viruses are appearing to be related,” he said. He added that the finding could change the understanding of the route of transmission as further investigations and testing continue. Kenya has so far recorded nine confirmed Ebola cases caused by Bundibugyo virus, including one death, according to the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC). Eight of the cases were linked to the country’s first imported case from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), including four healthcare workers. The genomic finding came on the same day the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) said it is investigating a possible connection between Nigeria’s case and Kenya’s first imported case. The agency said both patients had travelled through Entebbe International Airport in Uganda on 3 October, prompting investigations into whether they had shared equipment or had other contact. Africa CDC, however, stressed that no connection had been established between the infections. The Kenyan patient travelled from the DRC through Uganda before arriving in Nairobi. He later died, becoming the first recorded Ebola death in Kenya’s current outbreak. The Nigerian patient also passed through Uganda, but Ugandan authorities had earlier rejected suggestions that this established the country as the source of her infection. On 21 October, Uganda’s Ministry of Health said it had no confirmed active Ebola case and that the Nigerian patient’s transit through the country did not establish that she contracted the virus there. The ministry said preliminary information indicated that the Nigerian woman had travelled to eastern DRC for business and passed through Uganda in early October without showing symptoms. It said the location of her exposure remained under investigation. The new genomic finding now provides evidence of similarity between the Nigerian and Kenyan infections, although Nigerian authorities have not established that the patient was infected in Kenya. Mr Pate said Nigeria still has only one confirmed Ebola case and that authorities were continuing contact tracing, quarantine and additional testing of contacts. Some tests have returned negative results, while others are pending, he said. He urged Nigerians to remain vigilant but calm, saying there is no need for panic. “We will continue to work diligently to ensure that we contain this virus as much as possible, and that we avoid a situation that spills over to the communities,” he said. The minister said the government is also strengthening infection prevention and control measures in health facilities and would train health workers on how to identify and manage suspected cases. He urged hospitals to notify public health authorities of suspected cases and encouraged Nigerians to observe basic preventive measures, including regular handwashing and hygiene. Mr Pate also said Ebola is not currently known to be transmitted through the air but through close contact with infected body fluids. He urged Nigerians to rely on information from public health authorities, including the NCDC, Federal Ministry of Health, World Health Organisation and Africa CDC, rather than unverified information on social media
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/he.title_zh: 埃博拉：尼日利亚病例与肯尼亚感染病例高度相似
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/he.body_zh: 卫生与社会福利协调部长穆罕马德·帕特证实，在尼日利亚检测到的埃博拉病毒与肯尼亚首例输入性病例所确认的病毒高度相似。帕特周五在阿布贾联邦卫生部举行新闻发布会时透露了这一情况，并表示基因组测序显示，两种病毒仅有一个突变位点不同。他说，这项分析由尼日利亚疾病控制与预防中心（NCDC）和奥孙州埃德 Redeemer’s University 的基因组学与全球健康研究所测序团队完成，团队由病毒学家克里斯蒂安·哈皮率领。不过，他警告称，这一发现并不能确定尼日利亚首例病例是如何感染的。“根据基因组分析，没有证据显示该指示病例曾在肯尼亚旅行并因此与尼日利亚建立联系，但这两种病毒似乎存在关联。”他说。随着进一步调查和检测持续进行，这一发现可能改变人们对传播途径的认识。据欧洲疾病预防控制中心（ECDC）报告，肯尼亚迄今已记录9例由本迪布焦病毒引起的确诊埃博拉病例，其中1例死亡。其中8例与该国首例来自刚果民主共和国（DRC）的输入性病例有关，涉及4名医护人员。基因组方面的这一发现公布之际，非洲疾病预防控制中心（Africa CDC）也表示，正在调查尼日利亚病例与肯尼亚首例输入性病例之间可能存在的联系。该机构称，两名患者均于10月3日途经乌干达恩特贝国际机场，因此有关部门调查他们是否共用过设备或有过其他接触。然而，Africa CDC强调，尚未确认两起感染之间存在联系。肯尼亚患者从刚果民主共和国出发，经乌干达抵达内罗毕。他后来死亡，成为肯尼亚当前疫情中首例有记录的埃博拉死亡病例。尼日利亚患者也途经乌干达，但乌干达当局此前否认了由此认定该国是她感染病毒来源的说法。10月21日，乌干达卫生部表示，该国没有确诊的活跃埃博拉病例，尼日利亚患者途经该国并不能证明她是在当地感染病毒的。该部称，初步信息显示，这名尼日利亚女子因商务前往刚果民主共和国东部，并于10月初途经乌干达，当时没有出现症状。她接触病毒的具体地点仍在调查之中。新的基因组发现如今为尼日利亚和肯尼亚两起感染之间的相似性提供了证据，但尼日利亚当局尚未确定该患者是在肯尼亚感染的。帕特说，尼日利亚目前仍只有1例确诊埃博拉病例，当局正在继续对接触者进行追踪、隔离和进一步检测。他说，部分检测结果为阴性，其他结果仍在等待。他敦促尼日利亚人保持警惕但保持镇定，表示没有必要恐慌。“我们将继续努力工作，尽可能确保控制这种病毒，避免疫情蔓延至社区。”他说。部长表示，政府还在加强医疗机构的感染预防和控制措施，并将培训医护人员如何识别和管理疑似病例。他敦促医院向公共卫生当局报告疑似病例，并鼓励尼日利亚人采取基本预防措施，包括定期洗手和保持卫生。帕特还表示，目前尚不清楚埃博拉病毒会通过空气传播，而是通过与感染者的体液密切接触传播。他敦促尼日利亚人依赖公共卫生当局，包括NCDC、联邦卫生部、世界卫生组织和Africa CDC发布的信息，不要相信社交媒体上未经核实的信息

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/23/f.summary_zh: 联邦政府已确保联邦高等法院阿布贾分庭判定653名被控涉恐怖主义边缘行为者有罪。法格贝米在检视已进入第11阶段的审判进展时表示，今年开展的第三阶段审判共有1,060名嫌疑人被带上法庭受审。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/23/f.body: The federal government has secured the conviction of 653 persons charged with offences bordering on acts of terrorism before the Federal High Court, Abuja. Attorney General of the Federation (AGF) and Minister of Justice, Prince Lateef Fagbemi, SAN, made the disclosure on Friday, while speaking with journalists in Abuja. Fagbemi, who gave the update while reviewing the progress of the trials, which is on its 11th phase, observed that 1,060 suspects were brought before the courts for trial, which is the third phase conducted this year. He disclosed that as at noon on Friday, 880 cases had been tried, resulting in 653 convictions, seven acquittals and 27 discharges. The AGF, however, said the exercise was still ongoing and that the final figures would be announced upon its conclusion, describing the current phase as apparently the largest, since the federal government commenced the special terrorism trials, attributing the progress to judicial cooperation, effective prosecution and inter-agency collaboration. Fagbemi expressed appreciation to the judges handling the cases, particularly under the leadership of Justice Binta Nyako, who has been acting on behalf of the Chief Judge of the Federal High Court, Justice John Tsoho. He also commended prosecution and defence counsel, as well as relevant security and justice institutions, for their contributions to the exercise. Among the agencies acknowledged were the Office of the National Security Adviser (NSA), the Department of State Services (DSS), the military, the police, correctional centres and the Legal Aid Council. Fagbemi noted that the collaboration among the institutions has been critical to advancing the prosecution of terrorism, terrorism financing and related offences in the country. The AGF also thanked journalists for informing the public about the federal government’s efforts to address terrorism and related security challenges in the country. On the representation of defendants by lawyers from the Legal Aid Council, the AGF explained that the council was fulfilling its responsibility of providing legal assistance to eligible defendants and clarified, however, that private legal practitioners were also representing some of the suspects. According to him, defence lawyers had been engaging with their clients before the court proceedings, including visiting detention facilities and preparing them for their defence. He noted that some of these preparatory activities could not be subjected to public scrutiny because of the sensitive security considerations surrounding the cases. On the issue of deradicalisation of suspects recommended by the court, Fagbemi said the process remained an important component of the overall exercise, explaining that deradicalisation was intended to help eligible individuals understand and regret their actions, enabling them to reintegrate into society and resume their daily lives. The AGF maintained that rehabilitation and reintegration were necessary to complement the judicial process and reduce the risk of individuals returning to extremist activities. The ongoing trials form part of the federal government’s efforts to prosecute terrorism-related offences and strengthen accountability in the country’s response to insecurity. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/23/f.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府通过最新大规模审判成功定罪653名恐怖分子
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/23/f.body_zh: 联邦政府已促使阿布贾联邦高等法院对653名被控犯有接近恐怖主义行为罪行的人作出定罪判决。联邦总检察长兼司法部长Lateef Fagbemi、SAN于周五在阿布贾接受记者采访时披露了这一情况。Fagbemi在审议已进入第11阶段的审判进展时表示，共有1060名嫌疑人被带上法庭受审；这是今年开展的第三阶段审判。他透露，截至周五中午，已审理880起案件，其中653人被定罪、7人无罪释放、27人撤销指控。联邦总检察长表示，这项工作仍在进行，最终数字将在结束时公布，并将当前阶段描述为联邦政府启动特别恐怖主义审判以来规模最大的一阶段。他将审判进展归功于司法部门的配合、有效起诉以及各机构之间的协作。Fagbemi感谢了负责审理案件的法官，尤其是在Justice Binta Nyako的带领下；她一直代表联邦高等法院首席法官Justice John Tsoho履职。他还赞扬了控辩双方律师，以及相关安全和司法机构对这项工作的贡献。获得致谢的机构包括国家安全顾问办公室（NSA）、国家情报局（DSS）、军方、警察、惩教机构和法律援助委员会。Fagbemi指出，各机构之间的协作对于推进对国内恐怖主义、恐怖主义融资及相关罪行的起诉至关重要。联邦总检察长还感谢记者向公众报道联邦政府为应对国内恐怖主义及相关安全挑战所做的努力。关于法律援助委员会律师为被告人提供代理的问题，联邦总检察长解释说，该委员会正在履行向符合条件的被告提供法律援助的责任，同时澄清私人执业律师也在代理部分嫌疑人。他说，辩护律师在法院审理程序开始前一直与当事人接洽，包括前往拘留场所探视并帮助他们准备应诉。他指出，由于这些案件涉及敏感的安全考量，其中一些准备工作无法接受公众监督。关于法院建议对嫌疑人进行去激进化处理的问题，Fagbemi表示，这一过程仍是整个行动的重要组成部分。去激进化的目的在于帮助符合条件的人理解并悔悟自己的行为，使他们能够重新融入社会并恢复日常生活。联邦总检察长强调，康复和重新融入社会是补充司法程序、降低个人再次参与极端主义活动风险所必需的。正在进行的审判是联邦政府努力起诉恐怖主义相关罪行并加强全国应对不安全局势问责机制的一部分。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，并在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办事处。该报是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过所有平台面向政界、商界、专业人士和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层，同时为有志青年和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术交汇的平台。本报是一项公共信任事业，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.summary: The Federal Government has condemned xenophobic and Afrophobic hostilities against Nigerians and other foreign nationals in South Africa, as it evacuated another 114 distressed citizens from the country. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.summary_zh: 联邦政府谴责南非针对尼日利亚人及其他外国公民的仇外和反非敌意行为，并再次从该国撤离114名陷入困境的公民。该部门表示，此次行动是自2026年6月10日启动撤离工作以来的第16次领事撤离行动，使从南非撤离的尼日利亚公民总数达到2,151人。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.body: The Federal Government has condemned xenophobic and Afrophobic hostilities against Nigerians and other foreign nationals in South Africa, as it evacuated another 114 distressed citizens from the country. In a statement on Friday evening, the latest batch of returnees comprised 57 men, 23 women and 34 children who arrived in Lagos aboard South African Airways Flight SA060 at about 8:30 p.m. on Thursday, October 22, 2026. The returnees were received by officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the National Emergency Management Agency, the Nigeria Immigration Service and other relevant Federal Government agencies. The ministry said the latest operation was the 16th consular evacuation since the exercise began on June 10, 2026, bringing the total number of Nigerians evacuated from South Africa to 2,151. It explained that the Redeemed Christian Church of God, RCCG, under the leadership of Pastor Enoch Adejare Adeboye, funded the one-way tickets for the latest batch from its $265,854 donation to support the evacuation of 500 distressed Nigerians. With the latest evacuation, the church has funded the return of 432 Nigerians, while the Federal Government has fully funded the evacuation of 1,388 citizens. The Federal Government expressed appreciation to the RCCG for its financial support towards the humanitarian exercise. Condemning the attacks, the government called on the relevant South African authorities to take decisive measures to protect all persons, irrespective of nationality, and ensure that perpetrators of violence against foreign nationals are held accountable. It said it would continue engaging relevant stakeholders, including South African authorities, to address xenophobia and Afrophobia and promote the safety and welfare of Nigerians residing in South Africa. The statement in parts, “The latest operation marks the sixteenth (16th) consular evacuation since the commencement of the ongoing exercise on 10th June, 2026, bringing the total number of Nigerian nationals evacuated from South Africa to 2,151. Of this number, the Federal Government of Nigeria fully funded the return of 1,388 nationals. “The Federal Government reiterates its unequivocal condemnation of all forms of xenophobic and Afrophobic hostilities directed at foreign nationals, including Nigerians, in South Africa. It further calls on the relevant South African authorities to take decisive measures to protect all persons, irrespective of nationality, and ensure that perpetrators of violence against foreign nationals are held accountable. The government also advised Nigerians in the country to obey local laws, remain vigilant and prioritise their personal safety. It urged them to maintain regular contact with the Nigerian High Commission in Pretoria and the Consulate General in Johannesburg for consular assistance whenever necessary. The Federal Government reaffirmed its commitment to safeguarding Nigerians in the diaspora and providing timely consular assistance as the need arises. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.title_zh: 仇外情绪：尼日利亚联邦政府谴责袭击事件，再从南非撤离114名尼日利亚人
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.body_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府谴责了南非针对尼日利亚人和其他外国人的排外及反非敌意行为，同时又从该国撤离了114名陷入困境的公民。尼日利亚联邦政府周五晚发表声明称，最新一批返乡人员包括57名男性、23名女性和34名儿童，他们于2026年10月22日星期四晚上8时30分左右乘坐南非 Airways SA060航班抵达拉各斯。返乡人员受到外交部、国家紧急事务管理局、尼日利亚移民局及其他相关联邦政府机构官员的接待。大使馆表示，自2026年6月10日启动有关行动以来，这次最新行动是第16次领事撤离，累计已有2,151名尼日利亚人从南非撤离。声明解释称，在牧师Enoch Adejare Adeboye领导下，救赎基督教会（RCCG）从其265,854美元的捐款中拨出资金，为最新一批人员购买了单程机票；这笔捐款原本用于支持500名陷入困境的尼日利亚人撤离。随着最新一次撤离，该教会已出资帮助432名尼日利亚人返乡，尼日利亚联邦政府则全额资助了1,388名公民的撤离。尼日利亚联邦政府感谢RCCG为这项人道主义行动提供的资金支持。在谴责袭击事件时，政府呼吁南非相关当局采取果断措施，保护所有人，不论其国籍，并确保针对外国人的暴力行为实施者受到问责。政府表示，将继续与南非当局等相关利益攸关方沟通，以处理排外和反非问题，并促进居住在南非的尼日利亚人的安全与福祉。声明部分内容如下：“自2026年6月10日启动当前行动以来，这次最新行动是第16次领事撤离，累计已有2,151名尼日利亚国民从南非撤离。其中，尼日利亚联邦政府全额资助了1,388名国民返乡。“尼日利亚联邦政府再次坚决谴责南非境内针对外国人（包括尼日利亚人）的各种排外和反非敌意行为，并进一步呼吁南非相关当局采取果断措施，保护所有人，不论其国籍，并确保针对外国人的暴力行为实施者受到问责。政府还建议身在当地的尼日利亚人遵守当地法律、保持警惕，并优先保障个人安全。声明敦促他们定期与驻比勒陀利亚大使馆和驻约翰内斯堡总领事馆联系，在必要时寻求领事协助。尼日利亚联邦政府重申，将致力于保护海外尼日利亚人，并在有需要时及时提供领事协助。本文所发表的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.summary_zh: 第一层 2027年尼日利亚民主大会党（贝努埃州南区参议员候选人丹尼尔·奥涅赫同志已告知该党总统候选人彼得·奥比先生，他预计奥比将在2027年总统选举中以压倒性优势赢得贝努埃州。奥涅赫是在率领贝努埃州民主大会党全国议会候选人代表团对前阿南布拉州州长进行战略访问时说出这番话的。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.body: Layer 1 The 2027 Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) Benue South Senatorial Candidate, Comrade Daniel Onjeh, has told the party’s presidential candidate, Mr Peter Obi, that he expects him to win Benue State by a landslide in the 2027 presidential election. Onjeh said this when he led a delegation of Benue State NDC National Assembly candidates on a strategic visit to the former Anambra State Governor. Asked about the purpose of the visit, Onjeh said the delegation had gone to meet Obi to review what happened in the 2023 presidential election, look at the political situation in Benue and discuss what lies ahead in 2027. He described Obi’s performance in Benue State during the 2023 presidential election as impressive and outstanding, adding that he expects the former Anambra State Governor to receive even greater support in 2027. Onjeh said the delegation also discussed the state’s voting strength and the interest being shown in voter registration. He maintained that the support Obi received in 2023 reflected a desire for political change among sections of the electorate. The former President of the National Association of Nigerian Students (NANS) said the delegation also appealed to Obi to make Benue State a priority, especially after what he described as the deliberate obstruction of his previous attempts to visit the state. Onjeh questioned why a Nigerian citizen should be prevented from travelling freely within his own country, describing such interference as unacceptable. He said the candidates encouraged Obi to put those experiences behind him and assured him that the concerns previously raised to stop his visits would be adequately addressed. They also urged him to return and complete his humanitarian mission to Benue and spend sufficient time with the people during his proposed presidential campaign tour. Obi, according to Onjeh, assured the delegation that Benue remained dear to his heart and that he would return to spend ample time with the people. He said the former Anambra State Governor spoke about equity and justice, stressing that no part of Nigeria should be left out of his engagements with the people. Beyond the discussions about Benue, Onjeh said Obi had an important message for the National Assembly candidates: they must prepare, organise themselves and their supporters, and ensure that the votes cast by Nigerians are protected. He explained that Obi placed particular emphasis on the need for Nigerians not only to vote but also to ensure that their votes count. According to Onjeh, Obi linked this to the country’s future, arguing that unless Nigerians can freely choose their leaders and have those choices respected, the country will continue to struggle with poverty and the other challenges holding back its development. He said Obi also spoke about the need for Nigeria to make progress in technology and other sectors, noting that credible elections and accountable leadership were essential to moving the country forward. Onjeh, a former Chairman of the Governing Board of the Projects Development Institute (PRODA), Enugu, said the meeting also allowed the Benue candidates to discuss their preparations and exchange views with Obi on developments in the state. The former President of the West African Students’ Union (WASU) said the delegation left with a clear message about the importance of preparing early, working together and ensuring that voters are able to exercise their rights without interference. He maintained that the 2027 election would provide another opportunity for the people of Benue to make their choice through the ballot. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.title_zh: 2027年：你将以压倒性优势赢得贝努埃州
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.body_zh: 第一层：2027年尼日利亚民主大会党（benue South）参议院候选人丹尼尔·翁耶赫同志已告知该党总统候选人彼得·奥比先生，他预计奥比将在2027年总统选举中以压倒性优势赢得贝努埃州。翁耶赫带领贝努埃州民主大会党国民议会候选人代表团对前阿南布拉州州长进行战略访问时说出了这番话。被问及此次访问的目的时，翁耶赫说，代表团前来会见奥比，是为了回顾2023年总统选举中发生的情况，了解贝努埃的政治局势，并讨论2027年前的前景。他形容奥比在2023年总统选举中于贝努埃州的表现令人印象深刻且十分出色，并补充说，他预计这位前阿南布拉州州长在2027年将获得更加广泛的支持。翁耶赫说，代表团还讨论了该州的投票力量以及选民登记工作受到的关注。他坚称，奥比在2023年获得的 reflects 了部分选民对政治变革的愿望。尼日利亚全国学生协会（NANS）前主席说，代表团还呼吁奥比优先关注贝努埃州，尤其是在他此前试图访问该州却遭到他所说的故意阻挠之后。翁耶赫质疑，为什么一名尼日利亚公民应被阻止在本国境内自由旅行，并称此类干涉不可接受。他说，这些候选人鼓励奥比把那些经历抛在脑后，并向他保证，先前为阻止他访问而提出的各种顾虑将得到妥善解决。他们还敦促奥比返回贝努埃州，完成其人道主义使命，并在他拟进行的总统竞选巡回活动中花足够时间与当地民众相处。据翁耶赫说，奥比向代表团保证，贝努埃州始终在他心中占据重要位置，他会回来与当地民众共度充足时光。他说，这位前阿南布拉州州长谈到公平与正义，强调在Nigeria任何地区都不应被排除在他与民众接触的范围之外。除有关贝努埃州的讨论外，翁耶赫说，奥比还向国民议会候选人传达了一项重要信息：他们必须做好准备，组织好自己和支持者，并确保尼日利亚人投下的选票得到保护。他解释说，奥比特别强调，尼日利亚人不仅要投票，还要确保自己的选票能够产生效力。据翁耶赫说，奥比把这一点与国家未来联系起来，认为除非尼日利亚人能够自由选择领导人，并让选择得到尊重，否则国家将继续在贫困以及其他阻碍发展的挑战中挣扎。他说，奥比还谈到尼日利亚需要在技术及其他领域取得进展，并指出，可信的选举和负责任的领导是推动国家前进的关键。翁耶赫曾任 Projects Development Institute（PRODA）恩古努主管委员会主席，他说，此次会面还让贝努埃州候选人得以讨论各项准备工作，并就州内局势与奥比交换意见。西非学生联盟（WASU）前主席说，代表团带着一项明确的信息离开：尽早准备、携手合作，以及确保选民能够在不受干涉的情况下行使权利的重要性。他说，2027年选举将为贝努埃州人民提供另一个通过选票作出选择的机会。本文所表达的意见不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的意见

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nair.title_zh: 奈拉在平行市场贬值至1奈拉兑1美元兑1,367美元
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nair.body_zh: 奈拉周四在平行市场兑美元汇率由1,363奈拉贬值至1,367奈拉。同样，奈拉在尼日利亚外汇市场（NFEM）兑美元汇率由1,365奈拉升至1,370奈拉。尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）数据显示，周四奈拉指示性汇率由每美元1,365奈拉升至1,370奈拉，表明奈拉贬值5奈拉。因此，平行市场与官方市场之间的价差由周四的每美元2奈拉扩大至3奈拉。周四，NFEM银行间交易额由3.166亿美元增长219%，达到10.1亿美元。不过，金融分析人士预计奈拉将继续贬值。本文所表达的意见不代表Vanguard报业或其任何员工的观点

https://leadership.ng/fg-to-name-zaria-r.body: The permanent secretary, Federal Ministry of Transportation, Engr. Funso Adebiyi, disclosed this during a visit to the Emir’s palace, where he also pledged to intervene in outstanding compensation disputes delaying the railway extension from Jaji Station towards the Kano–Abuja rail corridor. Adebiyi said the ministry would review the monarch’s request and convey it to the appropriate authorities for consideration. The Emir had appealed to the federal government to immortalise his grandfather through the proposed naming, arguing that his contribution to the establishment of railway transportation in Zaria deserved recognition. He urged Adebiyi to present the request to the Minister of Transportation and President Bola Ahmed Tinubu. Beyond the naming proposal, the monarch raised concerns over unresolved compensation claims involving residents whose properties and interests had been affected by railway construction. Responding, Adebiyi said he would meet the affected residents the following week to examine their complaints, review relevant records, and explore ways to resolve the disputes. He acknowledged that compensation issues were among the factors delaying the railway extension, adding that the ministry would review the grievances, including concerns relating to the statutory framework governing compensation. The permanent secretary assured the Emir that the ministry would work towards an acceptable resolution. Bamali, who welcomed the return of train services to Zaria, described the development as a revival of the city’s historic connection with rail transportation. Recalling his childhood, the monarch said he travelled from Zaria to Bauchi in 1949 to see a train for the first time. He called for sustained investment in railway infrastructure, noting that improved rail connectivity would ease the difficulties associated with road travel. We’ve got the edge. The State government has put together an inter-ministerial group to work towards the development of sports infrastructure in colleges and create a support system for young athletes, Higher Education Minister P. Viswanathan said on Friday. Speaking to Physical Education Directors (PEDs) of government colleges across the State at the University of Madras (UoM), he said Sports Development Minister Aadhav Arjuna, School Education Minister Rajmohan, and Industries Minister S. Keerthana were part of the caucus that would seek to establish a link between academia, industry, and sportspersons studying in government colleges to improve sports infrastructure and support system for athletes. “It was the Sports Minister who suggested that we hold this meeting to evaluate the requirements,” he told the PEDs. “We have set our eyes on the 2036 Olympics and want to extend all possible help to our sportspersons,” he added. Earlier, PED representatives put forth several suggestions to improve conditions. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/t.body_zh:

高等教育部长P. Viswanathan周五在Madras大学表示，邦政府已成立一个部长间工作组，推动大学体育设施发展，并为年轻运动员建立支持体系。

他在Madras大学（UoM）向全邦公立大学的体育主任（PEDs）讲话时表示、体育发展部长Aadhav Arjuna、学校教育部长Rajmohan和工业部长S. Keerthana均参加了该小组；该小组将寻求在学术界、产业界以及就读于公立大学的运动员之间建立联系，以改善体育设施和运动员支持体系。

“正是体育部长建议我们召开这次会议，评估相关需求，”他告诉PEDs。“我们已经盯上了2036年奥运会，希望为我们的运动员提供一切可能的帮助。”他补充说。

部长表示，部长间工作组将确保在Tamil Nadu运营的企业提供的企业社会责任（CSR）资金在邦内使用。

“我们将确保运动员能够乘机前往各地，参加全国或国际级别的比赛，”他向与会者保证。

他说，在186个获批的PED职位中，有97个空缺，政府将采取措施尽快填补这些职位。

此前，PED representatives提出了多项改善条件的建议，其中包括为运动员提供营养餐、提高参赛人员的差旅津贴和每日津贴、在所有公立大学建设多用途室内体育场、为体育配额学生提供免费教育，以及为残疾人运动员建设独立设施。

他们还要求为按体育配额录取的学生提供宿舍，为参加比赛的学生提供体育贷款，并参照面向学校学生的午餐计划，为大学学生建立营养餐计划，以提高入学率。

部长要求PEDs根据这些建议提交一份可行的行动计划，并保证会研究他们的建议。

UoM注册主任Rita John、UoM副校长召集委员会成员S. Armstrong、高等教育委员会（joint director of planning）Cynthia Selvi，以及高等教育委员会（joint director of planning）R. Thangaraj等人出席了活动。

Unlock these with Subscription The Road Transport Ministry has proposed introducing separate colour schemes for driving licences issued or renewed for Indian and foreign nationals, alongside doing away with affidavits sworn before an executive magistrate or notary as proof of age and address. The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), in draft amendments to the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, has also proposed making it mandatory for driving licences to carry the holder's blood group, mobile number and emergency contact numbers. "Every driving licence issued or renewed by a licensing authority shall be in the form of a laminated or Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) card in Form 7, and the Form shall contain separate formats for driving licences issued or renewed for Indian nationals and foreign nationals, respectively," the draft notification said. The ministry also proposed accepting affidavits and life insurance policies as proof of age and address to prevent misuse. It has proposed raising the qualifying threshold for the safe-driving tutorial assessment from 60-75%, alongside a fee waiver for select online driving licence services completed via Aadhaar authentication. A senior official said the proposed changes to driving licence rules are aimed at tightening assessment requirements. MoRTH, in draft amendments to the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, has proposed that the safe-driving tutorial should run for at least 30 minutes. Under the proposal, licensing authorities would have to approve or reject applications to change driving licence particulars, including name and address, within 15 days, with reasons for rejection. It also proposed removing charges for changes in personal details, including the applicant's name and address. The draft rules also specify documents that applicants can use as proof of identity, age and residence. The list includes Aadhaar, passport, voter identity card, e-ration card, birth certificate, among other documents. Under the proposal, every driving licence issued or renewed by a licensing authority will be in a laminated or Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) card in Form 7. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——白宫周五宣布，美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普促成俄罗斯与乌克兰即将在饱受战火摧残的乌克兰城市奥列什基停火，以便运送人道主义援助并疏散平民。白宫称，梅拉尼娅·特朗普启动了相关磋商，她与一名代表直接同俄乌领导层合作，确定停火条款。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — First lady Melania Trump has brokered an upcoming ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the war-ravaged Ukrainian city of Oleshky to allow for humanitarian aid and the evacuation of civilians, the White House announced on Friday. The White House said Melania Trump had initiated the discussions and that she and a representative worked directly with Russian and Ukrainian leadership to define the terms of the ceasefire. “Under our agreement: first a ceasefire will be put in place; second, humanitarian aid will be delivered to Oleshky; and third, civilians will be allowed to move freely out of Oleshky,” Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine’s human rights ombudsman, said in a video message posted online. “The operation will be carried out gradually and is extremely challenging to implement. I will therefore keep Ukrainian society informed and share the results of the operation.” Russia’s chief of the general staff, Gen. Valery Gerasimov, said Russian forces “will cease fire on the Kherson axis” starting at 4 a.m. Tuesday Moscow time “in connection with the humanitarian operation near Oleshky.” The Russian forces will also carry out “engineering reconnaissance” and ensure “safe movement of the humanitarian convoy” into the city, Gerasimov said. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov also said Moscow was grateful to the first lady and that effort was discussed during the latest call between Russian President Vladimir Putin and President Donald Trump, he said. Peskov said "those who want to leave it would be able to do so.” He would not say whether those who evacuate will be taken to Russia- or Ukraine-held territory. He also demurred when asked how long the evacuation will last, saying only it would likely take several days. Melania Trump has made helping children in conflict one of her signature issues and hosted a U.N. Security Council meeting on the issue earlier this year. She has written Putin to work on efforts to reunite families with children who have been displaced by the war . “What she wants to do is save children, and that’s her focus,” the president said of the first lady during a question-and-answer exchange with journalists in Washington. The development comes as tensions have increased to new highs between the Trump administration and Ukraine’s government. Kyiv has faced restrictions on the satellite internet system that it relies on to knock down Russian attacks, with Trump and other top U.S. officials sending mixed messages about who was responsible for throttling the Elon Musk-made Starshield system. Trump also has recently waived new Russian sanctions , reached an agreement with Russia to import diesel and pushed Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to make a deal to end the war that began in February 2022. In renewed efforts to revive the peace process , Trump envoy Steve Witkoff traveled to Norway this week for talks with Zelenskyy before meeting with Putin in St. Petersburg, Russia. Zelenskyy did not mention the ceasefire in Oleshky during a remote appearance at the Hudson Institute, a Washington think tank. He did note that American Patriot missile interceptors were still on hold and Starshield and Starlink speed limits were still in place. He also spoke of the importance of the United States to renewed diplomatic efforts to end the war, including a possible joint meeting with Trump and Putin. Food and medical supplies have been scarce for months in Oleshky, which sits on the Dnipro River that separates Ukrainian forces from the city’s Russian occupiers. There is no electricity, heat or running water. Roads leading from town are mined and dotted with burned-out cars. Drones buzz overhead. Once a city of about 24,000 residents, Oleshky was captured by Moscow’s forces on the first day of their full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. Its buildings were shelled and burned, and its infrastructure damaged. In June 2023, floodwaters inundated the city after the Kakhovka Dam collapsed from an explosion that an Associated Press investigation found was likely caused by the Russian military. Hundreds of residents were killed. Those left in the city along Ukraine’s southeastern front face death from hunger or disease as another harsh winter looms. Ukraine has appealed repeatedly for a local ceasefire to organize evacuations. Russia, as the occupying power, is obligated by international law to ensure civilians under its control have what they need to survive. Melania Trump said in the White House news release that civilian leaders from Ukraine and Russia will visit Oleshky residents to determine the level of assistance they require. “Residents who wish to evacuate will receive coordinated support and transportation to their preferred destination,” she said. “I anticipate some will want to go to Russia, and some to Ukraine.” Melania Trump also said “an impartial American media organization” will accompany and document Russian and Ukrainian teams on the ground throughout the process. "This will play a significant role in ensuring that the wishes of each family are faithfully respected,” she said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 白宫称，梅拉尼娅·特朗普推动促成俄军占领的乌克兰城市达成停火协议
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——白宫周五宣布，美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普已促成俄罗斯与乌克兰即将在饱受战争蹂躏的乌克兰城市奥列什基停火，以便运送人道主义援助并撤离平民。白宫表示，梅拉尼娅·特朗普启动了相关讨论，她和一名代表直接与俄罗斯和乌克兰领导层合作，确定停火条件。乌克兰人权专员德米特罗·卢比涅茨在网上发布的视频中说：“根据我们的协议：第一，实施停火；第二，向奥列什基运送人道主义援助；第三，允许平民自由撤离奥列什基。”“行动将逐步实施，执行难度极大。因此，我会让乌克兰社会了解情况，并通报行动成果。”俄罗斯总参谋长瓦列里·格拉西莫夫将军说，从周二莫斯科时间凌晨4时开始，俄军将“在赫尔松轴线上停止交火”，以配合奥列什基附近的人道主义行动。格拉西莫夫说，俄军还将进行“工程侦察”，确保“人道主义车队”安全进入该市。克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫也表示，莫斯科感谢这位第一夫人，并称双方在俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京与唐纳德·特朗普总统最近一次通话中讨论了相关努力。佩斯科夫说：“那些想离开的人将能够离开。”当被问及撤离人员将被送往俄罗斯控制区还是乌克兰控制区时，他不予置评。被问及撤离将持续多久时，他也拒绝回答，只表示可能需要数天。帮助冲突地区的儿童一直是梅拉尼娅·特朗普重点关注的议题之一。今年早些时候，她主持了一场联合国安理会会议，讨论这一问题。她还曾致信普京，推动努力让因战争流离失所的儿童与家人团聚。特朗普总统在华盛顿与记者问答时评价这位第一夫人说：“她想做的是拯救儿童，这就是她关注的重点。”此次进展正值特朗普政府与乌克兰政府之间的紧张关系升至新高度之际。基辅一直受到卫星互联网系统使用限制的影响，该系统是乌克兰打击俄罗斯袭击所依赖的工具；特朗普和其他美国高层对限制埃隆·马斯克旗下Starshield系统的责任归属发出了不一致的信息。特朗普最近还豁免了新一轮对俄制裁，与俄罗斯达成进口柴油协议，并推动乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基达成结束2022年2月开战的协议。为再次推动和平进程，特朗普特使史蒂夫·维特科夫本周前往挪威，与泽连斯基会谈，随后将在俄罗斯圣彼得堡与普京会面。泽连斯基在华盛顿智库Hudson Institute远程出镜时没有提及奥列什基停火。他确实指出，美国爱国者导弹拦截系统仍处于暂缓状态，Starshield和Starlink的速度限制仍然有效。他还谈到美国重新开展外交努力、推动结束战争的重要性，包括特朗普与普京可能举行联合会议。奥列什基位于第聂伯河畔，该河将乌克兰军队与占据该市的俄军分隔开来。数月来，当地食品和医疗物资一直短缺。市内没有电力、供暖和自来水。通往该镇的道路布满地雷，散落着烧毁的汽车。无人机的嗡嗡声不断掠过上空。奥列什基曾有约2.4万名居民，2022年2月俄军全面入侵乌克兰的第一天，该市便被莫斯科军队攻占。市内外建筑遭到炮击和焚烧，基础设施遭到破坏。2023年6月，卡霍夫卡大坝因爆炸坍塌，洪水淹没该市；美联社调查发现，这次爆炸很可能是俄军所为，数百名居民死亡。随着又一个严寒冬季逼近，留在乌克兰东南前线这座城市里的居民面临饥荒或疾病导致的死亡。乌克兰一再呼吁当地停火，以便组织撤离。作为占领国，俄罗斯有义务依据国际法确保其控制下的平民获得生存所需物资。梅拉尼娅·特朗普在白宫新闻稿中说，来自乌克兰和俄罗斯的平民领导人将走访奥列什基居民，以确定他们需要何种程度的援助。她说：“希望撤离的居民将获得协调一致的支援和交通服务，以送往他们选择的目的地。”“我预计有些人希望前往俄罗斯，有些人希望前往乌克兰。”梅拉尼娅·特朗普还表示，一家“公正的美国媒体组织”将在整个过程中随行，记录俄罗斯和乌克兰团队的现场行动。她说：“这将在确保忠实尊重每个家庭的意愿方面发挥重要作用。”

Unlock these with Subscription Rescuers combed through a remote area in the Chinese region of Tibet on Friday (October 23, 2026) after a magnitude 7 earthquake that killed at least 16 people, injured 54 and collapsed hundreds of homes, according to Chinese state media. The disaster struck Nagqu, a city north of Tibet’s capital, Lhasa, which is some 4,800 meters (5,249 yards) above sea level, on Thursday (October 22, 2026). At least 339 homes collapsed, and officials told journalists they were concerned about further building collapses from aftershocks, as well as casualties from rockslides. More than 5,000 people from three local counties were deployed for rescue efforts. Supplies, including 2,000 prefabricated housing units, around 3,400 tents and 2,000 folding beds, as well as flashlights and winter clothing arrived in the region. Local railway authorities have taken emergency action to halt trains passing through the region. The earthquake also caused rockfalls that have forced local authorities to close a section of National Highway 317, allowing only emergency, rescue and official support vehicles through as crews worked to clear debris, according to Xinhua. Intermittent snows are expected in the earthquake region over the next three days, Xinhua said. Chinese President Xi Jinping called for all-out efforts in rescue operations and medical relief work, issuing instructions Friday morning. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 韩国铁路车辆和电动巴士制造商Woojin Industrial Systems于周五表示，公司入选今年韩国就业和劳动部表彰计划，以表彰创造就业机会和改善工作条件的企业。Woojin表示，在首尔 metropolitan area以外投资推动了其就业增长。Woojin将这一增长归因于与当地大学和职业高中开展的投资与招聘合作。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Woojin Industrial Systems, a Korean manufacturer of railway vehicles and electric buses, said Friday it has been selected for this year’s Ministry of Employment and Labor recognition program honoring companies for creating jobs and improving working conditions. The annual program recognizes 100 private companies and provides administrative and financial incentives to encourage hiring and improve workplace practices. Woojin said investment outside the Seoul metropolitan area helped drive its employment growth. It completed a 47 billion won ($35 million) electric bus factory in Gimcheon, North Gyeongsang Province, supporting efforts to recruit about 100 local workers. The proportion of the company’s workforce covered by employment insurance rose to 673 at the end of 2025 from 578 in 2024. Woojin attributed the growth to investment and recruitment partnerships with local universities and vocational high schools. Of its 140 new hires in 2025, 64 were aged 15 to 34. The company said expanded recruitment of women and support for maternity protection measures helped reduce its female employee turnover rate from 18 percent to 5.3 percent over the past three years. Woojin also said it uses anonymized applications and artificial intelligence analysis based on job descriptions to screen candidates. All 57 recruits evaluated during their probationary periods in 2025 were appointed to regular positions. For older employees, the company rehired all four workers who reached retirement age in 2024 under new contracts following job suitability assessments, without a break in employment. Its wage adjustment system for senior workers links reductions to performance rather than imposing a uniform 30 percent cut. Employees receiving an A rating face no reduction, while those rated B face annual cuts capped at 2 percent, with cumulative reductions limited to 10 percent over five years. Employee benefits include up to 800,000 won annually for professional qualifications, free dormitory accommodation, commuter buses and lunches. Workers can take leave in two- or four-hour increments, and one hour of every two hours spent studying languages counts toward scheduled working time. “This recognition reflects the efforts of all our employees to foster mutual respect and pursue sustainable growth," Woojin Industrial Systems Managing Director Lee Heung-pyo said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Woojin因创造就业机会和改善工作条件而获得认可
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国铁路车辆和电动公交车制造商Woojin Industrial Systems周五表示，该公司入选今年韩国雇佣劳动部表彰计划，以嘉奖创造就业机会和改善工作条件的企业。这项年度计划表彰100家私营企业，并提供行政和财政激励，鼓励企业招聘员工和改善工作场所实践。Woojin表示，在首尔 Metropolitan area 以外投资有助于推动其就业增长。该公司在庆尚北道金泉建成一座投资470亿韩元（3500万美元）的电动公交车工厂，支持招聘约100名当地员工。公司享有雇佣保险的员工比例从2024年的578人上升至2025年底的673人。Woojin将这一增长归因于与当地大学和职业高中开展投资及招聘合作。公司2025年新增的140名员工中，有64人年龄在15至34岁之间。该公司表示，扩大女性招聘并支持 maternity protection 措施，帮助其女性员工流失率在过去三年中从18%降至5.3%。Woojin还表示，公司采用匿名申请和基于职位描述的人工智能分析来筛选候选人。2025年在试用期内接受评估的57名招聘人员全部获聘为正式员工。对于年长员工，公司在2024年对4名达到退休年龄的员工进行岗位适配评估后，以新合同重新聘用他们，期间不中断 employment。公司的资深员工工资调整制度将减薪与绩效挂钩，而不是统一削减30%。获得A级的员工不削减工资，获得B级的员工每年减薪上限为2%，五年累计减薪上限为10%。员工福利包括每年最高800,000韩元的职业资格证书补贴、免费宿舍住宿、通勤巴士和午餐。员工可以按两小时或四小时为单位请假，每学习两小时语言，其中一小时计入规定工作时间。“此次表彰反映了我们全体员工为促进相互尊重和追求可持续增长所作的努力，”Woojin Industrial Systems董事总经理Lee Heung-pyo表示。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Science Minister Bae Kyung-hoon said Friday his ministry will make efforts to devise measures to address problems caused by smart glasses, vowing to speed up related guidelines already under preparation. Bae made the remarks during a parliamentary audit held at the National Assembly when a lawmaker asked whether the ministry is planning to deal with concerns over covert filming and privacy violations caused by such devices. "We will swiftly come up with response measures from a pan-ministerial level," Bae said, noting that President Lee Jae Myung pointed out the issue during a recent Cabinet meeting. "We are preparing a guideline but will speed up its progress." Smart glasses are wearable computer frames that integrate digital technology into eyewear, allowing people to film objects with a camera installed on the glasses, or show visual information on the lenses. The technology was brought to the mainstream mostly by Ray-Ban from Meta Platforms Inc. The device has recently face scrutiny in Korea, as a few people have been caught using them to cheat in academic and technical exams or illegally film others. Several countries, including Norway, Australia and the European Union, are already weighing possible restrictions on such devices. Authorities found a total of three cases of illegal filming utilizing smart glasses as of this year, according to data from Rep. Lee Jeong-heon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 科学部长承诺制定跨部门措施监管智能眼镜
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 科学部长裴庆勋周五表示，该部将努力制定措施，应对智能眼镜引发的问题，并承诺加快制定目前正在筹备的相关指南。在韩国国会举行的一场国会议员质询中，有议员询问该部是否计划处理此类设备可能带来的秘密拍摄和侵犯隐私等问题，裴庆勋作出了上述表态。裴庆勋说：“我们将迅速从跨部门层面制定应对措施。”他还指出，李在明总统最近一次内阁会议上提到了这一问题。他说：“我们正在制定一项指南，但将加快进度。”智能眼镜是一种将数字技术融入眼镜的可穿戴计算机框架，人们可以利用安装在眼镜上的摄像头拍摄物体，也可以在镜片上显示视觉信息。这项技术主要由Meta Platforms Inc.旗下的Ray-Ban推向大众市场。近来，这种设备在韩国受到严格审查，因为有人被发现利用智能眼镜在学业考试和技术考试中作弊，或非法拍摄他人。包括挪威、澳大利亚和欧盟在内的多个国家已经考虑对此类设备实施可能的限制。据韩国执政党民主党议员李正勋提供的数据，截至今年，当局共发现3起利用智能眼镜非法拍摄的案件

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title: Korea marks first Hansik Day, unveils vision for Korean cuisine
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary: Korea held its first official ceremony for Hansik Day, a newly designated national commemorative day for Korean cuisine, in Seoul on Friday. The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs co-hosted the ceremony at the National Museum of Korea, a day before Hansik Day on Saturday. The first is preserving fermented foods such as kimchi and jang, Korea’s soybean-based sauces and pastes, and promoting their scientific value.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 韩国周五在首尔举行首个韩食日正式纪念日庆祝活动。韩食日是韩国新指定的韩国料理国家纪念日。韩国农业、食品和农村事务部与外交部于周五在韩国国立中央博物馆联合主办了庆祝活动，为周六韩食日前一天举行。此次活动旨在传承泡菜和酱类等发酵食品，即韩国以大豆为基础制成的酱汁和酱料，并推广其科学价值。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Korea held its first official ceremony for Hansik Day, a newly designated national commemorative day for Korean cuisine, in Seoul on Friday. At the event, officials outlined plans to turn the country’s food into a global cultural and industrial asset. The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs co-hosted the ceremony at the National Museum of Korea, a day before Hansik Day on Saturday. “Hansik” is the Korean word for Korean food. Marked on Oct. 24, the date combines the number 10, which the government says stands for completion and harmony, with the 24 solar terms. These are the traditional seasonal markers that have long guided farming in Korea. About 300 people attended the ceremony. They included diplomats from 15 countries, food industry officials, academics and certified food masters, who are artisans the government recognizes for preserving traditional food-making techniques. Vice Agriculture Minister Kim Jong-gu presented four policy directions. The first is preserving fermented foods such as kimchi and jang, Korea’s soybean-based sauces and pastes, and promoting their scientific value. The second is using artificial intelligence and food technology to innovate Korean cuisine. The third is promoting culinary tourism that links regional food culture with travel. The fourth is strengthening Korean restaurants overseas and training professionals for them. “We will spare no policy support so that Korean food is loved more in daily lives around the world and its growth leads to a real leap for agriculture and the food and restaurant industries,” Kim said. Lim Sang-woo, the foreign ministry’s ambassador for public diplomacy, called Korean food a diplomatic asset. He said the ministry is expanding K-food diplomacy through more than 170 overseas missions. Six honorees received ministerial citations. Among them were Buddhist temple food master the Venerable Seonjae, chef Lee Jun of the Michelin-starred Seoul restaurant Soigné, Huh Young-man, the cartoonist behind the food comic “Sikgaek,” and the sauce maker Sempio Foods. HANSIK FESTA, a three-day festival, opened alongside the ceremony and runs through Sunday around the museum’s Mirror Pond. It features cooking demonstrations by chefs and food masters, cooking classes, pop-up stores and a flea market. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 韩国纪念首个韩食日，展示韩国料理发展愿景
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 韩国周五在首尔举行首个官方韩食日纪念仪式。韩食日是韩国新设立的韩国料理国家纪念日。仪式上，官员概述了将韩国食品打造为全球文化和产业资产的计划。韩国农业食品 rural事务部和外交部于周六韩食日前一天，在国立韩国博物馆联合主办了仪式。“Hansik”是韩语中对韩国料理的称呼。韩食日为10月24日，这一日期将数字10与二十四节气结合起来；政府表示，10象征圆满与和谐。二十四节气是韩国长期以来指导农耕的传统季节节点。约300人参加了仪式，其中包括来自15个国家的外交官、食品行业官员、学者和认证食品大师；这些大师是政府认可的传承传统食品制作技艺的匠人。韩国农业食品 rural事务部副部长金钟九提出四项政策方向。第一是保护泡菜和酱类等发酵食品；酱类是韩国以大豆制成的酱料和酱膏，同时推广其科学价值。第二是利用人工智能和食品技术推动韩国料理创新。第三是推广将地方饮食文化与旅行相结合的美食旅游。第四是加强海外韩国餐厅实力，并为其培训专业人员。金钟九说：“我们将不遗余力地提供政策支持，让韩国料理在世界各地的日常生活中更受喜爱，使其发展带动农业、食品和餐饮业实现真正飞跃。”外交部公共外交大使林相伍称韩国料理是一种外交资产。他说，外交部正通过170多个驻外机构拓展K-food外交。6名获表彰者获得了部长嘉奖，其中包括佛教寺院料理大师仙哉大师、首尔米其林星级餐厅Soigné主厨李俊、饮食漫画“Sikgaek”作者漫画家许永万，以及酱料制造商Sempio Foods。为期3天的HANSIK FESTA与仪式同步开幕，活动持续至周日，在博物馆倒影池周边举行。活动包括厨师和食品大师现场烹饪示范、烹饪课、快闪店和跳蚤市场。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The culture minister said Friday his ministry will conduct a thorough audit of the former National Museum of Korea chief who resigned over the museum's controversial display of a misattributed calligraphic work from his private collection. You Hong-june stepped down earlier this week after the museum wrongly displayed the calligraphy in an exhibition as the work of a Korean independence activist. The piece was later identified as the work of a prominent pro-Japanese collaborator during Japan's 1910-45 colonial rule of Korea and turned out to be from You's own private collection. "I think the incident has damaged the reputation and public trust the museum has built over the years," Culture Minister Chae Hwi-young told a lawmaker during a parliamentary audit of the ministry. "The ministry will seek to restore public confidence through a rigorous investigation." The audit will not be limited to the alleged abuse of authority by the former director but will also look into "every procedure involved in the management and authentication of the exhibit at issue," Chae added
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 文化部将审计前博物馆馆长错署书法作品事件
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国文化部长周五表示，该部将对前国立中央博物馆馆长展开全面调查。此人因博物馆有争议地展出其私人收藏中一件归属判断错误的书法作品而辞职。柳贤俊本周早些时候卸任，此前博物馆在一场展览中错误地将这幅书法标为韩国独立运动人士的作品。该作品后来被认定为日本于1910年至1945年殖民统治朝鲜期间一名 prominent 亲日 collaboration者的作品，并被发现来自柳贤俊本人的私人收藏。文化部长车wi-young在对该部进行议会审计时告诉一名议员：“我认为，这起事件损害了博物馆多年来建立的声誉和公众信任。”“该部将通过严格调查努力恢复公众信心。”车wi-young补充说，审计不仅限于调查前馆长涉嫌滥用职权的行为，还将调查“涉及涉案展品管理和鉴定的每一道程序”。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title: US colleges scale back cooperation with Chinese institutions after Pentagon's push
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: This decision comes as the Pentagon's push to tighten oversight of US universities' research ties with China has led to more than 80 termination-related actions across 30 American colleges, with some schools scaling back academic partnerships with Chinese institutions. In August, the US Department of Defence ordered 30 universities to audit their foreign research ties, including partnerships with Chinese institutions on its blacklist, or risk losing federal funding.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 这一决定出台之际，五角大楼正推动加强对美国高校与中国研究关系的监管；此举已导致美国30多所高校采取80多项终止合作的相关措施，一些学校还缩减了与中国机构之间的学术伙伴关系。今年8月，美国国防部命令30所高校审查其外国研究关系，包括与列入黑名单的中国机构之间的合作关系，否则可能失去联邦资助。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: Virginia Tech is accelerating the closure of a joint undergraduate program with China's Xidian University, bringing forward the end of a partnership that it had previously planned to keep running until 2029, according to a university spokesperson and a copy of an official letter reviewed by the South China Morning Post. This decision comes as the Pentagon's push to tighten oversight of US universities' research ties with China has led to more than 80 termination-related actions across 30 American colleges, with some schools scaling back academic partnerships with Chinese institutions. Margaret Ashburn, Virginia Tech's associate director of media relations and deputy spokesperson, shared a copy of the school's letter to the Pentagon and told SCMP that the university had recently decided to accelerate the closure of the joint program with Xidian University. "The program noted in the letter will officially terminate after the current academic year," she said. In the letter, the school said it had previously decided in 2025 to wind down the program and stopped admitting new students, but enrolled students could continue until 2029. It remains unclear how the accelerated shutdown will affect students currently enrolled in the program. SCMP has contacted Xidian University for comment but has not received a response. To address security concerns before the complete shutdown, the letter also said Virginia Tech had introduced significant mitigation measures for the program, including research security briefings before and after travel for faculty members visiting Xidian University. Additionally, addressing another flagged relationship, Virginia Tech clarified that recent joint publications with Shandong University - added to the US blacklist in July 2026 - stemmed from earlier work, noting that active collaboration had already been discontinued in 2019. The Chinese embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Beijing has consistently opposed the restrictions. Liu Chang, a spokesperson for the Chinese embassy, previously accused the US of overstretching the concept of national security and politicising academic exchanges. Liu said scientific research required openness, that restricting normal exchanges would also harm American researchers and institutions, and urged Washington to abandon its "Cold War mentality" and ensure a fair and open environment. In August, the US Department of Defence ordered 30 universities to audit their foreign research ties, including partnerships with Chinese institutions on its blacklist, or risk losing federal funding. The blacklist, formally known as the Section 1286 list, contains 130 foreign organisations, mostly Chinese but also Russian and Iranian, that Washington deems national security risks. Many leading Chinese civilian universities, including Fudan University, are on the Section 1286 list. The August announcement did not name the universities, but media reports citing a US official said the 30 included some of the country's most prestigious institutions, such as Harvard, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Cornell University. The Pentagon announced on Monday that the 30 universities had completed initial audits of their foreign research ties and addressed relationships flagged as potential security risks. It also named seven universities for their swift actions in compliance with the audit: Oklahoma State University, Pennsylvania State University, the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, the University of South Carolina, the University of Southern California, the University of Texas at Austin and Virginia Tech. The department did not provide further details about the termination-related actions. Emil Michael, undersecretary of defence for research and engineering, said institutions that failed to meet research security standards were on notice and would not receive taxpayer funding if their partnerships endangered US troops or the country's technological edge. "Our work will continue," Michael said. "The department commends the institutions that took decisive action to mitigate relationships that could expose American research to foreign exploitation." There has been pushback elsewhere, too. According to The Washington Post, a Pentagon official asked Southern Illinois University Carbondale this summer to audit its ties with nine Chinese entities. The university initially saw no need to cut ties but later ended an agreement with Shenyang Aerospace University, which had recently been added to the blacklist, at the department's insistence. Drake University in Iowa said in September that the government had raised concerns about its joint degree program with Qingdao University, which Drake said was not on the list. The audits are not the end of the effort. The department said it would continue working with Congress, including the armed services and appropriations committees in both chambers, as well as the House Select Committee on China
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国五角大楼施压后，美国高校缩减与中国机构的合作
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh:
据弗吉尼亚理工大学发言人以及《南华早报》查阅的一封官方信函副本，弗吉尼亚理工大学正在加快终止与西安电子科技大学共同开展的本科合作项目，比原计划提前结束这一延续至2029年的合作关系。

随着五角大楼加强监管美国高校对华研究合作，30多所美国高校已采取80多项与终止合作有关的措施，其中一些学校正在缩减与中国机构之间的学术合作。弗吉尼亚理工大学媒体关系副主任兼副发言人Margaret Ashburn向《南华早报》提供了该校致五角大楼的信函副本，并表示学校最近决定加快终止与西安电子科技大学的联合项目。

她说：“信函中提到的项目将在本学年度结束后正式终止。”

信函称，学校曾于2025年决定逐步结束该项目，并停止招收新生，但已入学的学生原本可以继续学习至2029年。目前尚不清楚加速关闭该项目会如何影响目前正在就读的学生。《南华早报》已联系西安电子科技大学置评，但尚未收到回应。

为在项目完全关闭前解决安全疑虑，信函还表示，弗吉尼亚理工大学已为该项目采取多项重要缓解措施，包括在前往西安电子科技大学访问的教职人员出发前及返回后，为他们安排研究安全简介。此外，弗吉尼亚理工大学还就另一项被列为审查对象的合作关系作出说明，称该校近期与山东大学联合发表的论文源于此前开展的工作，实际合作已于2019年停止。山东大学于2026年7月被美国列入黑名单。

中国驻华盛顿大使馆没有立即回应置评请求。北京一贯反对这些限制措施。中国大使馆发言人刘昌此前指责美国过度延伸国家安全的概念，并将学术交流政治化。

刘昌表示，科学研究需要开放，限制正常交流也会损害美国研究人员和机构，并敦促华盛顿放弃“冷战思维”，确保营造公平开放的环境。

今年8月，美国国防部要求30所高校审查其外国研究合作关系，包括与列入黑名单的中国机构之间的合作，否则可能失去联邦资金。这份黑名单正式名称为“第1286条清单”，包含130个被华盛顿视为国家安全风险的外国机构，其中大多数来自中国，也包括俄罗斯和伊朗的机构。

包括复旦大学在内的许多中国顶尖公立大学均被列入“第1286条清单”。8月发布的公告没有点明这些高校，但援引一名美国官员的媒体报道称，30所高校中包括哈佛大学、麻省理工学院和康奈尔大学等该国最负盛名的部分院校。

五角大楼周一宣布，这30所高校已完成对外国研究合作关系的初步审查，并处理了被列为潜在安全风险的合作关系。国防部还表彰了7所迅速采取行动配合审查的高校：俄克拉何马州立大学、宾夕法尼亚州立大学、北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校、南卡罗来纳大学、南加州大学、得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校和弗吉尼亚理工大学。

国防部没有进一步说明这些终止合作的措施。

负责研究与工程的国防部副部长Emil Michael表示，未能达到研究安全标准的机构已收到警告；如果其合作关系危及美军或美国的技术优势，这些机构将无法获得纳税人资金。

Michael说：“我们的工作将继续。国防部表彰那些果断采取行动，缓解可能使美国研究受到外国利用的合作关系的机构。”

其他方面也出现了反对。据《华盛顿邮报》报道，五角大楼一名官员今年夏天要求南伊利诺伊大学卡本代尔分校审查其与9个中国机构的合作关系。该大学最初认为没有必要切断联系，但后来在国防部坚持要求下，终止了与沈阳航空航天大学的协议；该校近期刚被列入黑名单。

爱荷华州德雷克大学9月表示，政府对其与青岛大学的联合学位项目提出了担忧，而德雷克大学称青岛大学并不在该清单上。

这些审查并非这项工作的终点。国防部表示，将继续与国会合作，包括与众议院和参议院两院的军事委员会及拨款委员会，以及众议院中国问题特别委员会合作……
