The Russian leader has agreed “in principle” to resume the talks after Nov. Witkoff's talks with Putin about Moscow’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine took place as Trump pushed Kyiv to make a deal that stops the fighting.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京周三同意下个月与华盛顿和基辅恢复三方谈判，以结束乌克兰战争，克里姆林宫一名官员说。俄罗斯领导人原则上同意在11月后恢复谈判。维特科夫与普京关于莫斯科全面入侵乌克兰的会谈是在特朗普敦促基辅达成停止战斗协议之际进行的。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed Wednesday to resume three-way negotiations next month with Washington and Kyiv aimed at ending the war in Ukraine, a Kremlin official said. The Russian leader has agreed “in principle” to resume the talks after Nov. 10, Putin’s foreign affairs adviser Yuri Ushakov told reporters following a meeting in St. Petersburg between Putin and U.S. President Donald Trump’s envoy Steve Witkoff. The talks will focus on “building a security system for Russia and Ukraine after the conflict ends,” Ushakov said. Witkoff's talks with Putin about Moscow’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine took place as Trump pushed Kyiv to make a deal that stops the fighting. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has insisted that only a summit of leaders can break the impasse. The two armies remain locked on the battlefield, and the two countries pummel each other with daily long-range strikes. Representatives of the three countries held three rounds of negotiations early this year, meeting twice in Abu Dhabi in January and February, followed by further talks in Geneva in February. However, little progress was reported beyond exchanges of prisoners of war as Moscow and Kyiv stuck to their basic demands. Latest proposals to end the war have little of value, Kremlin says The discussion in St. Petersburg lasted about three hours, the Kremlin said, and came a day after Witkoff met with Zelenskyy and some European leaders in Norway's capital, Oslo. The proposals from the Oslo meeting “contained little of real value in the context of resolving the Ukrainian crisis,” Ushakov said. However, he later told Russian state TV that while Moscow isn’t “fully satisfied” with the Oslo proposals, they are a step in the right direction. Witkoff’s meetings suggested leaders are keen to bring new momentum to U.S.-led peace efforts, more than 4½ years after the war began. Efforts by the Trump administration since early last year to end the war have made no significant progress. Zelenskyy said freezing the conflict in Ukraine was the “minimum” required from Russia to bring about an end to the war. “Right now, we have to freeze, and I think this is (the) real way to end this war,” Zelenskyy said in an interview broadcast Wednesday on Fox News. Witkoff and Putin met at St. Petersburg’s Constantine Palace, with Ushakov and Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev also at the table. Trump’s son-in-law, Jared Kushner, joined the discussion via a video link, Ushakov said. Before the meeting, Witkoff said that “there is some degree of momentum” in talks. He thanked Putin for agreeing to send diesel to the U.S., after Trump lifted a ban despite anger from some U.S. lawmakers, adding that the fuel would help reduce prices for American farmers and truckers. Putin said he was ready to consider prospects for the restoration of U.S.-Russia economic ties, adding that he was also prepared to discuss the U.S.-led conflict with Iran. Moscow stands ready to use its relationship with Tehran to help bring peace, he said. Ushakov said that “large-scale joint economic projects that offer significant prospects for cooperation” between Russia and the U.S. were discussed in detail with Witkoff. “Some of these are, in fact, nearing the implementation stage,” he said. In other developments, Russia on Wednesday released a retired American teacher who had been imprisoned on charges of fighting as a mercenary in Ukraine. Witkoff said it appeared to be a goodwill gesture by the Kremlin after Trump asked Putin to free Stephen Hubbard. Putin also met Wednesday with Chinese Premier Li Qiang, who was in St. Petersburg for talks with other Russian officials, the Kremlin said. Russia has cultivated its ties with China, and the two countries last month vetoed a U.S. proposal for U.N. experts to keep monitoring sanctions on Iran. Putin and Witkoff also discussed a possible meeting next month between the Russian, Chinese and U.S. leaders at an economic summit in China, Ushakov said, adding that Beijing is already preparing for it. Norway's prime minister sees a possible ‘new phase’ in talks Witkoff planned to return to Oslo for more consultations after his trip to Russia, Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre said. “I think we may have entered a phase now where the Russians are also looking for opportunities for diplomacy,” Støre told Norwegian broadcaster NRK on Wednesday. Zelenskyy was still in Oslo early Wednesday, where he visited Norway's parliament and met with lawmakers. Zelenskyy said the talks in Oslo and St. Petersburg included discussion of future security guarantees for Ukraine, the fate of occupied territories, postwar reconstruction and the possibility of a ceasefire. At the White House on Tuesday, Trump increased the pressure on Zelenskyy to come to an agreement with Russia as relations between the two leaders have soured again. “We want Zelenskyy to make a deal,” Trump told reporters in the Oval Office. “We’ve given a lot to Ukraine. We’ve gotten absolutely nothing back except grief, death, tremendous monetary loss.” If that doesn’t happen, “I think it’s going to be a very bad thing,” Trump said. Amid fears that Washington was turning its back on Ukraine, Zelenskyy said Kyiv is once again receiving early warnings from its partners about incoming Russian missiles, after recent strikes that he said occurred without enough notice from allies. Russian attacks kill 5 people and wound at least 23 others, Ukraine says Overnight Russian attacks in Kyiv left three people dead and 12 wounded, while 10 residential buildings were damaged, the city’s military administration said. Energy facilities were targeted in Kyiv and three other cities in Russian attacks early Wednesday, Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said. Outside the eastern city of Kharkiv, two people died and 11 others were wounded when drones exploded in a residential area, he said. The Russian Defense Ministry said that overnight its forces struck a warehouse, an electrical substation and a bulk carrier at sea that was headed to the Ukrainian port of Odesa. The Russian Defense Ministry reported Wednesday that its air defenses intercepted 373 Ukrainian drones over multiple Russian regions overnight, as well as the illegally annexed Crimean Peninsula and the Black Sea
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 普京同意恢复与基辅和华盛顿的三方会谈
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京周三同意下个月与华盛顿和基辅恢复三方谈判，以结束乌克兰战争，克里姆林宫一名官员说。俄罗斯领导人已“原则上”同意在11月10日之后恢复谈判，普京的外交事务顾问尤里·乌沙科夫在圣彼得堡举行的普京与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普特使史蒂夫·维特科夫会晤后告诉记者。这些谈判将侧重于“在冲突结束后为俄罗斯和乌克兰构建安全体系”，乌沙科夫说。维特科夫与普京就莫斯科对乌克兰发动全面入侵进行的会谈，正值特朗普敦促基辅达成停止战斗的协议之际。乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基坚持认为，只有领导人峰会才能打破僵局。两军仍僵持在战场上，两国每天都用远程打击相互攻击。三国代表今年年初举行了三轮谈判，1月和2月在阿布扎比会晤两次，随后2月在日内瓦继续会谈。然而，除了交换战俘之外，据报几乎没有取得进展，因为莫斯科和基辅坚持各自的基本要求。克里姆林宫称，结束战争的最新提议没有什么价值。克里姆林宫说，圣彼得堡的讨论持续了约三个小时，这是在维特科夫于挪威首都奥斯陆与泽连斯基及一些欧洲领导人会晤后一天进行的。乌沙科夫说，奥斯陆会晤提出的提议“在解决乌克兰危机方面几乎没有什么实际价值”。不过，他后来告诉俄罗斯国家电视台，虽然莫斯科对奥斯陆提议“并不完全满意”，但它们是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。维特科夫的会晤表明，领导人们渴望为美国主导的和平努力注入新的动力，这场战争已经持续了四年半以上。特朗普政府自去年年初以来为结束战争所做的努力没有取得重大进展。泽连斯基说，冻结乌克兰冲突是俄罗斯为结束战争所需做出的“最低限度”要求。“现在，我们必须冻结冲突，我认为这是结束这场战争的真正途径，”泽连斯基在周三福克斯新闻播出的采访中说。维特科夫和普京在圣彼得堡的康斯坦丁宫会面，乌沙科夫和俄罗斯总统特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫也在场。乌沙科夫说，特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳通过视频连线参加了讨论。会前，维特科夫说谈判“有一定程度的势头”。他感谢普京同意向美国输送柴油，此前特朗普不顾一些美国议员的愤怒取消了禁令，并补充说这种燃料将有助于降低美国农民和卡车司机的价格。普京表示，他准备考虑恢复美俄经济联系的前景，并补充说他也准备讨论美国主导的与伊朗的冲突。他说，莫斯科准备利用与德黑兰的关系帮助实现和平。乌沙科夫说，与维特科夫详细讨论了“为俄美合作提供重大前景的大规模联合经济项目”。他说，“其中一些项目实际上已接近实施阶段。”在其他事态发展中，俄罗斯周三释放了一名退休的美国教师，此人此前因被控在乌克兰作为雇佣兵作战而被监禁。维特科夫说，这似乎是克里姆林宫在特朗普要求普京释放斯蒂芬·哈伯德后释放的善意姿态。克里姆林宫说，普京周三还与正在圣彼得堡与其他俄罗斯官员会谈的中国总理李强会面。俄罗斯一直发展与中国的关系，两国上个月否决了美国关于联合国专家继续监督对伊朗制裁的提议。乌沙科夫说，普京和维特科夫还讨论了下个月在中国的经济峰会上举行俄罗斯、中国和美国领导人可能会晤的问题，并补充说北京已经在为此做准备。挪威首相认为谈判可能进入“新阶段”维特科夫计划在结束俄罗斯之行后返回奥斯陆进行更多磋商，挪威首相约纳斯·加尔·斯特勒说。“我认为我们现在可能已经进入了一个阶段，俄罗斯人也在寻找外交机会，”斯特勒周三告诉挪威广播公司NRK。泽连斯基周三早些时候仍在奥斯陆，他在那里访问了挪威议会并会见了议员。泽连斯基说，奥斯陆和圣彼得堡的会谈包括讨论乌克兰未来的安全保障、被占领土的命运、战后重建以及停火的可能性。周二在白宫，特朗普加大了对泽连斯基的压力，要求他与俄罗斯达成协议，因为两国领导人之间的关系再次恶化。“我们希望泽连斯基达成协议，”特朗普在椭圆形办公室告诉记者。“我们已经为乌克兰付出了很多。除了悲痛、死亡和巨大的金钱损失之外，我们什么都没有得到。”特朗普说，如果这种情况没有发生，“我认为这将是一件非常糟糕的事情。”由于担心华盛顿正在背弃乌克兰，泽连斯基说，基辅再次从其伙伴那里收到关于俄罗斯导弹即将袭来的早期警告，此前他表示最近的袭击没有得到盟友足够的预警。乌克兰称俄罗斯夜间袭击造成5人死亡，至少23人受伤俄罗斯对基辅的夜间袭击造成三人死亡、12人受伤，同时10栋住宅楼受损，该市军事管理部门说。乌克兰总理谢尔希·科列茨基说，俄罗斯周三早些时候的袭击针对了基辅和其他三个城市的能源设施。他说，在东部城市哈尔科夫外，无人机在居民区爆炸，造成两人死亡、11人受伤。俄罗斯国防部说，其部队夜间打击了一个仓库、一个变电站和一艘驶往乌克兰敖德萨港的散货船。俄罗斯国防部周三报告称，其防空系统夜间在俄罗斯多个地区以及非法吞并的克里米亚半岛和黑海上空拦截了373架乌克兰无人机。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — The Pentagon and Lockheed Martin announced Thursday a 10-year agreement for the production of 850 F-35 warplanes, underscoring Washington's long-term commitment to the stealth aircraft. The "framework agreement," which the Pentagon said would "modernize and expand" the F-35 Lightning II Joint Strike Fighter program, still requires congressional approval and funding. The F-35, a joint project between the United States and a number of allies, is one of the world's most advanced military aircraft. There are more than 1,375 F-35s based around the world, according to Lockheed. In exchange for the Pentagon's 10-year commitment, Lockheed Martin will fund $7 billion in projects supporting the F-35s, the Pentagon said. "We have fundamentally changed how we stabilize the American defense industrial base to produce at speed and scale," top Pentagon acquisition official Michael Duffey was quoted as saying in the Pentagon announcement. Lockheed pledged to produce the warplanes at a rate of 156 aircraft per year

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——五角大楼和洛克希德·马丁公司周四宣布达成一项为期10年的协议，将生产850架F-35战机，凸显华盛顿对该隐形战机的长期投入。五角大楼表示，这份“框架协议”将使F-35“闪电 II”联合打击战斗机项目“实现现代化并扩大”，但仍需获得国会批准和拨款。F-35是美国与多个盟友联合研发的项目，也是世界上最先进的军用飞机之一。据洛克希德公司称，全球已有超过1,375架F-35战机部署。作为五角大楼作出10年承诺的交换条件，洛克希德·马丁公司将出资70亿美元，支持F-35战机相关项目。五角大楼在公告中援引其最高级别军购官员迈克尔·达菲的话说：“我们从根本上改变了稳定美国国防工业基础的方式，使其能够快速、大规模地生产。”洛克希德承诺每年生产156架战机

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: South Korea and the United States on Thursday held joint river-crossing drills aimed at enhancing interoperability as part of the annual Hoguk military exercise, the South Korean Army said. Some 540 troops from the allies took part in the drills along the Namhan River in Yeoju, about 65 kilometers southeast of Seoul. The drills mobilized some 130 pieces of equipment, including 10 KM3 amphibious bridging vehicles, ribbon bridge systems and about 50 combat vehicles, such as K2 tanks and K21 armored vehicles. During the drills, the allied forces jointly installed and crossed a bridge spanning a 280-meter section of the river. Army Chief of Staff Gen. Kim Gyu-ha and U.S. Brig. Gen. Robert Brown, commanding general of the 2nd Infantry Division/South Korea-U.S. Combined Division, observed the drills

According to sources familiar with the South Korean military, the lack of comment reflected a reluctance to publicly interpret Hilbert’s remarks, rather than an articulated government position on a broader U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) role.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 首尔市政府周四暂未回应美国第八集团军司令的言论。美军司令暗示，驻扎当地的美军应为超越应对朝鲜威胁的任务做好准备。知情人士称，这一沉默反映出政府不愿公开解读Hilbert的言论，而非政府就驻韩美军更广泛职责提出了明确立场。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Seoul government held off on responding Thursday to remarks by the U.S. Eighth Army commander suggesting that American troops stationed here should be prepared for missions beyond countering North Korean threats. Cheong Wa Dae, the Ministry of National Defense and the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) did not comment when asked about Lt. Gen. Joseph Hilbert’s email interview with the South China Morning Post on the Eighth Army’s readiness for broader regional operations. According to sources familiar with the South Korean military, the lack of comment reflected a reluctance to publicly interpret Hilbert’s remarks, rather than an articulated government position on a broader U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) role. The sources noted whether deployments beyond the Korean Peninsula would require prior consultation between Seoul and Washington has yet to be clarified. In an email interview published by the South China Morning Post on Wednesday, Hilbert said it would be “irresponsible to focus myopically” on threats within the Korean Peninsula or assume that being stationed in South Korea prevented his troops from undertaking other missions. “We view readiness as largely threat-agnostic. If we have a trained, ready force capable of executing the Army’s assigned missions, we can apply that force against whatever threat is required,” he said. Hilbert’s comments drew attention to a potentially broader regional role for USFK as Washington seeks greater flexibility to counter China while calling on Seoul to take more responsibility for deterring North Korea. That shift could allow American troops stationed in South Korea to undertake missions elsewhere, including in a potential Taiwan Strait conflict, although Hilbert did not explicitly mention China or Taiwan
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 美军第八集团军司令谈及美军在韩国的更广泛作用后，首尔方面未作回应
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 首尔政府周四暂未回应美国第八集团军司令的言论。该司令暗示，驻扎在韩国的美军应做好执行朝鲜半岛以外任务的准备。青瓦台、国防部以及联合参谋部（JCS）被问及约瑟夫·希尔伯特中将在《南华早报》进行的邮件采访，以及第八集团军为更广泛地区行动做好准备的立场时，均未发表评论。知情韩国军方消息人士称，这种不评论的做法反映出政府不愿公开解读希尔伯特的言论，而非政府已经明确提出对美军韩朝司令部扩大角色的立场。消息人士指出，在朝鲜半岛以外部署兵力是否需要首尔与华盛顿事先协商，目前尚未得到澄清。希尔伯特在《南华早报》周三刊登的邮件采访中表示，近视地专注于朝鲜半岛内部威胁，或认为驻扎韩国就意味着其部队不能承担其他任务，都是“不负责任的”。他说：“我们基本不针对特定威胁看待战备状态。如果我们拥有一支训练有素、准备充分，能够执行集团军所受任务的部队，就可以根据需要动用这支部队应对任何威胁。”在华盛顿寻求更大灵活性以应对中国之际，希尔伯特的言论使美军韩朝司令部可能承担更广泛地区角色一事受到关注；与此同时，美方要求首尔承担更多遏制朝鲜的责任。这一转变可能让驻扎韩国的美军赴其他地区执行任务，包括可能发生的台海冲突中的任务，尽管希尔伯特没有明确提及中国或台湾

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: 34 student activists convicted of illegal entry into presidential compound, US base
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: A court on Thursday found 34 student activists guilty of trespassing on the then presidential compound and a U.S. military base between 2022 and 2024. In January and October 2024, they attempted to illegally enter what was then the presidential compound in Seoul's Yongsan Ward to demand the resignation of then President Yoon Suk Yeol and a special counsel investigation into then first lady Kim Keon Hee.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 一家法院周四裁定，34名学生行动人士于2022年至2024年间擅闯时任总统官邸和一处美军基地罪名成立。2024年1月和10月，他们曾试图非法进入当时位于首尔龙山区、用于要求时任总统尹锡悦辞职并要求对时任第一夫人金建希进行特别检察官调查的总统官邸。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: A court on Thursday found 34 student activists guilty of trespassing on the then presidential compound and a U.S. military base between 2022 and 2024. The Seoul Western District Court sentenced a senior leader of the Korean Progressive University Student Union (KPUSU) to a suspended four-month prison term and ordered 32 other members to pay fines ranging from 1 million won ($756) to 6 million won. One other member received a deferred sentence of a 1 million-won fine. The students faced multiple charges, including trespassing on a U.S. military installation in Korea in August 2022 and March 2023 to stage rallies against joint military exercises between Korea and the United States. In January and October 2024, they attempted to illegally enter what was then the presidential compound in Seoul's Yongsan Ward to demand the resignation of then President Yoon Suk Yeol and a special counsel investigation into then first lady Kim Keon Hee. The court ruled that the defendants did not act on impulse but conspired in advance, such as by sharing picket signs with the same slogans before entering the U.S. base and gathering at an office to discuss specific execution plans ahead of their attempted entry into the presidential compound. The court said their actions could have posed a threat to national security as the presidential office was located on the same compound as the defense ministry. It further noted that while freedom of expression and assembly is guaranteed as fundamental rights, it is desirable that such rights are exercised within the framework of the legal order
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 34名学生抗议者因非法进入总统官邸和美军基地被判有罪
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 一家法院周四裁定，34名学生激进人士因在2022年至2024年间闯入时任总统府所在地和美国军事基地而被判有罪。首尔西部地方法院判处韩国进步大学生学生会（KPUSU）一名高级领导人缓刑4个月监禁，并责令其他32名成员缴纳100万韩元（756美元）至600万韩元不等的罚款。另一名成员被判处缓刑，并处以100万韩元罚款。这些学生面临多项指控，包括于2022年8月和2023年3月闯入驻韩美军设施，举行抗议韩美联合军演的活动。2024年1月和10月，他们企图非法进入位于首尔龙山区、当时作为总统府所在地的区域，要求时任总统尹锡悦辞职，并要求对时任第一夫人金建慧进行特检调查。法院裁定，被告并非一时冲动行事，而是事先策划并相互串通，例如在进入美国基地前分发印有相同标语的抗议牌，以及在试图进入总统府所在地前聚集在办公室讨论具体行动计划。法院表示，由于总统府与国防部位于同一区域内，被告的行为可能对国家安全构成威胁。法院进一步指出，虽然言论自由和集会自由作为基本权利受到保障，但这些权利宜在法律秩序框架内行使。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: The Korean won strengthened against the U.S. dollar Thursday, after the Bank of Korea (BOK) left its key rate unchanged, but hinted at further tightening. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: Little-known Korean AI firm grabs spotlight as Wall Street's AI litmus test
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Until this week, few on Wall Street had heard of Elice, a small Korean artificial intelligence (AI) neocloud company. It has since expanded, offering modular data centers that can be built in as little as three to six months, along with cloud services.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 截至本周，华尔街几乎无人知晓埃利斯——这家规模不大的韩国人工智能新云公司。此后公司业务不断扩张，提供可在短短三至六个月内建成的模块化数据中心，以及云服务。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Until this week, few on Wall Street had heard of Elice, a small Korean artificial intelligence (AI) neocloud company. Then its shares plunged 32 percent in their Kosdaq debut despite strong institutional investor interest, only to surge nearly 30 percent the following day. Elice's turbulent debut drew an unusual level of attention from international media outlets, including Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC and Barron's, as it raised a multibillion-dollar question: Will the massive sums pouring into AI infrastructure ever pay off? "Its record first-day decline indicated growing investor skepticism toward neoclouds, a fast-growing corner of the AI industry," Bloomberg wrote. "Wednesday's sharp rebound also highlights how fickle market sentiment remains, as strong sector earnings continue to validate growth." When trading began on Tuesday, foreign and institutional investors were quick to sell, offloading a net 9.05 billion won ($6.84 million) and 35.36 billion won worth of shares, respectively. Elice's disappointing debut came amid a sharp deterioration in investor sentiment toward AI infrastructure stocks. Neocloud providers have been particularly vulnerable after U.S.-listed CoreWeave raised concerns about hefty capital spending and the associated debt burden. "Ever since our previous note (about the Elice initial public offering) a month ago, neocloud peers have all de-rated in value significantly by 20-60 percent," said Nicholas Tan, an analyst at Aequitas Research who publishes on Smartkarma. As investor sentiment rebounded following SpaceX's blockbuster third-quarter earnings on Wednesday, Elice surged 29.92 percent to close at 79,900 won. The stock extended its gains on Thursday, climbing 17.15 percent to close at 93,600 won. Despite the two-day rally, shares were still trading just 3.4 percent above their initial public offering (IPO) price of 90,500 won. "Investors are increasingly looking for tangible returns on AI investments, keeping markets in a period of heightened volatility," said Park Soo-hyun, a strategist at KB Securities. Founded in 2015 by three doctoral students at the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, Elice started as an AI coding and education platform. It has since expanded, offering modular data centers that can be built in as little as three to six months, along with cloud services. Elice reported revenue of 39.5 billion won and an operating profit of 5.2 billion won last year. In the first half of this year, revenue reached 34.3 billion won, while operating profit rose to 10.3 billion won, nearly double its full-year 2025 figure
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 这家鲜为人知的韩国人工智能公司在华尔街人工智能考验中崭露头角
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 直到本周，华尔街几乎还没有听说过 Elice，这是一家小型韩国人工智能（AI）新型云服务公司。然而，尽管机构投资者兴趣浓厚，该公司的股票在 KOSDAQ 上市首日仍暴跌32%，次日又飙升近30%。Elice 波动剧烈的上市表现引起了包括 Bloomberg、Reuters、CNBC 和 Barron's 在内的国际媒体机构不同寻常的关注，并提出了一个涉及数十亿美元的问题：涌入人工智能基础设施的大量资金最终能否获得回报？Bloomberg 写道：“其创纪录的首日跌幅表明，投资者对新型云服务商的怀疑日益加剧；这是人工智能行业一个快速增长的细分领域。 周三股价的强劲反弹也凸显出市场情绪依然善变，而该板块持续强劲的业绩仍在印证其增长。”周二开盘后，外国投资者和机构投资者迅速抛售股票，净卖出额分别为90.5亿韩元（684万美元）和353.6亿韩元。Elice 令人失望的上市表现出现在投资者对人工智能基础设施股票的情绪急剧恶化之际。美国上市公司 CoreWeave 因巨额资本支出及相关债务负担引发担忧后，新型云服务商尤其容易受到冲击。Aequitas Research 分析师、在 Smartkarma 上发表评论的 Nicholas Tan 表示：“自从我们一个月前发布关于 Elice 首次公开发行的报告以来，新型云服务领域的同行股价均大幅回调，降幅达20%至60%。”周三，在 SpaceX 公布第三季度创纪录的业绩后，投资者情绪回暖，Elice 股价飙升29.92%，收于79,900韩元。周四，该股进一步上涨，涨幅为17.15%，收于93,600韩元。尽管连续两天上涨，该股价格仍仅比90,500韩元的首次公开发行（IPO）价格高出3.4%。KB Securities 策略师 Park Soo-hyun 表示：“投资者越来越希望从人工智能投资中获得切实回报，市场因此处于高度波动时期。”Elice 由韩国科学技术院的三名博士生于2015年创立，最初是一家人工智能编程和教育平台。此后，公司不断拓展业务，提供可在短至三至六个月内建成的模块化数据中心以及云服务。Elice 去年的收入为395亿韩元，营业利润为52亿韩元。今年上半年，公司收入达到343亿韩元，营业利润增至103亿韩元，接近2025年全年水平的两倍

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title: PHP security flaws alarm Korean government, companies
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: In a statement released Thursday, the Ministry of Science and ICT urged domestic companies and institutions operating PHP-based websites to immediately apply security updates. The warning came after critical vulnerabilities, dubbed PHP2Shell, were found, driving government agencies and companies around the world to shut down websites.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 尼日利亚科学、信息和通信技术部在星期四发布的声明中，敦促运营基于PHP的网站的国内公司和机构立即安装安全更新。此前，人们发现了被称为“PHP2Shell”的严重漏洞，促使世界各地的政府机构和企业关闭网站。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Experts warned that small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and individual business owners operating websites without dedicated cybersecurity personnel could be particularly vulnerable. They strongly recommended prompt security updates, noting that a vulnerability in one company's website could also affect other businesses whose websites are hosted on the same server. In a statement released Thursday, the Ministry of Science and ICT urged domestic companies and institutions operating PHP-based websites to immediately apply security updates. “The latest PHP vulnerabilities could affect a vast number of websites in Korea. An extremely urgent response is required as exploit code is already publicly available," Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Science and ICT Bae Kyung-hoon said. “Conventional preventive measures, such as manual inspections followed by security patches several days later, cannot defend against attacks. Automated response systems are essential, including immediately blocking vulnerable internet-facing assets and proactively applying web application firewall rules.” Popular website-building tools, such as WordPress and Gnuboard, are based on PHP. Many websites, including those of major government agencies, online stores and news outlets, are also built using the language. The warning came after critical vulnerabilities, dubbed PHP2Shell, were found, driving government agencies and companies around the world to shut down websites. The flaws were discovered by cybersecurity researchers, including Google-affiliated Wiz and Calif, which used OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol. They stem from how PHP handles memory, potentially allowing hackers to take control of servers or steal sensitive information without authentication. The flaws received scores of 9.2 out of 10 under the Common Vulnerability Scoring System, placing them in the highest severity category, known as "critical." European cybersecurity authorities have also classified the vulnerabilities as "critical" and urged immediate security updates. They recommended temporarily disconnecting affected systems from the internet or suspending their operations if updates cannot be applied immediately. As the issue becomes a global security threat, the Korea Internet & Security Agency (KISA), the country's cybersecurity authority, issued an advisory around 11 p.m. Wednesday, saying the PHP development team had released security updates to address the vulnerabilities. KISA warned that four PHP versions — 8.2, 8.3, 8.4 and 8.5 — could be affected and urged users to install the latest security updates for their respective versions. It also strongly recommended upgrading from PHP 8.1 or earlier versions, which are no longer supported with security updates. According to cybersecurity firm AhnLab, Korea had an estimated 110,000 hosts (servers) running vulnerable versions of PHP before the security patches were released, the sixth-highest number in the world. Unlike other vulnerabilities, the latest flaws affect PHP itself, meaning even websites built with secure code could be vulnerable, the ICT ministry said. Major IT companies in Korea are also issuing internal emergency alerts and intensifying their security measures. In an internal notice Thursday, one of Korea’s largest communications technology firms warned that the PHP flaws could allow external attackers to execute arbitrary commands and called for security patches to be applied to all publicly accessible PHP-based web services within 24 hours. Experts said the vulnerabilities could expose websites to attacks even if they were built with strong security measures in place. Smaller businesses may face greater difficulties in responding because they often lack dedicated cybersecurity personnel and resources, leaving websites running on outdated PHP versions. The PHP flaws are drawing the industry’s attention, particularly because the risks may extend beyond individual websites if multiple businesses share the same compromised hosting server. "If a company operates a PHP server that hosts multiple businesses, all of them could be affected," Lee said. "If information from multiple customers is stored on the same server, the impact could spread to those customers as well." The science ministry said SMEs and others operating websites through hosting providers should check with their providers to confirm whether security updates have been applied. Domestic hosting companies said they are applying security patches, but cautioned that it is difficult to determine whether all websites are protected because customers use different PHP versions and security configurations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: PHP安全漏洞引发韩国政府和企业担忧
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 专家警告称，没有专门网络安全人员的中小企业及个人网站经营者可能尤其容易受到攻击。他们强烈建议及时进行安全更新，指出一家公司的网站存在漏洞，也可能会影响到在同一服务器上托管网站的其他企业。科学技术信息通信部在周四发布的声明中，敦促运营基于PHP的网站的国内企业和机构立即安装安全更新。副总理兼科学技术信息通信部长裴庆勋表示："最新PHP漏洞可能影响韩国大量网站。由于漏洞利用代码已经公开，必须采取极其紧急的应对措施。""传统的预防措施，例如先进行人工检查、数日后再打安全补丁，无法抵御攻击。必须建立自动响应系统，包括立即阻断暴露在互联网上的存在漏洞的资产，并主动部署网页应用防火墙规则。"WordPress、Gnuboard等流行的建站工具均基于PHP开发。包括主要政府机构、网上商店和新闻媒体在内的众多网站也使用该语言构建。此次警告发布之前，名为PHP2Shell的重大漏洞被发现，促使全球各国政府机构和企业纷纷关闭网站。这些漏洞由网络安全研究人员发现，其中包括谷歌旗下Wiz以及使用OpenAI的GPT-5.6 Sol的Calif。漏洞源于PHP处理内存的方式，攻击者有可能在未经身份验证的情况下控制服务器或窃取敏感信息。这些漏洞在通用漏洞评分系统（CVSS）中获得了10分中的9.2分，属于最高严重等级，即"危急"级别。欧洲网络安全机构也将这些漏洞列为"危急"级别，敦促各方立即安装安全更新。它们建议暂时将受影响的系统从互联网断开，或在无法立即更新时暂停其运行。随着该问题演变为全球性安全威胁，韩国网络安全主管机构韩国互联网振兴院（KISA）于周三晚11点左右发布公告，称PHP开发团队已发布安全更新以修复相关漏洞。KISA警告称，PHP 8.2、8.3、8.4和8.5四个版本可能受到影响，敦促用户针对各自使用的版本安装最新安全更新。该机构还强烈建议从PHP 8.1或更早版本进行升级，因为这些版本已不再提供安全更新支持。据网络安全公司AhnLab的数据，在安全补丁发布之前，韩国估计有11万台主机（服务器）运行着存在漏洞的PHP版本，数量居全球第六。信息通信部表示，与其他漏洞不同，最新漏洞影响的是PHP本身，这意味着即使是采用安全代码构建的网站也可能受到威胁。韩国主要IT企业也在发布内部紧急警报，并加强安全措施。在周四发布的一份内部通知中，韩国最大的通信技术企业之一警告称，PHP漏洞可能允许外部攻击者执行任意命令，并要求在24小时内对所有可公开访问的基于PHP的网络服务安装安全补丁。专家表示，即使网站部署了较强的安全措施，仍可能因这些漏洞遭受攻击。规模较小的企业由于往往缺乏专门的网络安全人员和资源，应对起来可能更加困难，导致网站继续运行在过时的PHP版本上。PHP漏洞正引起业界高度关注，特别是因为如果多家企业共用同一台已被攻陷的托管服务器，风险可能蔓延至更多网站。李某表示："如果一家企业运营的PHP服务器托管着多个商家的业务，所有这些商家都可能受到影响。如果同一台服务器上存储着多位客户的信息，冲击还会进一步波及这些客户。"科技部表示，通过托管服务商运营网站的中小企业及其他用户应与服务商联系，确认其是否已安装安全更新。国内托管企业表示正在安装安全补丁，但同时警告称，由于客户使用不同的PHP版本和安全配置，很难确定所有网站是否都已得到防护……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Coupang, affiliates found to have committed 205 workplace safety violations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Inspections find suspected accident cover-ups, inadequate safeguards at logistics facilities The government said Thursday it will take criminal enforcement action over safety violations at Coupang and its affiliates, after inspections uncovered suspected cover-ups of workplace accidents and inadequate safeguards at logistics facilities. The Ministry of Employment and Labor found 205 violations of the Occupational Safety and Health Act across 105 logistics centers and delivery camps.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国政府周四表示，将对Coupang及其关联公司的安全违规行为提起刑事诉讼，此前检查发现该公司的物流设施涉嫌隐瞒工伤事故且安全防护措施不力。雇佣劳动部在对105个物流中心和配送营地进行的检查中，共发现205起违反《产业安全保健法》的行为。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Inspections find suspected accident cover-ups, inadequate safeguards at logistics facilities The government said Thursday it will take criminal enforcement action over safety violations at Coupang and its affiliates, after inspections uncovered suspected cover-ups of workplace accidents and inadequate safeguards at logistics facilities. The Ministry of Employment and Labor found 205 violations of the Occupational Safety and Health Act across 105 logistics centers and delivery camps. It said 61 violations would be subject to criminal enforcement action, while the remaining 144 would draw administrative fines totaling about 1.96 billion won ($1.48 million). Separate labor inspections also found that Coupang had failed to include key provisions of its performance improvement program (PIP) in its employment rules, in violation of the Labor Standards Act. The ministry said it will issue a corrective order and impose a fine. “Covering up workplace accidents or failing to report them not only prevents workers from receiving proper treatment and compensation, but also hinders efforts to determine their causes and identify and address hazards, making further accidents more likely,” Labor Minister Kim Young-hoon said. “Coupang must use these inspection results as an opportunity to take thorough measures to prevent further legal violations. It must also take seriously the risks of overwork, night shifts and excessive workloads that can accompany fast delivery and more efficient logistics, and earn public trust by adopting management policies that respect workers’ lives and health,” he added. The findings followed inspections of Coupang, a U.S.-based e-commerce giant, as well as Coupang Fulfillment Services, its warehousing and packaging arm, and Coupang Logistics Services, its delivery arm. The fact-finding effort was launched early this year in response to allegations raised by liberal lawmakers and media reports. Safety inspectors identified two cases of suspected concealment of workplace accidents and opened criminal investigations, the ministry said. In one case, a worker was induced to withdraw an application for workers’ compensation medical benefits through measures including a settlement payment. In another, a worker withdrew a similar application following a meeting with management, while the required workplace accident report was not submitted, according to the ministry. Inspectors also uncovered 25 cases of missing or late accident reports, which are expected to draw about 170 million won in fines. Employers must submit a report within one month when a workplace injury or illness requires at least three days off. Other violations included failures to install conveyor safeguards, such as emergency stop devices and covers, and to implement measures to prevent workers from being struck by forklifts. Inspectors also found failures to provide mandatory special health examinations for night workers, as well as deficiencies in the installation and management of rest facilities. After a labor inspection in 2024, the ministry recommended measures to protect workers’ health. Coupang affiliates implemented some, including separating vehicle and pedestrian routes and automating sorting, but others remained unfulfilled, according to the ministry. Officials said they will again press the companies to improve sorting and loading conditions and revise delivery arrangements to reduce workloads and work hours. The ministry’s labor inspections found no cases of workers being dismissed solely for failing Coupang’s PIP. It will also recommend clearer standards for selecting participants, setting targets and allowing employees to challenge decisions. Cover-up allegations were raised over the death of a worker surnamed Jang at Coupang Fulfillment Services’ Daegu center in October 2020. Investigators found that Coupang’s then-chief executive told employees to “make sure there is no record that he worked hard.” Company staff analyzed surveillance footage to log the time the worker spent drinking water, using the bathroom, waiting and talking, while the firm disputed reports linking his death to overwork. His death was subsequently recognized as work-related in February 2021. The ministry will refer the case to prosecutors with a recommendation against indictment because the statute of limitations has expired. Officials also said it would be difficult to establish a criminal concealment offense, noting that the death had been reported and investigators had not confirmed interference with the compensation approval process
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: Coupang及其关联公司被发现存在205项工作场所安全违规行为
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国政府周四表示，将就 Coupang 及其关联公司的安全违规行为采取刑事执法行动。此前调查显示，Coupang 旗下物流设施涉嫌隐瞒工伤事故，安全防护措施不足。雇佣劳动部在 105 处物流中心和配送站点共发现 205 起违反《产业安全保健法》的行为。部方称，其中 61 起将受到刑事执法处理，其余 144 起将处以总额约 19.6 亿韩元（约 148 万美元）的行政罚款。另据专项劳动监察发现，Coupang 未将绩效改进计划（PIP）相关条款纳入其雇佣规则，违反了《劳动基准法》。部方表示将发出整改命令并处以罚款。雇佣劳动部长金英勋表示："隐瞒工伤事故或不按规定上报，不仅使劳动者无法得到及时救治和赔偿，也不利于查明事故原因、排查隐患，反而可能引发更多事故。"他还说："Coupang 应当以此次检查为契机，切实采取措施防止再次违法，并正视快配送和高效率物流背后可能伴随的过度劳动、夜班和高强度作业风险，通过尊重员工生命与健康的管理方针重塑公众信任。"此次检查对象包括总部位于美国的电商巨头 Coupang 及其仓储包装业务 Coupang Fulfillment Services、配送业务 Coupang Logistics Services。调查工作于今年年初启动，缘于部分执政党议员的指控以及相关媒体报道。安全监察人员认定两起涉嫌瞒报工伤事故的案件，并已启动刑事调查。部方称，其中一起案件中，企业通过包括支付和解金在内的方式，促使一名员工撤回工伤医疗补偿申请；另一起案件中，一名员工在与管理层会面后撤回了类似申请，而按规定应提交的事故报告也未上报。监察人员还发现 25 起事故报告缺失或迟报，预计将因此处以约 1.7 亿韩元罚款。法律规定，因工负伤或患职业病需休假三天以上时，用人单位须在一个月内提交报告。其他违规行为包括传送带防护装置（如紧急制动装置和防护盖）缺失，以及未落实防止员工被叉车撞击的措施。监察人员还发现，未按规定为夜班工人提供专项健康体检，以及休息设施的设置与管理存在不足。2024 年劳动监察后，部方曾建议企业采取措施保护员工健康。部方表示，Coupang 关联公司已落实部分建议，包括人车分流和分拣自动化，但仍有部分建议未落实。官员称，将再次督促相关企业改善分拣和装卸条件，调整配送安排以减轻劳动强度和工作时间。此次劳动监察未发现员工仅因未通过 PIP 而被解雇的案例。部方还将建议企业就 PIP 参与者选定、目标设定以及允许员工申诉等环节制定更明确的标准。瞒报指控源于 2020 年 10 月 Coupang Fulfillment Services 大邱中心一名姓张的工人死亡事件。调查人员发现，Coupang 时任首席执行官曾指示员工"务必不留下他拼命工作的记录"。公司职员调取监控录像，记录该员工饮水、如厕、等待、交谈的时长，并否认其死亡与过劳有关的报道。2021 年 2 月，其死亡被认定为工伤。由于诉讼时效已过，部方将向检察机关移交此案并作出不起诉建议。官员同时表示，由于该死亡事件已按规定上报，且调查人员也未确认存在妨碍工伤认定程序的行为，因此难以认定构成刑事瞒报……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Presidential office denies investigation chief's Cabinet meeting attendance compromises impartiality
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The presidential office on Thursday refuted media criticism that the chief of the new investigative body attending Cabinet meetings could compromise impartiality and independence in investigations. The response came amid growing media criticism after Kim Ji-yong, chief of the Serious Crime Investigation Agency (SCIA), attended Tuesday's Cabinet meeting for the first time since taking office, despite the long-held practice of investigation chiefs not attending such meetings.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 总统办公室周四驳斥了媒体关于新调查机构负责人出席内阁会议可能损害调查公正性和独立性的批评。此前，严重犯罪调查局（SCIA）局长金智永自上任以来于周二首次出席内阁会议，而长期以来，调查机构负责人一直不参加此类会议；此事引发媒体批评日益升温。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The presidential office on Thursday refuted media criticism that the chief of the new investigative body attending Cabinet meetings could compromise impartiality and independence in investigations. The response came amid growing media criticism after Kim Ji-yong, chief of the Serious Crime Investigation Agency (SCIA), attended Tuesday's Cabinet meeting for the first time since taking office, despite the long-held practice of investigation chiefs not attending such meetings. In a social media post the previous day, President Lee Jae Myung said chiefs of all government institutions under his command could attend Cabinet meetings, but many media outlets pointed out that such a move could compromise the investigation chief's independence and impartiality in conducting investigations. "The government is strenuously working toward maintaining fairness and political neutrality in investigations and independence in indictments. This principle will remain unwavering going forward," Lee's senior secretary for the press, Seong Ghi-hong, told reporters. The official also made clear that no individual investigation cases or instructions on indictments would be discussed during Cabinet meetings
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 总统办公室否认调查主管出席内阁会议会损害公正性
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 总统办公室周四驳斥媒体对 newly组建的调查机构负责人参加内阁会议可能影响调查公正性和独立性的批评。此前，严厉犯罪调查局（SCIA）局长金智永自上任以来首次于周二出席内阁会议；长期以来，调查机构负责人不参加此类会议的惯例一直受到维持。此前一天，李在明总统在社交媒体上表示，他指挥下的所有政府机构负责人均可出席内阁会议，但许多媒体指出，此举可能影响调查负责人在开展调查时的独立性和公正性。李的总统府新闻高级秘书成起鸿对记者说：“政府正全力维护调查的公平和政治中立，以及起诉工作的独立性。今后这一原则将始终坚定不移。”她还明确表示，内阁会议不会讨论任何具体调查案件或起诉指示

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: WASHINGTON — The Supreme Court on Wednesday refused to allow the Trump administration to immediately enforce new medical restrictions for transgender people in federal prison. The Supreme Court has previously allowed other Trump administration policies for transgender people to move ahead for now, including restrictions on military service and passport sex markers. Attorneys for transgender inmates challenged the policy in court and U.S. District Judge Royce Lamberth ordered treatments to continue.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——美国最高法院周三拒绝允许特朗普政府立即对联邦监狱内的跨性别者实施新的医疗限制。最高法院此前曾允许特朗普政府的其他针对跨性别群体的政策暂时推进，包括限制跨性别者参军和更改护照性别标识等。跨性别囚犯的律师在法庭上对相关政策提出质疑，美国地方法院法官罗伊斯·兰伯思已下令继续提供相关治疗。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — The Supreme Court on Wednesday refused to allow the Trump administration to immediately enforce new medical restrictions for transgender people in federal prison. The decision leaves in place a lower-court block on the policy. It was adopted after an executive order from President Donald Trump, a Republican who has taken several steps to roll back transgender rights during his second term. The brief order did not detail its legal reasoning. Justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas would have allowed the policy to be enforced as the lawsuit played out in lower courts. The Supreme Court has previously allowed other Trump administration policies for transgender people to move ahead for now, including restrictions on military service and passport sex markers. The new policy would halt surgeries, taper off hormones and end social accommodations like makeup and wigs. Prisons would continue to offer mental health services. Attorneys for transgender inmates challenged the policy in court and U.S. District Judge Royce Lamberth ordered treatments to continue. Lamberth, who was nominated to the bench by Republican President Ronald Reagan, pointed out that untreated gender dysphoria can cause severe side effects like depression, anxiety and suicidal thoughts. The Trump administration appealed, arguing that treatments raised security concerns and “could no longer be justified.” A divided appeals court panel left the order in place. About 600 inmates were receiving hormone therapy in 2025, the agency said in court records. The government has not detailed evidence of security problems linked to hormone therapy for transgender inmates during the 30 years it has been provided, they wrote. “This ruling will prevent serious and irreparable harm to plaintiffs and the class while we continue to challenge the government’s unlawful efforts to deny medically necessary healthcare for political reasons," said Aditi Shah, staff attorney at the ACLU of Washington, D.C. The Justice Department did not immediately respond to a message seeking comment. The conservative-majority Supreme Court has previously upheld state laws banning certain medical treatments for transgender youth, and restricting sports participation by transgender athletes in women’s sports
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国最高法院驳回特朗普政府对跨性别囚犯医疗护理的限制
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国最高法院周三拒绝允许特朗普政府立即执行针对联邦监狱跨性别囚犯的新医疗限制规定。这一决定维持了下方法院对该政策的阻止令。该政策是在共和党总统唐纳德·特朗普签署行政命令后出台的；他在第二任期内采取了多项措施，削弱跨性别权利。这份简短命令没有详细说明其法律理由。萨缪尔·阿利托和克拉伦斯·托马斯两位大法官愿意在诉讼于下级法院审理期间允许执行该政策。最高法院此前曾暂时允许特朗普政府针对跨性别者的其他政策继续推进，包括限制服役以及对护照性别标记的规定。新政策将暂停 surgeries、逐步减少激素治疗，并取消化妆品和假发等社会便利措施。监狱仍将继续提供心理健康服务。跨性别囚犯的律师在法院对该政策提出挑战，美国地区法官罗伊斯·兰伯斯下令继续提供治疗。兰伯斯由共和党总统罗纳德·里根提名进入司法系统，他指出，未经治疗的性别焦虑可能引发严重副作用，如抑郁、焦虑和自杀念头。特朗普政府提出上诉，认为这些治疗带来了安全问题，并且“已不再具有正当性”。上诉法院一个意见分歧的合议庭维持了原命令。该机构在法庭记录中表示，2025年约有600名囚犯接受了激素治疗。政府在文件中写道，在跨性别囚犯接受激素治疗的30年间，并未详细说明与该疗法有关的安全问题证据。“这一裁决将防止原告及其所属群体在我们继续挑战政府出于政治目的而非法拒绝提供医疗必要保健服务期间遭受严重且不可弥补的伤害，”华盛顿特区美国公民自由联盟工作人员律师阿迪蒂·沙阿德说。司法部没有立即回应置评请求。保守派占多数的最高法院此前曾支持各州禁止向跨性别青少年提供某些医疗治疗，以及限制跨性别运动员参加女子体育比赛的法律

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.summary_zh: 韩国政府周四表示，今年前九个月共接待1711万名外国访客，同比增长21.5%，有望在10月前超过去年全年的访客总量。韩国文化、体育和旅游部称，仅9月份就接待了206万名外国游客，同比增长21.1%，月度访客量连续保持在200万人以上。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body: Korea welcomed 17.11 million foreign visitors in the first nine months of this year, marking a 21.5 percent increase from the same period in 2025 and puts the country on track to pass last year's full-year total by October, the government said Thursday. According to the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 2.06 million foreign tourists arrived in September alone, up 21.1 percent from a year earlier, keeping monthly arrivals above the 2 million mark. The January-September total compares with 14.08 million a year earlier and 18.94 million for all of 2025. China remained the largest source market with 5.47 million visitors, up 29.2 percent. Japan followed with 3.12 million, up 16.9 percent, while visitors from Taiwan were recorded at 1.86 million, up 32.4 percent. Arrivals from the Americas rose 12 percent to 1.62 million and those from Europe climbed 20 percent to 1.19 million. Foreigners’ card spending in tourism-related sectors, including online purchases, reached 15.94 trillion won ($12 billion) through September. That was up 47.7 percent from 10.79 trillion won a year earlier. More travelers are also bypassing the greater Seoul area, home to the country’s main international gateways, Incheon and Gimpo airports. Some 3.24 million visitors, or 19 percent of the total, came in through regional airports, up 37.4 percent. These include Gimhae in the southeastern port city of Busan, Jeju on the southern resort island of the same name, Cheongju and Daegu. Another 1.58 million, or 9.2 percent, arrived through seaports outside the capital region, including Busan, Jeju, Seogwipo, Yeosu and Gunsan, up 14.5 percent. “Efforts on multiple fronts — raising Korea’s profile as a travel destination, improving the travel environment and expanding tourism content — are bearing fruit,” said Kang Jung-won, deputy minister for tourism policy. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.title_zh: 截至9月，赴韩外国游客超过1710万人次，接近2025年全年水平
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body_zh: 韩国政府周四表示，今年前9个月韩国迎来1711万名外国访客，较2025年同期增长21.5%，有望在10月前超越去年全年访客总数。据韩国文化体育观光部介绍，仅9月份就有206万名外国游客入境，较上年同期增长21.1%，月度入境人数连续保持在200万以上。今年1月至9月的访客总数为1711万人，而上年同期为1408万人，2025年全年为1894万人。中国仍是最大的客源市场，访客达547万人，同比增长29.2%。日本以312万人位居第二，同比增长16.9%；台湾地区访客为186万人，同比增长32.4%。来自美洲的访客增长12%，达到162万人；来自欧洲的访客增长20%，达到119万人。截至9月，外国游客在旅游相关领域的刷卡消费额，包括网购，达15.94万亿韩元（120亿美元），较上年同期的10.79万亿韩元增长47.7%。越来越多的游客也在避开首尔周边地区。仁川机场和金浦机场等韩国主要国际门户均位于该地区。约324万名访客经由地方机场入境，占访客总数的19%，同比增长37.4%。这些机场包括位于东南部港口城市釜山的金海国际机场、位于南部同名度假岛屿的济州机场，以及清州和大邱机场。另有158万名访客经由首都地区以外的海港入境，占总数的9.2%，包括釜山、济州、西归浦、丽水和群山，增长14.5%。旅游政策副 Kang Jung-won 表示：“我们正在多措并举——提升韩国作为旅游目的地的知名度、改善旅游环境、丰富旅游内容——这些努力正在取得成果。”本文在生成式人工智能的协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The air forces of Korea and the United States will sign a letter of intent (LOI) on autonomous combat platform cooperation Thursday to bolster collaboration in the manned-unmanned combat systems, the Korean Air Force said. The LOI will be signed during a meeting between the chiefs of staff of the two countries' air forces — Gen. Son Sug-rag and U.S. Gen. Kenneth Wilsbach, the South's armed force said in a statement. The autonomous collaborative platform (ACP) refers to an autonomous system designed to collaborate with manned aircraft and other unmanned assets to execute air missions. Such manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) is regarded as a cornerstone of next-generation air operations, reducing risks to pilots and significantly boosting the operational range and survival chances for airmen. The collaboration comes as the U.S. Air Force is pushing for the development and operational integration of the unmanned combat aircraft systems. Korea's Air Force is also working to lay the groundwork to secure operational capabilities for the MUM-T systems. Building on the collaboration, the two air forces plan to bolster cooperation to advance operational concepts and interoperability for future MUM-T combat systems, the Air Force said

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——据周三媒体报道，美国驻韩国第八集团军指挥官表示，他的部队必须准备好应对朝鲜半岛以外的威胁，并强调仅仅关注半岛面临的威胁将是“不负责任的”。据报道，希尔伯特表示，“目光短浅地只关注朝鲜半岛的威胁”或“暗示我们因为身在韩国就不能做其他事情”将是“不负责任的”。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — The commander of the U.S. Eighth Army in South Korea has said his troops must be prepared to respond to threats beyond the Korean Peninsula, stressing that it would be "irresponsible" to focus solely on threats facing the peninsula, according to a media report Wednesday. Lt. Gen. Joseph Hilbert made the remarks in an email interview with the South China Morning Post, underscoring the U.S. military's emphasis on strategic flexibility. Hilbert said it would be "irresponsible to focus myopically" on threats on the Korean Peninsula alone or to "suggest that we cannot do other things simply because we are in Korea," according to the report. "We view readiness as largely threat-agnostic. If we have a trained, ready force capable of executing the Army's assigned missions, we can apply that force against whatever threat is required," Hilbert was quoted as saying. "So, we train every day with our Korean allies against our principal threat, while also ensuring we remain available and ready for whatever the nation may require," he added. The remarks come amid growing attention to Washington's push for greater strategic flexibility for U.S. Forces Korea, which could allow American troops stationed in South Korea to undertake missions beyond the peninsula to potentially focus on deterring China. The concept was underscored in the U.S. National Defense Strategy released by the Pentagon in January, which stated that South Korea is capable of taking "primary" responsibility for deterring the North with "critical, but more limited" U.S. support -- a shift that the Pentagon says is in line with America's interest in "updating" U.S. force posture on the Korean Peninsula. Asked about the potential contribution of U.S. forces stationed in South Korea to broader Indo-Pacific deterrence, the Pentagon reaffirmed Washington's commitment to defending South Korea under the bilateral mutual defense treaty. "The United States remains firmly committed to the defense of the Republic of Korea and to fulfilling our obligations under the U.S.-ROK Mutual Defense Treaty," a Pentagon official told Yonhap News Agency. "Our forces in Korea remain focused on maintaining readiness, deterring aggression, and defending the Republic of Korea alongside our ROK allies," the official added
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国第八集团军司令强调为应对朝鲜半岛以外威胁做好准备：报告
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——据周三媒体报道，美国驻韩第八集团军司令表示，他的部队必须做好准备应对朝鲜半岛以外的威胁，并强调只关注半岛面临的威胁将是“不负责任的”。希尔伯特中将在接受《南华早报》电子邮件采访时发表上述言论，强调了美军对战略灵活性的重视。据报道，希尔伯特表示，“只狭隘地关注朝鲜半岛的威胁”或“暗示我们因为驻扎在韩国就不能做其他事情”将是“不负责任的”。希尔伯特说：“我们认为战备在很大程度上与具体威胁无关。如果我们拥有一支训练有素、做好准备、能够执行陆军所 assigned 任务的部队，我们就能将这支部队用于应对任何需要的威胁。”他补充说：“因此，我们每天都与韩国盟友一起针对主要威胁进行训练，同时确保我们始终可供国家调用并做好准备。”这些言论是在人们日益关注华盛顿推动赋予驻韩美军更大战略灵活性之际发表的，这可能允许驻扎在韩国的美国部队执行半岛以外的任务，以潜在地专注于威慑中国。五角大楼1月发布的《美国国防战略》强调了这一概念，该战略指出韩国有能力承担“主要”责任来威慑朝鲜，而美国提供“关键但更有限”的支持——五角大楼称这一转变符合美国“更新”在朝鲜半岛军事态势的利益。在被问及驻韩美军可能对更广泛的印太威慑作出何种贡献时，五角大楼重申华盛顿根据双边共同防御条约保卫韩国的承诺。一名五角大楼官员告诉韩联社：“美国坚定致力于保卫大韩民国，并履行我们根据《美韩共同防御条约》承担的义务。”该官员补充说：“我们在韩国的部队继续专注于保持战备、威慑侵略，并与韩国盟友一道保卫大韩民国。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: WASHINGTON — South Korea and the United States have concluded a multinational maritime mine warfare exercise off Korea's southeastern port city of Busan with 15 partner nations, according to the U.S. Navy. The ninth Multi-National Mine Warfare Exercise 2026 concluded Friday after bringing together mine countermeasures vessels, explosive ordnance disposal personnel, clearance divers and autonomous underwater vehicles, the U.S. Navy said in a press release. The exercise was aimed at strengthening mine warfare capabilities and interoperability among participating navies through combined maritime operations. It included mine-hunting operations, harbor clearance and port-entry scenarios, mine detection and neutralization, and seabed surveys using unmanned underwater systems. The U.S. Navy deployed USS Chief, an Avenger-class mine countermeasures ship, alongside expeditionary mine countermeasures companies and diving detachments. The South Korean Navy participated with mine laying and hunting vessels, supported by specialized clearance divers and underwater disposal teams. The exercise also involved personnel from partner nations, including Japan, Canada, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand, as part of efforts to enhance multinational cooperation in maritime mine countermeasures. Capt. Lee Geun-rok, commodore of South Korea's 52nd Mine Warfare Squadron, said the exercise provided an opportunity to "substantially enhance interoperability and combined operational execution capability in the field of mine warfare." "We are proud to have participated in another successful multi-national interoperability event with our allies and partners, further increasing our mine countermeasure capacity and strengthening our overall capabilities," Capt. G. Scott Wells, commander of the U.S. Navy's Task Force 77, said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国与美国在釜山外海结束多国海上反水雷演习

Scott Wells上校说

Unlock these with Subscription In a letter to Forest, Ecology, and Environment Minister Ramalinga Reddy, PETA India requested the State government to make this the last Dasara to feature live elephants and send captive elephants to sanctuaries where they can live unchained. “Mechanical elephants, which can move their heads, ears, eyes, trunks, and tails, are mounted on wheeled bases and can carry ceremonial idols during processions and rituals, offering an alternative to the use of live animals,” PETA India suggested. The request came after the Jamboo Savari procession, held as part of the Dasara celebrations in Shivamogga on Wednesday, witnessed scary scenes when the elephant carrying the howdah ran helter-skelter within minutes of the procession kicking off. The incident is the latest episode, with similar incidents reported during Dasara celebrations and at elephant camps in the State. In October 2021, elephant Gopalaswamy panicked during the Srirangapatna Dasara after being startled by firecrackers. This had prompted organisers to cancel the elephant procession, and the idol of Goddess Chamundeshwari was instead carried on a silver chariot. In September 2024, elephants Dhananjaya and Kanjan fought inside the palace grounds in Mysuru, sending Kanjan fleeing onto a busy road as onlookers ran for safety. Earlier this year, Kanjan fought with another captive elephant, Marthanda, at Dubare Elephant Camp in Kodagu. A woman tourist was crushed to death in the confrontation, while Marthanda died of his injuries the following day. PETA India Vice-President of Policy Khushboo Gupta said Dasara’s message of the triumph of good over evil should extend to the treatment of animals. “No elephant should be made to suffer or put people’s lives at risk in the name of celebration, especially now that mechanical elephants exist,” she said, adding that the organisation was ready to help the State make the transition. The request comes after Karnataka got its 11th mechanical elephant facilitated by PETA India and Compassion Unlimited Plus Action (CUPA). Unlock these with Subscription The Union Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports has sanctioned ₹1.16 crore for the renovation of the dilapidated Government Youth Hostel near Anna Stadium in Tiruchi. The Youth Hostel, attached to the Mera Yuva Bharat - MY Bharat (formerly Nehru Yuva Kendra) office in Tiruch, was shut during the pandemic and remain closed since 2021. The hostel was established to cater to the needs of students and sportspersons travelling to the city from various districts, now lies abandoned. The 80-bed two-storey building that served both the athletes and students has been neglected for years and is in a dilapidated state due to poor maintenance. Earlier, students who travel to Tiruchi from surrounding places to take part in sports competitions and academic events held at the Bharathidasan University and other colleges in the city, used to stay at the hostel. The Central Public Works Department (CPWD) officials had inspected the structure and based on the inspection a proposal was submitted for renovation at a cost of ₹90.62 lakh. However, the Ministry had asked the officials to prune the estimate to less than ₹20 lakh following which a revised proposal was sent for ₹19.92 lakh. Tiruchi Member of Parliament Durai Vaiko too had inspected the hostel in October 2025 and had raised a question on the issue in Parliament. In a recent order, the Union Minister of Youth Affairs sanctioned ₹1.83 crore for upgrade of the youth hostels at Bhiwani (Haryana), Tiruchi, and Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh). The Tiruchi hostel has been allocated the maximum of ₹1.16 crore under the initiative while ₹36 lakh had been allocated to the hostel in Bhiwani and ₹30.60 lakh for the one at Bhopal. “It is good to note that the Ministry has allocated a substantial sum for the Tiruchi hostel as it required major structural repairs,” said Mr. Durai Vaiko expressing happiness over the allocation of funds. 印度联邦青年事务与体育部已批准拨款116万卢比，用于翻修蒂鲁奇 Anna Stadium 附近破败不堪的政府青年旅舍。该青年旅舍与蒂鲁奇的 Mera Yuva Bharat - MY Bharat（原 Nehru Yuva Kendra）办公室相连，疫情期间关闭，自2021年以来一直处于关闭状态。这家旅舍最初是为满足从各个县前往该市的学生和运动员的需求而设立的，如今已被弃置。这栋拥有80张床位的两层建筑曾同时为运动员和学生提供服务，但多年无人维护，失于修缮，已破败不堪。此前，从周边地区前往蒂鲁奇参加体育比赛，以及参加该市 Bharathidasan University 和其他学院举办学术活动的学生，通常会住在这家旅舍。

中央公共工程部（CPWD）官员曾检查该建筑，并根据检查结果提交了一份翻修提案，预算为9062万卢比。此后，该部要求官员将估算金额压缩至2000万卢比以下，随后又提交了一份总额为1992万卢比的修订提案。蒂鲁奇选区议员 Durai Vaiko 也于2025年10月视察了这家旅舍，并在议会就此事提出质询。

联邦青年事务部长在最近一项命令中批准拨款183万卢比，用于升级位于比wani（哈里亚纳邦）、蒂鲁奇和博帕尔（中央邦）的青年旅舍。根据该项计划，蒂鲁奇旅舍获得的拨款最多，为116万卢比；比wani旅舍获得36万卢比，博帕尔旅舍获得3060万卢比。

Durai Vaiko 先生表示：“很高兴看到，该部为蒂鲁奇旅舍拨付了一大笔资金，因为这处建筑亟需进行大规模结构维修。”他对该笔资金的拨付感到欣慰。

当地 Mera Yuva Bharat 办公室的消息人士证实了拨款事项，并表示 CPWD 将很快着手开展翻修工程。

https://x.com/olenarohoza/status/2113920.title: CHINA DEMANDS A MASSIVE PRICE FROM PUTIN FOR HELPING END THE WAR IN UKRAINE — BEIJING WANTS ALMOST UNLIMITED ACCESS TO RUSSIA’S NATURAL RESO
https://x.com/olenarohoza/status/2113920.snippet:
CHINA DEMANDS A MASSIVE PRICE FROM PUTIN FOR HELPING END THE WAR IN UKRAINE — BEIJING WANTS ALMOST UNLIMITED ACCESS TO RUSSIA’S NATURAL RESOURCES IN EXCHANGE FOR GUARANTEES OF A PEACE DEAL WITH TRUMP.

According to alleged Kremlin insiders, Xi Jinping is prepared to become the main international guarantor of a future peace agreement on Ukraine. However, Chinese leaders have reportedly presented Moscow with a series of economic demands.

Beijing wants to turn its participation in the peace negotiations into long-term advantages for Chinese businesses. The Kremlin is reportedly discussing just how many concessions it will have to make to secure Xi’s support in negotiations with Trump.

China is primarily interested in deposits of rare-earth metals, copper, gold, and other natural resources in Siberia and the Russian Far East.

Beijing is reportedly demanding priority access for Chinese companies to major extraction projects, long-term contracts for raw materials at preferential prices, and special privileges for Chinese investors. Expanding Chinese involvement in Russia’s forestry and energy industries is also reportedly under discussion.

China wants these agreements finalized before any official announcement ending Russia’s war against Ukraine.

Beijing fears that once American sanctions are potentially lifted, Russia could resume extensive cooperation with Western companies, threatening the privileged position Chinese investors have gained in recent years.

Xi therefore wants binding guarantees that would remain in force regardless of any future rapprochement between Moscow and Washington.

For Putin, this creates a serious dilemma.

On one hand, China's participation could significantly increase the chances of reaching an agreement with Trump to end the fighting and gradually lift sanctions.

On the other hand, accepting Beijing’s demands could mean that a substantial share of Russia’s future natural-resource revenues would effectively be tied to Chinese interests for decades.

In other words, Putin may have to mortgage Russia’s natural wealth to China in exchange for a way out of the war he started.

https://x.com/olenarohoza/status/2113920.title_zh: 中国要求普京为帮助结束乌克兰战争付出高昂代价——北京希望几乎不受限制地获取俄罗斯天然气资源
https://x.com/olenarohoza/status/2113920.snippet_zh:
中国就普京协助结束乌克兰战争提出巨额代价——北京希望以几乎不受限制地获取俄罗斯自然资源为交换，换取与特朗普达成和平协议的保证。

据所谓克里姆林宫内部人士透露，习近平准备成为未来乌克兰和平协议的主要国际担保人。不过，据报道，中国领导层向莫斯科提出了一系列经济要求。

北京希望把参与和平谈判转化为中国企业的长期优势。据报道，克里姆林宫正在讨论，为确保习近平支持与特朗普谈判，必须作出多少让步。

中国主要看重西伯利亚和俄罗斯远东地区蕴藏的稀土、铜、黄金及其他自然资源。

据报道，北京要求中国企业优先参与大型开采项目，签订以优惠价格供应原材料的长期合同，并给予中国投资者特殊特权。据报道，扩大中国对俄罗斯林业和能源行业的参与也在讨论之中。

中国希望在任何正式宣布结束俄罗斯对乌克兰战争之前敲定这些协议。

北京担心，一旦美国有可能解除制裁，俄罗斯就可能恢复与西方企业的广泛合作，从而威胁近年来中国投资者所取得的优势地位。

因此，习近平希望获得具有约束力的保证，无论未来莫斯科与华盛顿关系如何改善，这些保证都继续有效。

对普京而言，这造成了一个严峻的难题。

一方面，中国参与谈判可能显著增加与特朗普达成协议、结束战斗并逐步解除制裁的可能性。

另一方面，接受北京的要求，可能意味着俄罗斯未来相当大一部分自然资源收入将在未来数十年里实际上与中国利益绑定。

换言之，普京可能不得不把俄罗斯的自然财富抵押给中国，以换取摆脱他亲手发动的战争的一条出路。

https://x.com/ehimenpaul/status/21137638.snippet:
How Can Armed Groups Move So Freely While Communities Remain Under Threat?

Reports that heavily armed men arrived in convoys at a wedding ceremony in Zamfara State, allegedly linked to a wanted bandit kingpin, have once again raised serious questions about Nigeria’s security system.

Eyewitnesses reportedly said some of the men wore military-style uniforms, while others carried sophisticated weapons. The incident has reignited public concerns over how armed groups continue to operate openly in communities already struggling with insecurity.

Where is the government’s security strategy, and why do residents continue to live in fear? Nigerians deserve answers, not just repeated assurances. When heavily armed groups can reportedly move in convoys without fear, citizens are justified in demanding stronger intelligence, effective security operations, and accountability from those entrusted with protecting lives and property.

For the people of Zamfara, security is not a political slogan. It is the difference between living in peace and going to bed wondering what tomorrow may bring.

How much longer must ordinary Nigerians wait for the safety they deserve?💯😔😈🇳🇬📌

KATSINA STATE MINISTRY OF INTERNAL SECURITY AND HOME AFFAIRS

PRESS RELEASE
23 - 10 - 2026

Bandits Suffer Heavy Casualties as Hunters Repel Attack in Bakori

The Katsina State Government wishes to inform the public of a foiled kidnap operation in Gidan Wawo village, Kakumi Ward, Bakori Local Government Area.

On 23rd October 2026, at about 0128hrs, intelligence revealed the movement of 26 armed bandits on 13 motorcycles, led by one Isiya Kwashen Garwa, towards Dawan Laila forest in Bakori LGA.

Based on the intelligence, all security assets in Bakori LGA were immediately placed on alert to prevent a planned mass kidnap in neighbouring communities.

At about 1331hrs on the same date, reports were received of an attack in which the bandits burnt a private vehicle belonging to one Jamilu Lawal, aged 50, conveying three others travelling to Illela market in Sokoto State from Kakumi ward.

In swift response, hunters from Gidan Wawo were mobilised and engaged the criminals in a gun duel. The operation led to the neutralization of fourteen (14) bandits.

Regrettably, we lost one gallant community hunter, Mohammed Ibrahim Jidda, aged 29, who paid the supreme price in defence of the community. One other hunter, Usman Sunday, aged 25, sustained minor gunshot injuries and is receiving treatment. One victim, Jamilu Lawal, was burnt to death in the vehicle during the rescue operation, while three other victims were successfully rescued.

Intelligence has revealed plans for a possible reprisal attack by the bandits following the heavy casualties suffered. The state government, in collaboration with all security agencies, has put in place appropriate countermeasures to neutralize any further threats in the area.

The government commends the courage and sacrifice of our security operatives and community hunters and assures citizens that we remain resolute in protecting lives and property across the state.

We call on the public to remain calm and continue to provide timely and credible information to security agencies.

Dr. Nasir Mu'azu
Commissioner for Internal Security and Home Affairs, Katsina State

23 October, 2026

The Katsina State Government wishes to inform the public of a foiled kidnap operation in Gidan Wawo village, Kakumi Ward, Bakori Local Government Area.

On 23rd October 2026, at about 0128hrs, intelligence revealed the movement of 26 armed bandits on 13 motorcycles, led by one Isiya Kwashen Garwa, towards Dawan Laila forest in Bakori LGA.

Based on the intelligence, all security assets in Bakori LGA were immediately placed on alert to prevent a planned mass kidnap in neighbouring communities.

At about 1331hrs on the same date, reports were received of an attack in which the bandits burnt a private vehicle belonging to one Jamilu Lawal, aged 50, conveying three others travelling to Illela market in Sokoto State from Kakumi ward.

In swift response, hunters from Gidan Wawo were mobilised and engaged the criminals in a gun duel. The operation led to the neutralization of fourteen (14) bandits.

Regrettably, we lost one gallant community hunter, Mohammed Ibrahim Jidda, aged 29, who paid the supreme price in defence of the community. One other hunter, Usman Sunday, aged 25, sustained minor gunshot injuries and is receiving treatment. One victim, Jamilu Lawal, was burnt to death in the vehicle during the rescue operation, while three other victims were successfully rescued.

Intelligence has revealed plans for a possible reprisal attack by the bandits following the heavy casualties suffered. The state government, in collaboration with all security agencies, has put in place appropriate countermeasures to neutralize any further threats in the area.

The government commends the courage and sacrifice of our security operatives and community hunters and assures citizens that we remain resolute in protecting lives and property across the state.

We call on the public to remain calm and continue to provide timely and credible information to security agencies.

Dr. Nasir Mu'azu
Commissioner for Internal Security and Home Affairs, Katsina State

23 October, 2026

https://x.com/ntanewsnow/status/21137126.snippet:
NIGERIA CUSTOMS, TMPL TEST CUTTING-EDGE CARGO SCANNERS IN CHINA AHEAD OF DEPLOYMENT

The Nigeria Customs Service and Trade Modernisation Project Limited have completed factory acceptance tests for newly acquired non-intrusive inspection equipment and an electronic cargo tracking system in China.

The two-week exercise, led by Deputy Comptroller-General Oluyomi Adebakin, took place at the facility of Nuctech Company Limited.

The team conducted technical verification of the high-tech scanners and tracking system designed to enhance cargo examination and enable real-time monitoring from ports to destinations.

Deputy Comptroller-General Adebakin reaffirmed the commitment of Comptroller-General Adewale Adeniyi to leveraging technology for trade facilitation, revenue optimisation and national security.

She described the tests as a crucial quality assurance process to ensure the systems meet global operational standards before shipment to Nigeria.

She added that deploying the scanners would reduce physical examinations, curb cargo diversion, minimise human contact and improve operational efficiency across Customs formations.

尼日利亚海关与Trade Modernisation Project Limited在中国对最新采购的非侵入式检查设备及电子货物追踪系统完成工厂验收测试

尼日利亚海关与贸易现代化项目有限公司已在中国对最新采购的非侵入式检查设备及电子货物追踪系统完成工厂验收测试。

为期两周的测试由副税务总监Oluyomi Adebakin牵头，在Nuctech Company Limited的设施内进行。

测试团队对高科技扫描设备和追踪系统进行了技术验证。这些设备和系统旨在加强货物查验，并实现从港口至目的地之间的实时监控。

副税务总监Adebakin重申，税务总监Adewale Adeniyi致力于利用技术促进贸易、优化税收收入并维护国家安全。

她表示，此次测试是一项关键的质量保证流程，旨在确保相关系统符合全球运营标准，然后才能运往尼日利亚。

她补充说，部署这些扫描设备将减少人工开箱查验、遏制货物转移、尽量减少人员接触，并提高海关各机构的运营效率。

On October 22, 2026, Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) Governor Olayemi Cardoso pushed for greater Chinese investment in Nigeria’s financial markets, including naira-denominated instruments.

The discussions involved the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC).

𝗪𝗛𝗬 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗠𝗔𝗧𝗧𝗘𝗥𝗦

https://x.com/thecindyyy_/status/2113608.snippet:
When Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger left ECOWAS last year, many of us felt the ripple in markets and border posts. Last week in Dakar the two sides sat down properly and agreed to build a practical cooperation framework — not a return to membership, but rules that could ease trade, movement and security cooperation.
Ordinary people have been paying the price of the split in higher costs and delays. If these working groups deliver clear, fair rules, that is what actually matters on the ground. The question is whether we keep the focus on livelihoods or let process swallow the purpose.

Is it a coincidence that the areas with rare earth in Myanmar are also conflict zones?

In northern Myanmar’s Kachin State, near the Chinese border, rare earth deposits overlap with areas controlled by armed groups like the KIO.

After the KIO took control of the Chipwi–Pangwa area, China initially closed the border for rare earth-related imports and exports.

Rare earth mining in Myanmar has become closely tied to local conflicts. Armed groups use mining revenues to fund their operations, while China seeks stable access to these critical minerals. The result is a pattern where resource-rich border regions are also hotspots of fighting.

Is it a coincidence that the areas with rare earth in Myanmar are also conflict zones?

In northern Myanmar’s Kachin State, near the Chinese border, rare earth deposits overlap with areas controlled by armed groups like the KIO.

After the KIO took control of the Chipwi–Pangwa area, China initially closed the border for rare earth-related imports and exports.

Rare earth mining in Myanmar has become closely tied to local conflicts. Armed groups use mining revenues to fund their operations, while China seeks stable access to these critical minerals. The result is a pattern where resource-rich border regions are also hotspots of fighting.

https://x.com/dejiadesogan/status/211355.snippet:
Bandit Infighting Claims Over 40 Lives in Zamfara, Brother of Ado Allero Reportedly Killed

By: Zagazola Makama

A violent internal clash among rival factions of armed bandits in the eastern Mada axis of Zamfara State has reportedly left more than 40 fighters dead, including a younger brother of notorious bandit kingpin Ado Allero, identified as “Senator”.

Security sources and local accounts said the deadly confrontation occurred amid escalating tensions within the armed groups operating in the area, although the exact circumstances that triggered the infighting remain unclear.

Among those reportedly killed was Senator, said to be a younger brother of Ado Allero, one of the notorious bandit leaders operating in the North-West.

The reported death of Senator, if confirmed, could represent a significant development within the network associated with the bandit kingpin, particularly if it deepens existing divisions among armed groups operating across Zamfara and neighbouring states.

Preliminary accounts indicated that the confrontation involved armed elements from within the bandit networks, with casualties reportedly exceeding 40 fighters.

Zagazola report that the disputes over territorial control, disagreements over leadership and competition for resources have contributed to tensions among criminal groups operating in parts of the North-West. 

Further updates will follow as more credible information becomes available.

https://x.com/dejiadesogan/status/211355.snippet_zh:
赞法拉州武装 bandit 内部争斗据称造成40多人死亡，Ado Allero的弟弟据报遇害

作者：Zagazola Makama

据报道，赞法拉州东部Mada地区多个 rival 武装 bandit 派系发生暴力内部冲突，造成40多名武装人员死亡，其中包括臭名昭著的 bandit 头目Ado Allero的弟弟“Senator”。

安全消息人士和当地民众称，致命冲突发生在该地区武装团体之间紧张局势不断升级之际，不过引发这场内斗的具体原因尚不清楚。

据报遇死者包括Senator，据称他是Ado Allero的弟弟。Ado Allero是活跃于西北地区的臭名昭著的 bandit 头目之一。

如果Senator遇死的消息得到证实，可能意味着与这名 bandit 头目有关的网络将出现重大变化，尤其是在这一事件加剧赞法拉州及邻近各州武装团体之间现有分裂的情况下。

初步消息称，冲突涉及bandit网络内部的武装人员，死亡人数据称超过40名武装人员。

Zagazola报道称，围绕地盘控制的争夺、领导权分歧以及对资源的竞争，加剧了西北部分地区犯罪团体之间的紧张关系。

随着更多可靠信息的公布，后续消息将持续更新。

China and India in a standoff at multiple locations along Arunachal border since July, India hosted Xi Jinping from Sep 11-13 for the BRICS summit. 
“In the past few-days, a situation arose where face-off happened at several locations in Arunachal and it still continues,” ITBP D-G Shatrujeet Kapur said on Thursday.
This is the first official confirmation of the scale of the continuing tensions on the north-eastern border since July this year.
Government sources told The Hindu that since late July, India and China have been engaged in a stand-off at Asaphila near Taksing in Arunachal Pradesh. The Chinese People’s Liberation Army (PLA) is said to have pitched tents at an elevation, within 6-7 kilometres of India’s perception of the Line of Actual Control (LAC) near Maja company operating base in Taksing circle of Upper Subansiri district, sources said. https://x.com/adeyusuf_ia/status/2113399.snippet:
How a Village Self-Defence Group Turned Into Nigeria’s New Cross-Border Terror Bridge

In 2017, border villages in Sokoto invited an armed herding militia, Lakurawa to shield them from bandits.

By 2026, that former vigilante force had evolved into one of Nigeria’s fastest-spreading terror threats:
• Taxed Kebbi and Sokoto communities ₦50m ($36,000) in March 2026 just to let clerics preach Ramadan tafsir
• Killed 162 civilians in Woro and Nuku, Kwara State after villages rejected its rule
• Built an active corridor linking Sahelian jihadists (ISGS/JNIM) toward northern Benin and central Nigeria

History’s hardest internal security lesson repeats: when the state leaves a vacuum, outsourced community defence rarely stays defensive for long.

https://x.com/china_emb_ng/status/211331.snippet:
Chinese Ambassador to Nigeria Yu Dunhai Pays a Courtesy Call on Nigerian First Lady Senator Oluremi Tinubu @SenRemiTinubu

On October 22, 2026, Chinese Ambassador to Nigeria Yu Dunhai paid a courtesy call on H.E. Senator Oluremi Tinubu, CON, First Lady of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

Ambassador Yu stated that this year marks the 55th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Nigeria. Over the past 55 years, the two countries have stood together through thick and thin, firmly supporting each other on issues concerning their respective core interests and major concerns. Under the strategic guidance of our two Heads of State, the China-Nigeria Comprehensive Strategic Partnership has entered a new stage of high-quality development. China is ready to work with Nigeria to strengthen practical cooperation across all sectors, accelerate the release of benefits from zero-tariff measures, and propel bilateral relations to new heights. Ambassador Yu also briefed her on the four principles for constructive participation by all parties in resolving African hotspot issues and four-point proposition on advancing China-Africa mining cooperation proposed by President Xi Jinping, emphasizing that China always respects Africa’s ownership and resource sovereignty, and looks forward to achieving win-win cooperation and common development with the continent.

Senator Oluremi Tinubu spoke highly of bilateral relations, thanking China for supporting Africa’s independent development through initiatives such as zero-tariff policies. She noted that China is a great partner of Nigeria, and the Nigerian side stands ready to make joint efforts with China to sustain the sound momentum of Nigeria-China relations.

中国驻尼日利亚大使于敦海拜访尼日利亚第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布参议员 @SenRemiTinubu

2026年10月22日，中国驻尼日利亚大使于敦海拜访了尼日利亚联邦共和国第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布参议员阁下。

于大使表示，今年是中华人民共和国与尼日利亚建交55周年。过去55年来，两国风雨同舟、相互支持，在涉及各自核心利益和重大关切的问题上坚定地相互支持。在两国元首的战略指导下，中尼全面战略伙伴关系已进入高质量发展新阶段。中国愿与尼日利亚携手努力，加强各务实领域合作，加快零关税措施惠益的释放，推动双边关系迈上新台阶。于大使还向她介绍了习近平主席提出的各方 constructive 参与解决非洲热点问题的四项原则，以及推进中非矿业合作四点主张，强调中国始终尊重非洲国家的主人翁地位和对资源的控制权，并期待与非洲大陆实现互利合作和共同发展。

奥卢雷米·蒂努布参议员高度评价了两国双边关系，感谢中国通过零关税政策等举措支持非洲独立发展。她表示，中国是尼日利亚的伟大伙伴，尼日利亚愿与中国共同努力，保持尼中关系良好发展势头。

Africa Corps under pressure: the 🌴Sahel, April–October 2026

Russia promised security to the Sahel’s military regimes. The facts tell a different story.

🇲🇱 Mali: On 25 April, coordinated 🥷JNIM and FLA attacks struck several locations, including Bamako and Kati. Defence Minister Sadio Camara was killed and Kidal fell to the FLA. On 10 September, JNIM overran Dioura, reportedly killing over 100 Malian soldiers and five Africa Corps personnel. Russian-backed forces returned to Kidal in October after the FLA withdrew—but holding it remains the real test.

🇧🇫 Burkina Faso: JNIM continues to inflict heavy losses. At least 34 civilians were reportedly executed in Titao in February; around 90 soldiers were reportedly killed in a September ambush at Koubel-Alpha.
